reviewText: comes with few keys, which includes one with a LED light built in. Works great, it's bright to let the thieves know that they have to deal with something for a bit of time, which is always a bad sign for them. Also, the orange reminder cable serves the same purpose.Great buy overall.
I always lock up my motorcycle when it sits outside. I live in an apartment complex and every body leaves my motorcyle alone.

A bit tough to insert the key into the hole as the towing light outlet on the left is partly in the way.  It's manageable to lock and unlock, but you have to do it at a slight angle and/or wiggle it in.  The black makes it look hidden and matches nice.
Nice lock.  Fit perfectly on my 2013 F150.  Should keep the thieves away from my ball or cover.  Easy to use.

Very well made unit, fits my Ford F150 and my Ram 2500 , Grease the snot out of it inside and out and install. The cover is a bit cheap but seems to work well. Double Double Check that you have the locking end on correctly, Just play with it before use and you will master it.

I've been using this unit for a while now and have found it to be well made and satisfactory. The only reason I did not rate it a 5 was because the installation and removal of the locked end usually takes two hands. It is not quite as convenient as others of these I've seen in which you can insert the key and lock or unlock it with just one hand. But I consider that to be a relatively minor complaint on a unit that otherwise appears to be well-made and durable.
I was looking for a better lock that didn't rust, and this is the one. The lock is simple to operate and includes a rubber cover over the key hole. Looks great too with a black bumper.

I was a bit skeptical buying this on line without seeing it, but once it arrived I was happy I did, great lock and the fact it has the cover that stops dirt and grim getting in the lock made me even happier.
Works great so far. Live in the north east so it has functioned in all types of weather so far. Make sure to spray a little WD40 in the cylinder to protect against rust
Couldn't find a better hitch lock for the price. I use this for various hitch accessories and it has been very useful to protect my property.
very good quality lock and pin combo.was a little concerned at first but this thing is tough as nails.very high quality

This doesn't fit my 2007 Toyota Tacoma factory hitch.  It needs to be 2 7/8".  The package on this lock reads 2 5/8 but I measured it at 2 3/4.  I'm going to have to grind the bolt.Update, Jan 2014.  An noted I had to grind the inside ends to make this fit in my Tacoma OEM hitch.  Once, it was ground to the proper length, I spray-painted the bolt and have used it to haul a 19-foot trailer and attach my tow hook ever since with no further problems.

Hi All.I have used all different Brands of Receiver Locks over the past 45 years as RV'ers.  This is well made and should hold up for a long time.  The Rubber Dust Cap is pretty nice to have on these also, to keep the dirt and dust and water out of the lock.  A good inside clean lock, is a good working lock.  We sure couldn't complain about the cost of this one.  I have paid a lot more for 2 inch Receiver Locks in the past, and they haven't been as good as this one is.  I have alwasy replace the old fashioned Hitch Pins with the Clips with 2 inch Receiver Locks.  That way no one can mess with any of your RV Hook-Ups.  And you also don't have to ever worry about a pin comming out, and having your old fashioned Hitch Pin fall out.  I use one Receiver Lock, to lock our Tow Bar to our Motorhome.  And I use two more Reveiver Locks to lock the Tow Bar to the front Basp Plate of our Toad being Towed 4 Down.  Nobody can ever mess with this set-up, and noting is ever going to come undone on its own, ever.  Happy Travels
summary: A Nice Receiver Lock, at a Fair price.

reviewText: Nice looking product with the black coating.  Only fits the 2 inch receivers though.  It will be put to use on another vehicle!

This little lock works as advertised.  It fits my class 3 receiver no problem.  I haven't had a problem yet, but I don't think the little rubber cover will last very long.It's tight enough on the hitch that I don't think anyone could get it off easily without a key.Overall I think this was a good purchase.  Works great for me.

Very well made; I wound up not needing it, and returned it, but I almost kept it, as the price is reasonable, and it is really well made.  Should I need one in the future, I will be re-ordering this one!

I wanted to replace my current receiver lock with something black that better fits my truck color scheme and this was just about it. It arrived on time and I was surprised with its workmanship. This is a very sturdy device that locks tight. There is no play in the lock head and it uses a nice "handcuff" like cylinder type locking key. It also comes with a nice rubber weather cover for the key. I'm very happy with the lock and highly recommend this product.
Extremely nice heavy duty comes with a debris cover for the lock mechanism as well, the utube videos showing  bic pen is a load of crap as well, unless you have the key it isn't coming off.
Solid pin. The keyhole cover slips often. I added 3 rubber o-rings to snug it up to the 2 inch hitch.

After looking around in stores and most hitch receivers being $20+ I thought I would have a look on amazon. Decided to go with this one due to the great reviews. And they are well-deserved. It is a quality receiver lock for $13.No bells and whistles, but a solid, receiver lock. The black color looks nice as well. I won't expect the plastic end cap to keep ALL moisture out to prevent rusting, etc. but at least it will do some good.Nothing much else to say. It is a good deal.
summary: Great product for a great price!

reviewText: Very high quality with heavy duty strength rating.  My only complaint is the rubber cover on keylock seems flimsy and comes loose.

After reading some of the reviews, I was hesitant to buy this hitch pin, but did anyway.  With theft being protected by the judicial system circus, I imagine a criminal would attempt to pick the lock.  It sure would be costly if I caught him.  Anyway, I believe the pin is worth the investment.

Probably the best receiver lock pin available for the money. It's a bit long like others have reported but that can be remedied with a garden hose washer or other rubber washer, o-rings or cut a piece a sheet rubber to take up the gap and eliminate the rattle. The lock opens easily, it has a cap to keep out dirt/grime & it's strong. This Trimax product should last a long time.

The Trimax T-3Black receiver lock is one of the best locks offered.  It's plenty long and very well made.  The weight and feel of the metal is a testament to it's quality and workmanship.  I am very satisfied with the lock. The rubber lock cover keeps out dirt and water.  It is definitely worth the money.Update: After going thru a brutal winter in Ohio, this lock rusted and the key wouldn't open it.  i ended up having to cut it off (which by the way wasn't easy) Maybe if I would have lubed it good and made sure the cover was on constantly it may have lasted. For that reason alone I reappraised it to One star.
summary: Trimax receiver lock is one of the best

reviewText: Good lock that I use to secure my portable winch when I'm on trips and stop at restaurants. Without this it would only take a thief less than a minute to be gone with my property.
summary: Good lock to keep my property secure.

reviewText: Love this thing. Cheap and cool looking. Just wish the rubber cover stayed on better. Not big enough of an issue to loose a star.
Like it a lot. Purchased because the old one rusted, and wanted something that would hold up. Good product and built tuff.
Have not been using for very long, but it seems to be holding up so far. I tow a snowmobile all winter so will see what shape it is in after winter.
Lock your hitch and trailer, good quality stuff, i do recommend. I bought it because some of my friends had their trailer hitch stolen in parking lot...
So far so good.  Hopefully casing is strong enough to handle the elements.  Lock function seems a little quirky, but I suppose that prevents accidental lock/unlock.

I have this securing a smittybilt receiver hitch with D-ring and I've been very happy with it.  Nice, snug fit.  No rattles.  Hav enot yet had a chance to test it's tensile strength in real-world recovery applications, but I don't think it's going to be the weak point.  Two keys included.
so far so good. i haven't pulled anything yet with this installed but it sure looks sturdy and nice hope it works as it should. i do like the fact that it has a dirt/water shield where you unlock it.
fits perfectly on my jeep rubicon very well made and high quality materials. I would hight recommend to anyone. Thanks Sam
summary: Very well made and looks awesome

reviewText: very handy little guy! very solid locking feature, good to make sure no one jacks your hitch! well worth the price!

It locks and unlocks well with a "positive" engagement feel when it is secure. Fits great for both my front bumper receiver and rear receiver on my 2005 Dodge Ram.  No complaints, and I'd definitely buy it again.

This unit is great. The keyhole is sealed with a rubber cap to prevent dirt and moisture from entering and it is solid and strong. I had to tap the end lightly with a rubber mallet to get it through, but other than that it worked great! Comes with two keys.

As others have said the pin is a bit long for a 2" receiver but this is easily remedied. To prevent the side-to-side play just get some small O-rings from the dollar store and stack enough on the fixed end. When you slide the pin in you compress the rings slightly to put the lock on. When you let go the O-rings expand and put pressure on the pin and also keep it from rattling.

I purchased this to secure my motorcycle.  I use it on my 1976 FXE Harley's front rotor.  It works well and secures the front with the lock and visible indication to hopefully make the thief move on to another bike.  The only problem I had with it was I wanted to put it on my rear wheel because that makes it much harder for a thief to take the bike.  My rotor's holes are too small for the pin to fit and the throat barely fit due to my rotor's thickness.  It does however fit well on my front rotor.Bottom line, this is a good, low cost solution to add as one additional layer of theft protection for your motorcycle.
summary: Well made security lock for your motorcycle

reviewText: This lock is of super sturdy build, comes with 3 keys (one even has an LED light on it), carrying pouch with strap to hold into your bike or bag, and reminder cable. I can't imagine a better quality lock, especially under $50.One thing to note, as I was confused when ordering; make sure you understand what short vs long throat means. It is how far the lock needs to reach into clear your brake disc. I got the short for my '98 BMW F650, it does not reach far enough in, but luckily lines up with the holes on the disc allowing it to work. Had I gotten the long throat, I'd have no problem with that.

Does what it supposed to do,Fits most of my scooters.Does not fit a Honda Shadow 750's disc brake, because the disc is too wide.One star less, because the mechanism to mount the pouch to the handlebars is very weak, and impractical (I can't install it on handlebars of scooters because they have the handlebars covered with plastic, and can't install it on the handlebars of my motorcycle, because the hand grips and throttle are too wide, so it does not fit; the pouch also does not have a locking mechanism, so it's kind of moot to try to mount it somewhere).Otherwise, a great purchase!
Excellent quality. Added security in addition to the Scorpio i900 alarm system on my Ninja. Buying a Zuma next month & another Trimax for that as well.
I have a 750 Honda Shadow and this will not fit over the disk brakes. It was too cheap to hassle with the return.
summary: Only fits very thin brake discs

reviewText: Good weight. Easy to use. Bright color so you don't forget its there.Just slide this baby on the disc brake, push the button down and your good to go.Probably the easiest lock I've ever owned and gotta say the protection is there.Good quality.  Lots of extra keys.The key cover flips open and it's really cheap. Basically you just tear it off the first time using it because it's pointless.Recommended.

This lock is compact, heavy, and solid.  It fits on the brake rotor of my 2013 Ninja 300 perfectly.  It would definitely be difficult for someone to pry or cut this off, however it doesn't stop someone from taking the wheel/rotor off, or just simply lifting the bike onto a trailer.
Great for a 3" wide receiver for Tacoma or Tundra. It can be hard to find a hitchpin that is for a wider/reinforced receiver. This works well with some small room to spare. Highly recommend.

I like this design because it has nothing to hang down and it fits equally well inserted from either direction. The rubber cap keeps junk out of the lock's workings. It's strong enough to handle any load you will put on it from a class V hitch (tested to 40,000 lbs).It's good enough that this is my second of these locks. First is still great, needed one for another vehicle.

This is a nicer lock than I expected.  I missed this detail when I ordered it... but this lock is different than the other receiver lock I have used.  Most receiver locks (I think) use spring loaded pins to "lock".  When you unlock it you pull a sleeve out and then the springs push the pins away and the lock comes off.  This is all fine and good till you get some rust, then the springs can't push the pins out and you end up banging on the lock with a hammer for an hour (trust me, I know from experience)This pin has a T-shaped tip and the lock rotates around it to lock it in place.  This means there are no springs to jam.  The turning of the key directly unlocks the pin.  This seems much more robust to me.Notes on Material* The packaging states that the PIN is Stainless Steel.  It never claims the lock is all stainless.  I'm guessing the inside of the lock has some carbon steel due to strength requirements.* Some people have complained that the inside rusts.  I put a couple sprays of silicone in the lock to help protect from rust.Notes on Fit* This is longer than needed for my truck.  I have a 2012 F150 with the Max Tow package.  This is probably about 3/4" longer than what I need.  I was worried about it being too short so I ordered this "extended" version.  I suppose I should have just gone out and measured the hitch receiver.* Anyway, I am not worried.  I will probably add a couple o-rings (like others have said) to keep it from rattling too bad.Pictures* I took some pictures of the packaging and on my truck.  I thought it would be nice to see the notes on the packaging so thats why I took the pics...
summary: Nice design - fits my 2012 F150 hitch

reviewText: my regular size class 5 locker didnt fit on the new truck so had to order this. its a little longer then needed but a couple rubber washers make sure it does not rattle too much. great quality pin. should get years of service from it
summary: fits 2014 F350 super duty and is SOLID

reviewText: I had a locking pin from a previous truck that I owned and when I went to use it, uh, it is too short? So I then realized this truck has a Class V hitch.... so I had to find a pin that had a span of at least 3.10". I also wanted a stainless one as the plated ones will rust and I have already had to cut one off in my travels as I could not get it to release the lock mechanism.It came on time and packaging was simple and not adult proof, which was nice that the clam shell opened with some effort, but no scissors or knife required. It unlocks and locks very easy and with a 3.50" span--- it fit without a hitch (yes, pun intended!). It has a good mat finish and if I had a criticism it would be that the rubber cap should be deeper and the band that prevents it from falling off when you go to use the key should have been wider so it doesn't come off too easily. Other than that, it looks good and is nicer than anything I could even possibly find locally.
summary: Cannot find this kind of item locally. Good fit and worth the purchase

reviewText: Very well made, and fit perfectly.All stainless.  2 keys and does the job.Would recommend to anyone who wants to leave their trailer ball attached.I would have rated it 5 stars if it had a conventional key for it, but it has a circular key which I don't think that I can have duplicated very inexpensively.

I first heard about headlamp restoration kits from a mechanic who offered to make my old headlights look like new while I wait. I must admit I was skeptical and declined the service. Then I heard about this product again and bought a competing kit to restore the headlamps on a car I was selling. It made the headlamps look like new! I had no idea that the yellowing and fogginess of older headlamps is caused by road grime, bugs, grit, wind, and overall aging of the top layer of plastic.I sold that car to the first person to see it and from then on was sold on headlamp restoration. It actually drives me crazy to see yellow headlights on the various cars in parking lots. I'm basically a headlamp restoration evangelist.I tried this kit and it worked just as well as the other kit but took longer since you do everything by hand. If you have a cordless drill, there are some more expensive kits that come with an attachment to install on your drill to make the sanding go faster.I have one more car to sell, so I restored the headlights a bit more since their last treatment two years ago and they are sparkly and bright again.I also believe that even if you are not into vehicle vanity that these make your car safer on the road because your headlamps work better.

I've always wondered how used car lots and dealers get their cars looking so much better than average; I remember trading in an old car once and was shocked how good it looked a few days later. Now I can start to see why/how...products like this can really make a difference but at least for me, this is the first time I've encounted something for the do it yourself type person.I'm not mechanically inclined nor prone to spend a dime more on a vehicle than absolutely necessary...on the other hand, I like to keep things looking decent but have always hated the high cost of professional detailing and related. This is the perfect solution. It's affordable, easy to use and gets great results. No special tools or skills are required, it's not excessively difficult and the results look great.Terrific product!

This kit works if your headlights have been "sandblasted" by a few years of dirt and grime on the roads.  It seems to work by removing all dirt and then smoothing and filling in the imperfections on the plastic "cover" for your headlight.  If you headlights are just dirty, this really isn't for you.  It also won't do anything if the problem is a leak or anything on the inside.For this review, I went to the junkyard and tried it on three different cars.  The first car was a 1996 Honda Accord.  The headlights were yellow.  The kit did a decent job of smoothing out the imperfections in the plastic, but the plastic was still yellowed at the end.  The second car was a 2002 BMW (not HID) and the kit worked really well to improve the deeply pitted headlight lenses.  The final car was a 1991 Lexus LS400 with headlights that had been replaced with a HID kit.  These came out the worst of the three.  The headlights started out an 8 on a scale of 10 and the third and fourth steps never did much to restore the very scary sanding step.  They ended up worse then they started - maybe a 6 of 10.  I attribute this to the very cheep feeling plastic lens.
summary: It works, but requres a lot of work and some skill

reviewText: It was just a matter of time before someone came out with a product like this. I am unable to give a long term review as yet; however, thus far the product appears to have dome what it was noted for. It removed the fog from the plastic and restored them to like new condition with minimal effort.

This product greatly exceeded my expectations.  My headlights look brand new again.  What a wonderful product!This kit includes the following:1 pair of latex gloves2 pieces of fine sandpaperCleaning clothsPretreatmentCleaner / PolishShine Restorer / ProtectorWe own a 2002 Mitsubishi Lancer OZ Rally Edition. It has about 100k miles on it and it's in pretty good condition. However the headlights had become very cloudy and yellow over time. I have tried scrubbing them with various cleaning products and pressure washing and never saw any improvement. I had been considering purchasing a new set of headlights but I figured I would give this product a try first.The instructions were very simple and easy to follow.I started off by applying the Pretreatment to each lens and was amazed as the yellow grime melted off of the headlights.Then I used the fine 1500 grit sandpaper and wet sanded the front of the headlights and this seemed to remove anything that the first step didn't remove.Next I applied the Headlight Cleaner / Polish and after completion the headlights looked very clean but they just didn't have that new car shine.Finally I applied the Shine Restorer / Protector and instantly saw a huge difference. I ended up putting 4 coats on for the last step and I had to wait 5 minutes in between coats. The whole process took me about an hour total. I also noticed that I have enough product left to clean them again in the future. Each of the bottles is still about half full. I am out of sandpaper but I can get that at any hardware store.I took a before and after photo of my headlights compared the two and there is a huge difference. They looked pretty disgusting prior to using this product and now they look just about brand new. I would have had to spend several hundred dollars to get a new set of headlights. This product will give almost the same result for a very small fraction of the replacement price. It's well worth it in my opinion.  I highly recommedn this product.
summary: 8 year old headlights look Brand New again...

reviewText: This product really works; but you need to put some elbow grease into getting good results.  You can watch a video at the manufactures website with the instructions.Basically what you do is1) Clean the head lights with provided solution2) Sand (yep) with two grits of sandpaper in a back and forth motion using water.3) Polish with a gritty solution4)  Wipe on a solution that fills in any small scratches leftWhat this does is clear up all the little scratches and dings in the plastic that make the light diffract (bounce) around instead of going out through the headlight.  The last solution is some sort of acrylic that must have the same index of refraction (how much it bends light) as the plastic used in the headlights.You really need to put some time and effort into each standing and polishing step.  I found it easier to work with the car lights on in the dark, it made the scratches and dings easier to see.  It took me about an hour and a half to do two cars.  How long probably depends on how bad your headlights are to begin with, the older car took much longer.I was able to clear up the headlights on two cars just barely (I ran out of the last solution) .  One weas a 2003 Mazda Protégé and the second was a 2005 Hyundai Elantra.  Interestingly the sealing solution worked noticeably better on the Elantra.You will need more paper towels than are provided.  It would be nice if the solutions had different colored labels, you have to be careful to read them each time with each headlight.  If you do not use the gloves you will end up with slightly shiny fingers.BE SURE TO READ THE DIRECTIONS!  You do not want to polish with the sandpaper in circles, for example.A great product that performs as promised.Addition:  I had some of the polishing fluid leftover and decided to try it on the solar panels on the top of some of my decorative solar lights which were no longer charging.  After using the polish on the lights, 4 of the 6 nonworking lights will now charge the batteries again!
summary: Works very well, but put in some time and effort to get great results. Also used on solar lights

reviewText: Just what I needed to install two lighter/power sockets under the seat of my motorcycle to power my mobile electronics.

Mounted on my tractor underneath the canopy to keep it out of the weather I can connect any type of accessory with the same connection.I connected my "cigarette lighter" volt meter to monitor my charging system but the outlet doesn't seem to maintain adequate contact to the plug.  The same voltage meter works just fine in my pickup truck but will not stay consistent while connected to this power outlet.The volt meter shows a less than full current flow until I press the plug into the socket and hold it there then it reads correctly.  The accessories that I have plugged into this outlet seem to work without issue.It works well enough that I give it 4 stars.  The housing is heavy polymer and should hold up well.The rubber outlet covers are adequate yet they can be easily lost if care is not taken when removing them.  The little rubber retaining rings only do so much .

Generally a mandatory addition to any vehicle's dash area, or any other appropriate location, so we can power the plethora of portable devices we used in our vehicles today, such as GPS units, cell phone chargers, laptop connectors, games, etc.  Easy to install with the provided screws and with basic knowledge of auto wiring the connection to power is also simple, skill level 2.  I'm satisfied with delivery, which was within a week of ordering.

Not the best. I put this in the back of my pickup, covered by a topper, to run a 12v cooler during the summer. I put groceries in the cooler from store to home.Instal is straight forward. The black wire grounds directly to the box with a sheet metal screw. I ran a hot from the battery + via 10ga to the red and spliced them together.The unit is one piece, plastic. I used body tape to stick this to the pickup box and drilled holes for two sheet metal screws. So far, it holds well and works. I get the feeling this will not last as long as I want as it seems a little cheaply made. Then again, it was cheap so I am not expecting great things from it.
summary: I suppose you get what you pay for.

reviewText: Super high quality, much better than I expected for such a low price. Comes with connectors on wires but I cut them to use different ones for my project. This is a great way to add more ports to a car. I hid them under my dash for things I keep plugged in like my GPS and dash cam.
Nice high amp (current) rating on this. I epoxy it to a 12ah  12 volt gel battery and I can use it as a jumpstarter oremergency power supply for camping or power outages.

I use it on a 17 foot Boston Whaler.  I connected it directly to the battery so I can use spot lights, other lighting, charge cell phones, etc.  Can't get any simpler.  Basically a piece of useful junk.  Recommend it.
This outlet is made of nice quality. It works great and I believe will last quite a while. I would buy again if needed.

I built a counsel in my Motor home where a old CRT TV was taking up way to much room for this old man to crawl over to get to the drivers seat.  I have GPS, Backup Camera, Satellite radio two cell phones a i-Pod and i-Pad to keep charged, so I am in need of a lot of power in my counsel.  These double power outlets ought to do the trick, plus I am turning one of the outlets into a double USB port for charging also.I have to tell anyone interested I love Amazon, they deliver so fast, quicker than I can go to the store in a lot of cases, one of the pleasures of living in a small town.
This is a reinforced bracket with a plastic coating, very strong feeling when mounted securely.  No flex as I plug in/out of it.  The sockets seem to be likewise, very solid and secure feeling.
Got this to add a 12v power outlet jack to my car that was "Hot" all the time.It was easy to tie into the fuse box and worked well.
summary: 10242 Auxiliary Twin Power Outlet (Boat or Car)

reviewText: This unit is well made and was easy to install.I can now run 3 different pieces of equipment off my front dash.Just what I needed.Would recommend this to anyone looking to add 12V power hookups to their vehicle.

A necessary for today's vehicles.My Camry had two outlets  in the front but the demand was very high as my GPS,my phone,my daughters's Laptop and her phone,heated and massaging car seat etc. were all looking for their turn to connect. Hence I ordered this along with an inline fuse and got it installed by a professional by bypassing the ignition switch.Now my GPS and phone charger a  re connected to these outlets and now my GPS (which is my mp 3 music player also) and phone batteries remain charged . and the two factory installed outlets are available for any other requirement.
I did hook this up to my car battery, left it on for a few days and when I checked on it, it wasn't working nooo mooore
summary: I hooked this up to my car battery

reviewText: Using this to keep the charge up on my battery for my camper and doing an excellent job so far.  The true test will be this spring when everything is hooked up again.

I did not carefully read reviews before placed my order.  Few buyer pointed out the product feature has changed.  According ad photo, It suppose has green and red indicator lights but only comes with one single red light, green light feature is omitted.  Red light means AC power is on but no way to tell it is actually charging or not?  For only one red light version, you can pay less than half price from other seller for similar product at Amazon.
Purchased several to keep the batteries charged on my classic cars. They work very well and the price is right! Highly recommended.
I bought this charger to replace an OEM one that failed for our 4-wheeler. I have also used it on my Harley. It works as good as the more expensive varieties.
very nice looking and very heavy duty..its pretty tough getting on though..very tight but i used a flat bar and it slipped right on..
summary: very well made but tough to get on

reviewText: Fits fine.  Looks good.  About 6 months later, the "Jeep" logos have started to fade off.  Other than that, I'm happy with the cover.

This is a great cover. It is long lasting and durable. It has a great finish and high quality like leather feel. As advertised, it also does not leave much smell on your hands. The steering wheel cover I had previously bought from Wal-Mart left strong odors on your hand.
at first I thought it wouldn't fit but after sitting in the sun I was able to fit it over the steering wheel. look good
Perfect addition to any jeep! Not bulky like some other steering wheels. I would buy this again in a heartbeat.
This cover is almost perfect. Size is good. It was easy to install even in cold weather. Looks great and insulates wheel.

I bought this for a 2012 Wrangler Unlimited Rubicon. Unlike others, mine was fairly cool when I installed it. It was a task to get on, I bent a fingernail completely backwards, but still went on in about 3 minutes.It doesn't cover the entire circumference of the steering wheel's grip, but it isn't supposed to. I'd guess it covers about 60% but, I think it feels good and solid. I fits tight enough to prevent slipping and doesn't cover any of my steering wheel controls. I feel that the added thickness improves grip and prevents hand fatigue.Some other reviews mentioned that the Jeep logos were embroidered. Mine are stamped and painted. I could see them rubbing off a bit over time but haven't experienced it myself. I lined up the logos on parts of the wheel that I rarely use; 10:00 2:00 and 6:00. As far as odor, I didn't notice one, probably due to the air freshener that was already there.The look and feel of this cover are great for the price. It's a neat detail for my white Jeep and keeps the cold at bay. We'll see how it holds up to a Houston Summer. Shipping was fast, although I had issues with the carrier's delivery. I recommend this for style, protection and function.
summary: Definitely a low cost/high quality mod...

reviewText: I see that no one has left a review in a while, so they no one may  have ordered for a 2012.I ordered this for my 2012 JK and it does not fit. The circumference for the steering wheel was right but I assume the "thickness" of the steerng wheel has changed as this does not cover the steering wheel correctly (front to back) and I had to remove and return...

I just purchased a black 2012 Jeep Wrangler Unlimited (that I love) and this steering wheel cover looks sharp!!!If you are considering this cover and are looking at the negative reviews keep these things in mind:-Steering wheel covers are hard to get on in general.  This is so the cover does not slip and cause you to loose your grip on the steering wheel while driving.  Yes, it took a little muscle but I'm 5'3", 125lbs and after getting the top part of the cover on the wheel, with a little help from one of my (girl) friends, we were able to slide the bottom on together.-All leather/plastic/rubber steering wheel covers stink at first and it can rub off on to your hands.  The smell does go away though!-This cover looks sharp and is well made.  If you like the way it looks, I would highly recommend it to all Jeep lovers!!!

Very well made, and adds some jeep pride to your ride. feels great while driving. It is a tight fit, so instructions say lay it in the sun to warm it up before installing. Cleans up easy if you have been on dusty trails or in the mud. The only negative is that a little bit of the steering whell shows in the slit. but as it stretches out that goes away.

I bought this steering wheel cover to hide the peeling leather on my 2001 Jeep Grand Cherokee Limited steering wheel. I measured the inside dimensions of the wheel, 15". I did not have to heat or stretch the new wheel cover, it fit perfectly and looks great. It's also much easier to keep clean with interior protectant.
Easy to install!  Does not slip or slide around once installed.  I used this to cover up a worn steering wheel on my Cherokee.  I've been using it for the last 10,000 miles without any complaints.

I'll start by saying that this does a good job of keeping your face warm.  However, even a relatively small pair of glasses like what I'm wearing (Oakley "drill bit") are somewhat too large for these.  I cu the nose hole out to about twice as large as it originally was, and cut a bit out of the hole around the eyes to clear the ear pieces, but it is seemingly impossible to get the mask close enough to my face so that my breath all goes through the mouth and nose hole instead of coming up through the eye parts and fogging my glasses up immediately.  My modifications do make it at least work indoors where it isn't cold (out of the box, it would fog up inside, too), but I didn't get this for playing dress-up inside.  But not everyone wears glasses, so I assume this probably works fine for those people.
summary: Not great for someone with glasses

reviewText: I will be using this  a lot this winter since I live in a cold climate (Minnesota). I do spend my time ice fishing and snowmobiling in the winter. This will help protect my face from the cold wind. Good buy!

It was way too small for an adult head.  After testing it a couple of times, I started getting dizzy and not sure whether it was the fumes I was smelling when the mask was tight close to my nose. Anyway, I simple cannot rate this any higher not because of the small size but more about the odor/fumes.
summary: Got this for Halloween but did not use it

reviewText: I bought this mask with the intent to use for sub-zero running/exercise.It's reversible and both sides are comfortable.  The skull graphic is printed on one side and is slightly less soft than the unprinted side but it didn't bother me in the least.  It covers the full forehead down to about the mid throat.  With a stocking hat it covers the full head.Warmth: 100% warm. I've tested it at -15 F with a decent wind driving the windchill down to the -25 F or better range.  No problem.Fit: good.  It's obviously not tailor made for my face or head, but it's got plenty of adjustment in the Velcro strap and stays where you put it.  Warm air does leak up into the eye opening so wearing with glasses or goggles doesn't work well (depending on ambient temp, of course).Usability for running: The first problem I ran into was that the breathing holes are too small for sustained aerobic activity.  Once I got up to about an 8:30 pace I felt like I was breathing through a hose.  I didn't pass out but it was definitely restrictive.  I stuck with it for 3.5 miles before I tore the mask off.  The second issue related to very cold weather was that frost had started to close off some of the small breathing holes, making the breathing increasingly difficult.  I could have kept going but I decided that a cold face was more enjoyable than restricted breathing.  Although my face was so toasty from the 3.5 miles with the mask that I easily went another 3.Overall, even though it doesn't really work well for what I had hoped it gets 4 stars since I'll be able to use it for many other cold weather activities, it fits well, is of good quality and looks cool.  I may try to cut out the mouth openings a bit larger, too.  Why not.
summary: Neoprene mask & cold weather running review

reviewText: fits great all neoprene construction keep my face warm while riding my toys in the northeast winter without a full face helmet.

Originally bought this for a Halloween party that had to be cancelled due to Superstorm Sandy, but have discovered that it's even better than my old winter face mask (more complete coverage) and it's now destined for use when I'm out shoveling or blowing snow in our New England winters.

This is an excellent quality face mask, fitment with the velcro is secure and allows enough adjustability for my large 7-5/8" head (With room to spare.)Only downside is that wearing sunglasses with these promotes fog on the inside of the lenses due to breath captured by the mask. This is typical with neoprene face masks though, not a flaw in this particular mask.
summary: Great fitment, easy breathability, definitely will help keep the face warm in winds!

reviewText: Bought it for hunting season and it works great. Very comfortable and warm even in pretty low temperatures. Definitely a future return customer.

I was a bit nervous ordering a battery online, but this Yuasa was delivered in great shape and with clear instructions. The acid was added easily. The battery perfectly fit my 2005 Suzuki M50 Boulevard. The battery charged quickly using a small CTEK trickle charger. The price is great. The bike kicks over every time. Sure beats getting ripped off at the dealers.
Exact fit for my 2005 SV650.The instructions were clear - but probably because I watched the other reviewer's video on how to add the battery fluid. No problems encountered on my install.

Do yourself a favor and don't buy those junk Chinese batteries. I know they are cheap buy they won't last. The Yuasa is American made and lasts many times longer. I have several Yuasa batteries in my generator, ATV's and motorcycles and they all have lasted years. And if you use a battery maintainer they will last even longer.

Yuasa batteries are OEM in most if not all motorcycles. I've found they outlast all other brands I have tried over the years.The fit is perfect and can be verified on the manufacturers website.I would recommend Yuasa batteries for all motorcycle applications.
I've used Yuasa's for years.  Best MC battery made.  Installed just like OEM, starts right up.  Holds charge very well.

Replacement for a 2006 Vespa GT200.  Shipped dry, with the acid in bottles.  You should be mechanical enough to be able to follow detailed instructions on how to remove the covers and fill the battery.  Please WEAR SAFETY GLASSES and GLOVES!  Do this OUTSIDE and have a water hose near bye "just in case".... you don't want to accidentally spill or splash the acid on your skin!  Now that your scared... don't worry, it really is easy to do, just do it safely.  The last battery I bought was also a Yuasa and it was still going strong at 3 years.  I replaced it... "just to be on the safe side".  Motorcycle/scooter batteries should generally be replaced every year, or 2 at the most.  I was pushing really pushing it at 3.
I bought this unit and follow all procedures to prep the battery.  It fits perfectly in my 2004 Suzuki SV650s without any problem.

This is the original equipment for  my motorcycle.  The performance and  life of the battery seems good. You would probably have to pay more if you could find a higher performing battery that  would fit your motorcycle.

I have to be honest, I was a little scared when I heard that I have to put the acid in myself. However, when I got the battery the instructions were clear. Make sure to put the battery on a trickle charger for a few hours as it does not come charged. This battery replaced a 1 year old battery the previous owner installed. Hopefully this battery will last longer than that. No problems so far, after 2 months of running it in my SV650

I hear lots of bikers talking about how good this cleaner is so I decided to try a bottle. I first bought a small spray bottle and it worked pretty good so I bought this one+ gallon refill. It's not perfect if your bike's really dirty, as mine tends to get, you will need to apply a little elbow grease to get it really clean. My old back is almost 70 and it's getting harder and harder to bend over and hand wash my bike like I used to. And I'm also getting a little lazy too!

The only problem I am having is getting to to use it again. It does not use it's self. After the first time and it did good, I have been watching it for a month now and it has not went out there and cleaned it again. Just Damn!! LOL
I use S100 12005L Total Cycle Cleaner Bottle on my Chopper, great product.  Make sure bike is cool, spray on then rinse off with high pressure, gets majority of grime off bike.
A good way to minimize the high cost, by buying in bulk.  Besides, the spray bottle that S100 comes in, is not worth a poot.

Not only is this great for motorcycles, but also for cars as well when you have to get the bugs and tar off the lower skirt.Also works on Motorcycles as well.  I started using this stuff 20 years ago and while pricey there is nothing else like it.
I can't actually say if these quiet the pump, as I have not run it without them, but they certainly make installing it much easier (as they bend easily unlike PEX.

These can save you time and frustration while camping. If you spring a leak use one of these. I bought these to quiet a pump, but I found it was not needed for that. I had purchased an accumulator tank and it came with a very short connector so I used one of these and have the other for an emergency. It makes sense how it would dampen sound. RV's have little space to work in so one is a handy spare water-connector that is easy to finger tighten. Recommended.
summary: Works great and good to have on hand while RV ing

reviewText: This helped tremendously to silence the water pump on my Jayco fifth wheel. Jayco had originally mounted PEX tubing directly to the pump so any vibration was transmitted directly into the walls. These flexible hoses help to reduce the amount of vibration transmitted. Though it does still get loud when its cold and the hoses stiffen. These hoses are quite long (about 20") so pay attention to available space. Its nice to not have water usage wake everyone up in the middle of the night!

I replaced my old Flojet pump with a Revolution pump. While at it, I installed these hoses. One of my existing hoses was already the same type, but the other more rigid. I don't think these helped much, and it's more connections that need to be checked for leaks.
summary: Probably unnecessary, but I did it anyway

reviewText: Allo necessary connections and fittings were included.  It did help the pump noise on RV from getting into unit. t

That is until he installed it and you can't even hear the pump running.  It's almost crazy the difference it makes and I wouldn't have believed it had I not read all the reviews like the one I'm entering right now.  There is nothing more annoying than listening to a pump cycle on and off!
summary: My husband thought I was out of my mind for buying this!

reviewText: I installed this with a Whisper King pump and accumulator kit.  I'm not sure of how each of the components performs on their own, all I can confirm, is that when you install the Whisper King, the pump silencing kit and this accumulator, you'll achieve the performance you're looking for and the system is very quiet.  I'm guessing, but I'd say it's more than half as quiet with this set up.

Nothing cooler than the woosh of raindrops sliding up the windshield.  Absolutely hate when the windows get all smeary and blurry.This works great and beats those cloths that they sell at Target and WalMart that always dry up too quick.As long as you have enough light while you're applying and are sure to get all the streaks out, this makes windows crystal clear and amazingly water resistant.Using this after waxing the car, makes all the difference in the world.  If you've ever been concerned on a rainy day next to a truck on the interstate, you need to give this a try.

I've used Rain-X products on and off for years.  While Rain-X does shed water from the windshield as advertised, be advised that it leaves a hazy film on the windshield that produces a glare when illuminated by overhead street lights and on-coming traffic lights, which dangerously impairs vision and the ability to see the road ahead of you.  This is true during daytime driving, but is more so while driving at night, especially as you pass underneath amber-colored street lights.  Once applied, Rain-X is difficult to remove and takes quite a while to wear off by itself.  After a recent windshield replacement, to which I applied Rain-X, I realized just how badly my vision was imparied by using this product.  Glass cleaner didn't seem to work, so to remove the Rain-X, I resorted to a super-concentrated windshield cleaner.  It took several attempts, and a lot of elbow grease, but I eventually was able to remove the product from my windshield.  I tossed the remaining Rain-X products in the trash so my kids won't be tempted to use it on their car windshields.
summary: RAIN-X = WAY TO RUIN A WINDSHIELD.  IMPAIRED VISION FROM GLARE

reviewText: Works as advertised. Works best in heavy rain. Like the other reviewers say, it makes it easier to clean dead bugs off and ice.I keep my car garaged all the time, at work and home and it seems to last forever, at least through one rainy season. I also do the side mirrors and side windows because water can bead up on them too.My only cons is that it's difficult to apply from the bottle and a lot seems to soak up in the towels that I apply my Rain-X with, and it's rather labor intensive to apply. Other than that, it works great during the rainy season. Now they have spray bottles too, so I'd recommend that intead.

Works good at repelling water from windshield. I give it 4 stars just for the fact it doesn't last that long. Seems like you have to reapply every 2 weeks. But after each application does a great job.

I have been using Rain-X for the last 15 years and there is never a time, except for maybe the coldest days of our Boston winters, where my cars don't have a relatively fresh application on the windshields.The key to applying this stuff is to take your time. Use a microfiber cloth or even a paper towel and apply it like wax. It takes a good 4-5 minutes to put on a thorough application. To remove the hazing, just spray on some water and wipe with a fresh microfiber cloth. It works amazing, but don't expect to go "windshield wiper free" unless you are on the highway driving faster than the speed limit tells you is appropriate. However, it helps dramatically with visibility and makes it so light rain isn't as bothersome.Give it a try, it is worth the small price of admission!
summary: Nothing beats Rain-X in the liquid form, use it year-round

reviewText: We have an outdoor security camera with a dome enclosure. When it rained, water would bead up in the middle of the dome - which happened to be the center of the camera lens.I applied this 3 months ago and have had no problems since, the water beads and rolls off the dome.

This stuff is the best example I can think of, of a product that not only works but far exceeded my expectations.  As one reviewer mentioned, it will cause wintertime ice to easily flake off.  Ditto for summertime bug removal.  It repels rain so well that it is a viable alternative to doing an expensive windshield wiper mechanism repair (for those of us that drive old cars).  I work as a highway patrolman (er . . patrolperson) for a living, and quickly learned that windshield wipers tend to lift off of the windshield when when having to drive at 80-90+.  No problem with Rain-X as this is where it works best -- aided by the wind to blow your windshield clear.  MANY TIMES I have driven to a call at high speed, in blinding downpour rain, with my wipers turned off and seeing perfectly (and enjoying my coffee), while other traffic is stopped on the shoulder or crowded in under bridge overpasses (I still can't figure out the purpose of that) due to no visibility. And I find that it lasts for several weeks on a car that is not garaged.  My highest recommendation.  Three thumbs up!  Oops - make that two thumbs up.

If you have an RV with load-range tires that require 80psi, then spend the extra coins for a compressor that is dependable in a roadside emergency.  With the extension air hose there isn't any problem reaching the rear wheels on the trailer.  Think about what your needs are and toss those cheaper cigarette lighter plug-in models.  You get what you pay for.  It was nice that the price was reduced 50% when I purchased this one.

This compressor delivers fast air at continuous operation 100% duty cycle unit is capable of pressures up to 150 PSI continuously without the need to be rested, unlike lower priced compressors that can leave you stranded. I have gone through several other compressors that take long time periods to get your tires up to pressure, if the ever get there without melting down. I have a F350 that we pull a 5th wheel with Class D tires inflate to 80 Lbs. PSI. Many of those compressors fail before achieving that pressure. This is quality equipment right down to the accessories. The connectors, gauges, and inflation gun are my favorites because of quality, ease of use, and accuracy. It's great for my 5th wheel and with the hose I can reach all my tires on the tow vehicle as well as the 5th wheel without  pause.  I often go to my jeep or truck to use these tools instead of the many I have in my shop. Two minor issues Is the rubber shocks on the sand plate I feel should be metal springs because I picture them rotting but they do work very well . Then the oddly shaped  bag is nice, but it's a bag leaving the unit somewhat vulnerable to damage,  from things being placed on top of it in loading, and difficult to pack because of its shape. I know this can happen because my first unit came freight damaged with the quick connector cracked off. A hard case would be more bulky but may be a better alternative and easier to find a place to pack. I have come up with my own fixes to both of those issues. These is a wise investment, and recommend it to 4X4 enthusiasts, and RV'ers.  I hope to share with you my most recent experience (below) how it save me the agony of criticism from my wife and gained approval of my buying my toys. I hope the review was helpful and enjoyable.Here's the scenario. We were out camping in Mammoth lakes, CA with our 5th wheel. One day while we were on a side trip leaving the 5th wheel at camp we visited some of the local natural sites. This day in particular was Obsidian Dome (a huge dome of Volcanic glass). After driving around it we started to explore the adjacent roads. We went to several beautiful areas on good roads with no incident. The final excursion (somehow it's always the last one) we venture down a road leading across the edge of a meadow into some trees.  The road started to get rougher and narrower and felt it prudent to reverse direction in a campward conclusion. The road was to narrow to turn so I back down several hundred feet to a spot I could make a multiple "Y" turn in my 4x4 `02' F350 super cab that has a lousy turn radius. It really becomes more of a "W+" maneuver.  I find a nice clear space and backed up into it successfully and went forward into the opposing bank in effort to re back to change my angle back down the road. Now remember where I am (volcanic region with pumice for soil) and what I am driving ( a monster rv hauling truck with highway tire pressure of 80 lbs PSI). That's the turnaround point comes as well as the wedded bliss starts to crumble, because my front tires sink into 12" of pumice fluff. But no problem I have a Hilift jack and the 4x4 kit (bought at Amazon .COM LLC), but I'm short on chain. So I add a old tow strap into the mix and start to pull out of the holes my tires were spinning in. My wife saw the light at the end of the tunnel and the sun about ready to go behind the mountain. She actually said she would never complain about "My toys I buy".  That lasted for about 5 minutes when the old strap stitching at the hook gave away and the truck rolled back into it's original position. From experience I swiftly said That's OK I can still fix this. I said We need to rethink this. She started mumbling something like she would go to the Bahamas next year. I couldn't help thinking my tire pressure was an issue here so I break out the Viair compressor (bought at Amazon .COM LLC),. She said whats that?, another toy?  I installed the tire valve stem deflators (bought at Amazon .COM LLC),  and took the pressure to 15 lbs.  This is a piece of advice: get her busy picking up bark and stuff to add body to the pumice or sand.  Eureka!  SCORE! The trick did the job and I kept my smartest man in the world status with my lovely red head (the dogs never lost the faith). We got turned around without calling AAA before dark and proceeded down the road to a junction with very good base. Now this is where the compressor comes in. Now I need to reflate the tires to Highway pressure. My experience with other compressors was they will take an immense time to refill and melt down after lengthily operation.  This compressor promises contrary to that and delivers. In fact It seemed to fill just as fast as my 3 hp compressor in my shop. On the same road trip my air lift bag compressor melted down and I was able to manually use this one to fill my bags. Turns out my wife approved the purchases and we will be returning to Mammoth next year. 
summary: Best compressor value by far & helps in domestic disputes.

reviewText: What can I say, this machine is fantastic.  With a 100% duty cycle and check all my tires and fill as needed and not have to wait for it to cool down.  I went and added 5 to 8 lbs to all 4 tires on one car and 2 more on the other.  The motor never even got warm.  The cary bag is great and has lots of room for other small items.  The aire nozle locks onto the valve stem and the gage is failry accurate.  Everything is heavy duty construction.  Should have bought one years ago.  Now it is not as fast as the air pump at the gas stationor the big compresor in my gerage but for a small hand held unit it is fast enogh.  Besides, when I am out in the boonies what is a few minutes to air up over no air at all.

It's nice to have the security of extra air in case of a flat tire.  I bought this for a 9000 mile roadtrip this summer with some friends, not one problem on the trip.  However, the day after returning home I walked out to a flat tire.  I plugged in the compressor and in minutes my 35" tire was full of air and I could drive to the shop to get it repaired.  No waiting for a towtruck to come help out.  Nice.  Solidly built, sturdy little compressor.  I look forward to many years of travel with this little gadget.

Fabulous unit, compact, quiet, powerful, and not too heavy. I cut off the alligator clamps and wired it to a 7-way trailer connector so that I can plug it in to the rear of my truck. 12v is only present when the truck is running so this is a foolproof setup. I like the 100% duty cycle although I do not expect that to be an issue.

I purchased this for use after driving on the beach, allowing me to refill my 32" tires after airing down for sand work.  This thing is QUIET!  You can hold a comfortable conversation while this thing is running.  Comes with a very generous carrying case, and everything you need to use out of the box, with extra air filters included.  I haven't had a chance to try it with any air tools or lockers, but if you need a quick, quality and quiet compressor to fill up your tires after the trail don't hesitate!  This is also best price I could find.

I have a 1993 M35A3 with 6 Michelin 14.5 XLs and a spare.  The CTIS (central tire inflation system) had been disconnected, and the split wheel o-rings need to be replaced.  This means that I have 7 huge tires with slow leaks.  I have the truck in an apartment complex parking lot with no electricity for my big Makita 5hp compressor.  And my honda generator cant crank over the Makita.  I had a little red compressor from VIAR, which was good in the emergency I needed it for, but got so hot in inflating these tires that it melted the yellow hose.The 450P was hooked up to my yellow goodyear hose and Subaru Outback (running), and put to work right out of the box.  It took 5 of these tires from 15 lbs or less to 45 lbs in about 35 minutes.  When you have 13,000 lbs of truck, having tires that roll is critical, because even a wrecker can't move them with deflated tires.  The pump was hot, but the inflating pipe on the compressor runs through the padded handle, which allows you to pick it up when hot.  The gauge has a trigger and a  lever that holds fitting on to the tire valve, which is really handy.  Having a switch vs using the battery clamps to start saves on sparking.I was at a loss as to how I was going to get these tires inflated in remote situations with out a huge generator to run a huge compressor...so this continuous duty 12v pump was very timely.(for those of you who are military truck experts, I am aware the M35A3 has an on board compressor, but there is a blockage somewhere ahead of the 'glad hands.')  The M35A3 is about the largest truck (23,000 lbs gvw) you can drive in NC without a license , and has 7 really big tires to say grace over.  This is not a replacement for a functioning CTIS or a big compressor, but will get even the largest tires inflated and rolling.
summary: Even works on big Army 6x6 tires

reviewText: good towels. fast shipping

The first microfiber cloths I ever used wereMeguiar's Supreme Shine Microfiber Cloths (Pack of 3).  I loved `em.  But I wanted to try the Zwipes since they were so much cheaper per sheet.They arrived in a medium sized box and I was surprised to discover that they filled up the entire box.  There was no other packaging.  So I just continued to use the box to store the Zwipes as I used `em.The Zwipes aren't as big (in surface area) as the Meguiar's.  And they aren't as thick, either.  But they are just as effective at cleaning every last bit of dirt and dust from my car's surface and windows.Surprisingly, the bright colors - yellow, lime and blue - allowed me to use the Zwipes elsewhere in my house.  They work great in cleaning furniture, mirrors, shower doors, sinks, faucets, appliances, counter tops, you name it.  I now use them everywhere.  I also learned to useMeguiar's Ultimate Quik Wax 15.2oz Liquid Spray Bottleto polish the surfaces to a mirror-like shine.  (This spray-on wax has a nice berry-like smell.)  But please don't tell my friends.  It's like my own little secret.As a tip: a big package of 36 microfiber wipes in the traditional yellow/brown color, and just as thick and almost as large as the Meguiar's, are also available at Costco for a very low price.To conclude, I don't know how I lived without microfiber cloths before.  With Zwipes I can now use them everywhere - and I do.  This is a product I highly recommend.  Enjoy.
summary: Not as Big or as Thick as Meguiar's.  But Still Effective.  Use Everywhere

reviewText: little small and skimpy but it gets the job done.Costco towels are better imo for the money but I like the verity of colors.

I like this  microfiber cloth.  They have many uses around the house - for dusting and cleaning up. It works wonders on TV and computer screens. However my favorite use for them is for cleaning the car. They are slightly smaller than another set of microfiber cloths I have, and they work better for washing, applying back-to-black treatment to bumpers, and for apply car wax. I use a larger microfiber tower for drying (where slightly larger and thicker so I can use fewer towels for the job).Another great use I found by them is by sewing two of them together to form a mitt for my window washer. I have a tall SUV and cannot reach across the windshield all the way to clean it. Using the extended reach of the window wash squeegee with a microfiber towel mitt on it gives me streak free window with very little effort. Once the the mitt on the squeegee I tied to the handle with a string to keep it from sliding off. I have one mitt for washing and one mitt for drying.I noticed that the price on the on this product fluctuates. There is a nice online tool that I use to help catch a good price on Amazon, this tool is called  "Online Price Alert".  This tool will send you an email when the Amazon item price reaches the target price range that you specify. If you search on "online price alert" in Google it will be come up at the top.  I find this tool to be very helpful.

You can really use these cloths for anything. I use them in the kitchen to wipe hands instead of wasting paper towels. I also use them on my car. The quality is good and they hold up to washing with no problem. I've seen one of these in the auto store for $5 each. Good deal here.

Had a dozen microfiber cloths for many years but until recently did not know how much more I could be using them.  These Zwipes are far less expensive than any brand, anywhere and the finest quality.You will have them forever and be able to share such a large package.Great value!Use for furniture, bathrooms, appliances, jewelry, shoes, woodwork, upholstery etc.  And if you wish, no cleaning solution is needed, just dampen; and then dry off with another cloth.Update:  Just ordered another big batch of these cleaning cloths as more and more friends and family wish to try.  So it is shared and then they can purchase their own 'stash'!
Good product to clean my car. Fiber is nice and really cleans anything on the surface. Also absorb water well.

I purchased these for my husband who washes cars and he said that he needed more so I ordered eurow microfiber premium 16x16 350 gsm 36 pack from amazon just to try something different and he loves the eurow's brand better because they are a lot thicker and made of better quality material and is cheaper than zwipes. While zwipes still gets the job done they are better for using on glass. Where as eurow is better for removing polish or wax off the vehicle.
summary: These are ok but eurow's brand is way better.

reviewText: These cloths are a great value, but they could be better.  If the manufacturer would take the proper finishing steps, this would be a super product.  Mine came with a lot of "fuzz" and stray bits of material on the cloths (shake one and see) and a faint chemical residue smell.  If these had been washed/rinsed before packaging, they would be super, as it is, I suggest running these through a cold water wash cycle once or twice before using them.For anyone wondering, these are the coarse micofiber style for general purpose cleaning, not the fine microfiber such as used for cleaning cameras and lenses.  Fine for LCD screens, TV screens and such, though.  A good choice to pack with your laptop.A good cleaning cloth at a fair price.---------------------------------------------Update: 2011-11-19 Upped my rating to 4 stars as these cloths have held up well and I use them a lot for daily cleaning.  Just be sure to wash before first use!
summary: Good value, have held up well.

reviewText: I have bought 2 boxes of these now.  I gave half of the box to my dad and he likes them too.  I replaced paper napkins with these microfiber from now on.  I just wash them and they are good for round two.  Use them to clean my truck after I polish.

I use these mainly when waxing my car, as then buff to a great shine without leaving any lint, and the car wax I use seems to wash out cleanly.The size is good, and overall they feel comfortable in your hand. Never known one to leave lint, and they seem to hold up well to repeated washings. Still, I'm not the type who feels comfortable "washing" my car with one of these and a little water - but that doesn't mean I won't use them to apply/remove wax.Great product at a fair price...definitely recommended.

These are great universal use microfiber cloths. I wouldn't use them on the exterior of my car, or even the interior, but that's because I'm OCD. I would use them on everything else though for sure (and I do). For the price and quality it's hard to beat. Far superior to the ones you would find at w-mart or t-get. The tag removes cleanly, no rough spots to scratch really, they clean well in a washer, and so far have lasted several washes with plenty of life left in them.

reviewText: I love microfiber.  It's wonderful.  You can use it for just about anything.  Clothing, upholstery, bedding, cleaning cloths - it's everywhere now and there's a good reason.  It's incredibly soft, sturdy, and absorbent.  There are variations in quality though.  For all-purpose cloths, these are a great deal, and you stock up to boot.  These cloths don't look that sturdy, but they are.  Keep a dozen in the kitchen, you may never buy paper towels again.  You can clean just about anything with them.  There are better cloths for polishing glass, but these will work.  They're also good for dusting off your keyboard.  Why don't you do that right now?  It probably needs it.These would make a good practical gift for any teen or adult.Update:  2014  I'm still using my original package of 36.  Some have got quite thin, but I haven't needed more for myself.  I've re-purchased and gifted new packs to several people.  OK, they didn't look thrilled at first, but once they started using them, they fell all over themselves thanking me.ZWIPES gets the rare and envied HB seal of approval.  I consider this one of, if not the best purchase I've ever made on Amazon.  Two wings up!

I'm not sure if praising cleaning towels means having Manly Points deducted, but these little towels are amazing.  Extremely versatile, they can be used for everything from washing the car without risking micro scratches on the paint to washing dishes.  They're reusable, of course, so make much more sense than wasteful paper towels.  Microfiber cloth is electrostatic by nature and so attracts dust like a magnet. Their design also allows them to be effective in removing many types of dirt without the use of any additional chemicals making them safer for use especially with households that have infants and children or persons with allergies or hypersensitivity to chemicals. They're more absorbent than a sponge and since you're more likely to toss them in the washing machine than a kitchen sponge, they're much more sanitary, since the kitchen sponge is said to be the most germ infested location in the entire house. Even the multiple colors they arrive in is a plus if you want to designate one color for car use, one for kitchen only and one for misc. cleaning.  As with any fabric product, it's always a good idea to do an initial laundering before using them to dry or clean anything food or kitchen related. Don't use fabric softener, though, when washing them as the oils in those products will clog the microfibers and reduce the cloth's effectiveness. It might be noted that microfiber is made from synthetic materials that are petrochemical based and so are not biodegradable and can emit toxins when burned. Also, towels used on sensitive surfaces like your car's paint, should kept separate for that use only, since other applications might embed particles in the fibers and make micro-scratches more likely. This is one high tech product that really makes many low tech chores a lot easier and more effective.
summary: Even Vince from Sham-wow prefers them!

reviewerName: Jeri Zerr "formerly a Road Warrior of the Nth...
reviewText: I had been hearing about microfiber cleaning cloths, but I finally decided to give them a try when replacement pads for our spray mop were unreasonably high. I am sold!  I cut the cloths in half, they stick perfectly well to our Libman Freedom spray mop.  Better yet, they have so many other uses!Initially I assigned them to various tasks by color code. Yellow were assigned to personal care, green for windows and mirrors and blue for grimier tasks.  Eventually as the cloths become somewhat worn, I cut them in half then they are dedicated to the spray mop.  If I need to use a smaller cloth, I just cut them in half "early" and keep them separate from the floor cloths until they are "worn" a bit and ready to be reassigned to care for our floors. As the final step I use the most worn microfiber cloths for cleaning the toilet, once they've bit the dust they are then discarded. I've already saved more than the cost of these wipes since we no longer use nearly as many paper towels.  They are super easy to rinse out - dirt and grime wash away, fur and hair sometimes need some encouragement to "release" from the microfiber. The cloths do really well in our HE washer.  Since it spins them so thoroughly we just hang to dry and they're ready for their next cleaning task.  Never use fabric softener, it will ruin the "microfiber grabbing power" of the cloths.Did I mention windows and mirrors?  We make a solution of 5 parts white vinegar, 5 parts water and 2 parts alcohol (rubbing alcohol or vodka) to clean our windows and mirrors (it also makes a great all purpose cleaning solution!) This solution works very well with these microfiber cloths, in fact now we no longer use nearly as much of our spray solution if I start with an already slightly damp microfiber cloth. I will definitely buy again when we need more microfiber cloths.
summary: GREAT cleaning cloths!  They are excellent for personal care, cleaning our home, our vehicles, and even windows and glass!
