summary: Did what it supposed to do.

reviewText: I truly believe that Meguiars could get away with charging double the price and I would still pay for this great compound.  But let's keep that between you and I.  I primarily use this compound when I have minor to moderate swirls that do not require the use of a more aggressive compound such as the Meguiars Professional Compound M105.If you are an amateur and don't know much about polishing and want to play it safe then this is the compound that I would recommend.  I will not cause swirls like the M105 as it is not nearly as abrasive.  When used with a dual action polisher this product will yield incredible results as a stand-alone product.  I also use this compound on clear plastics to remove LIGHT oxidization from headlights and finally this product also works quite well on some metals.I always follow up my polishes with a more gentle polish (why not, you're already doing it anyway) and I would recommend their ultimate polish in combination with the meguiars soft buff finishing pad and the final result is incredible depth and a brilliant smooth swirl free finish when done properly.Tips:  I strongly advise first and most importantly a THOROUGH wash of all components to be polished followed by a contamination removal (clay barring) to remove imbedded contaminants prior to polishing.  No sense taking the risk of doing more harm than good with your buffer and driving those contaminants deeper into the paint therefore creating more scratches and swirls than you are removing.  ALWAYS follow up your polish with no less than a Carnuba wax or better yet a Sealant wax such as Meguiars NXT or better yet Meguiars professional polymer sealant.
summary: a great compound at a very reasonable price...

reviewText: Car need a good cleanup to shine?  Use this.  I have a black Lexus and when used, its amazing how much of the hairline scratches go away and how deep and glossy the black ends up.  Follow up with their NXT Generation Tech Wax 2.0 and the shine and depth come out even more.  Looks like it just came out of a paint shop.
This stuff works. For tuff spots, and faded areas, you can't beat it. Easy to use, even in sunlight. Can't be without it.

This came highly recommended so I picked up a bottle to remove the many swirls in the hood of my dark blue car.  I used a buffer and applied only a small amount to the pad.  Did one application, polished it off and viola!  No more swirls and a return of the new car shine.  Simple to use and it works very well.  Another great Mequiar's product.

paired with the DA and the correct pad, this compound will cut, and ready your paint for LSP. I've used 3 bottles up till tis day and my customers are all happy with the result. UC will remove mild oxidation, minor scratches and swirls yet it leaves a glossy finish to your paint. Don't forget to clean your pad after few passes and DO work only in 2 x 2 sections or smaller and do not let it dry! this is a compound, not a gloss wax. follow up with the UP and seal with your favorite wax. I just wished i could share pictures here. for under 10 bucks, it's a steal.

I like the way this compound cuts, just enough to get the dirt and debris out of the paint or clearcoat. Used with Meguiar's W 9207 7" Soft Buff 2.0 Foam Finishing Pad and Meguiar's Professional Dual Action Polisher. It sure beats doing it by hand.

Great for removing fine scratches, however it doesn't do anything with swirls.Car finish looks the same after use... maybe because my car finish isn't that neglected?I guess it doesn't work well with my Tri-coat paint.

I can't say enough about how incredible this polish is. Used it on the paint of a 20 year old Lexus and it was insane at how pearly the white paint became after rubbing this on and off. This isn't any kind of substitute for a clay bar and I'll definitely need to do that when I have the time to remove that nasty gritty feel of all the crap and debris thats collected on the paint, but this polish works wonders on old paint to make it shine like new. Throw on a wax after and you're golden.

This is the first compound I've ever used on my car and it has done a pretty good job, I must say. I have a 2007 Mazda3 4-door in Galaxy Grey, which has mostly been repainted due to 2 accidents and 1 mishap on the interstate which involved some sort of debris in the road that caused $2,500 in damage, all of which was just paint and a damaged headlight and mirror cover. Anyway, my car just has the basic swirl marks from washing, nothing too crazy. The roof of my car had some water spots and cat scratch marks and this compound seemed to greatly diminish the appearance of these flaws. But once I applied wax after the fact, it came off so smoothly than ever before, so I could tell something worked. Also, my front bumper was peppered with white marks from driving the interstate daily and had some other scratches from when a huge chunk of tire hit my car. I concentrated the compound in that area, used a lot of elbow grease, and I swear, my bumper pretty much looks almost new. It just looks so much cleaner now. And if you're like me and try to keep your car looking its best, this will definitely help. I have an arsenal of waxes, clay bars and spray lubricants and I now have this compound to make my car looks that much better. I will definitely purchase this in the future.I gave it 4 out of 5 stars because the compound didn't seem to have much effect on the hood with light swirl marks. Maybe I just didn't put enough time into it, but I'm sure I'll go back to that area and if the results change, I'll update my review.Update: 7/3/12 My car paid a visit to Mazda service for a couple new door handles and the service writer complimented the shine on the car. I can definitely tell this compound has added way more depth to the paint's gloss... even though I've thoroughly clay-barred the car and waxed it previously. This product can remove swirls and water spots on paint and glass. reviewText: This works well for taking small blemishes off of your clear coat. It must be used properly and not left on like a wax. Will not make for a miracle on something with oxidation all over it. But will make a slightly older finish look new again. Use the polish for a top coat and then wax and it will look great.

reviewText: My car is a 13 year old sedan.  I used to wash and wax my cars regularly, but let this one go for probably 6-7 years.  The paint lost its shine, and I ended up using this product along with a Porter-Cable orbital polisher to bring the shine back to the car's finish.I hadn't restored an oxidized finish before, so I had a lot of concerns going in to this - whether this compound was abrasive enough or if I needed one of the heavy cut products, whether I'd need a milder polishing compound after using this to improve the finish, whether I could do it by hand or if I needed to purchase a polisher, etc.  I learned about using a clay bar, but decided that was a step too far for a 13 year old sedan like mine.Meguiar's Ultimate Compound was strong enough to remove the paint's oxidation and restore the shine when used with the orbital polisher.  I needed to go over some areas a few extra times to remove some discoloration, but I believe this product is very safe for the paint and I never had the feeling that good paint was being polished off.Also, after using this compound I went straight to a polish to protect the new finish.  There was no need for using a less-abrasive compound to improve the finish.Very happy with this polishing compound.  It is a one-step, novice-proof product that will cut moderate oxidation and bring back the shine.  Personally, I tried to apply this by hand, and found that I couldn't achieve what I wanted without the power of an orbital polisher.
I use the full ultimate 3-step after a iron-x and a clay bar about 2 times per year (mid summer and right after winter)Just enough cut to get swirls out without taking too much clear off

I have always trusted Meguiars products.  I have a Obsidian Lexus.  I use this product with a Griots Garage 6" DA polisher. It takes out light swirls and scratches and makes the car ready for wax. reviewText: I have bought several of these for my car. I absolutely love this stuff. At first i was afraid to try it and didn't think it would work but boy was i wrong. It is a very easy way to give your car a show room look. I apply this after washing my car. All you need is a good microfiber cloth. Spray and polish with the cloth and it gives it a instant shine. I found this product work as advertised, however it dried very quickly and was difficult to remove at times.  I applied with Porter Cable polisher and it helps to mark your pad so you knows its spinning. I purchased this after reading rave reviews in several different forums and websites. The reviewers were right. This product does exactly what it is intended to do. It's perfect for compounding a vehicle in need of paint correction. If you have swirls and light scratches, then this is what you use if you want to eliminate them. For those that use off the shelf waxes at the auto store (as I used to do), they only temporarily cover up the swirls, they do not remove them. I spent close to 30 hours researching how to properly do paint correction and this was one of the most hyped compounding polishes out there from the pros.I started by using a clay bar and clay lubricant on my car to remove the contaminants in the clear coat that even the M105 won't pull out. Then after washing the car, I used a Porter Cable DA polisher (also purchased here on Amazon) to compound the car's surface with the appropriate pad (typically orange). I worked in 2 foot by 2 foot sections and used cross hatch patterns to assure even coverage. This really brought out a lot of shine and this isn't even the polishing stage yet! It wouldn't pull out one heavier scratch that I have, but it made quick work of the smaller scratches and completely removed the swirl marks. Keep in mind that this is an abrasive. You don't want to use this every time you detail your car because it removes a very small amount of the clear coat. You should hopefully only have to use this once to correct the issues then you can maintain the paint from there.I then used Meguiar's M205 to polish the car, again using the DA but this time with a white pad designed for polishing This is what brings out the shine! It's like wood working.. you start with a rougher 120 grit to get the majority of the roughness out, then move up to a less aggressive 240 grit sandpaper to smooth it out even more. These products are simply liquid sandpaper - one has more grit and the other has less. One does the dirty work, the other finishes it offFor what it's worth, I then followed up the polishing with 2 coats of sealant and 2 coats of Carnuba wax. The before and after is simply amazing and that's saying a lot because the car I did all of this on is yellow, not a color known for high gloss and reflection quality like you see on darker carsHighly recommended!

reviewText: works well and its great to get swirls out of my black car. I use it with the meguiar's finishing pad and Porter Cable orbital buffer.

Meguiar's 205 is a versatile tool that should be in every detailer's arsenal.  This product can be used in a variety of situations, and is suitable for use by hand, dual action polisher (random orbital), or by rotary.It should be noted that Meguiar's Ultimate Polish is based on the same technology and formulation as this product.  Ultimate Polish has more polishing oils, but less abrasives.  If your paint is already in great shape, Ultimate Polish would be the better product to use due to the higher oil content.  M205 has more cutting ability, and will therefore have more restorative power to your paint finish.  Unfortunately, M205 is also more expensive.M205 is a professional caliber Meguiar's product that is used to remove fine swirls or haze from paint.  M205 is very rich in polishing oils, and should be used as the final step before waxing in order to great a high reflection, high gloss shine on the paint.  This product features SMAT -- super micro abrasive technology.  This is a huge improvement over older diminishing abrasive polishes.SMAT technology involves the use of aluminum oxide particles in suspension that are extremely tiny, hence the term micro abrasive.  As you polish, these particles help strip off dead oxidized paint and boost the clarity of the finish.  Older diminishing abrasives products must be worked sufficiently to break down the abrasives into smaller and smaller particles until they are "all gone."  The problem with these types of products is that if they are not worked in sufficiently, they will create a haze on the paint or even instill swirls.SMAT technology polishes can be worked for any length of time, as the abrasives do not change or break down over time.  This makes this polish much more user friendly than older polishes.The proper use of 205 falls under two categories:1) Using as a follow up to a product like M105 (an extremely aggressive cutting compound).  M105 can sometimes leave hazing in the finish.  M205 on a polishing pad will clear this right up.2) Using less for the cutting power and more for the finishing characteristics of the product.  This would be done on a less aggressive (jeweling) pad and likely with less speed and pressure than as a follow up product.The M105/M205 product combo is probably the most well-respected on the market.  No detailer should be without this stuff.  If you are just starting out, take a look at Ultimate Polish.  Its' about half the price, and the higher oil content will make it easier to use.  Higher oil levels will allow the product to be worked onto the paint longer without drying out.
summary: One of the best polishes available -- at any price.

reviewText: It doesn't matter what you've been using to prep your surface, one needs to put the final polish on their big surfaces such as their hood and the tops of the fenders as these are the surfaces that people look at and get the most attention when people are checking out your polishing effort.There is a bit of splatter with this product so set your speed at two or three and make sure you smear the product around on your hood before turning the buffing wheel on.  Under the wiper blades, I found there to be a minimum of splattering on the windshield plastic and what little dried material there was to be found, easily cleaned up with a damp drying towel.This product easily distributes on a prepared surface and a primed buffing pad will spread this product over a large area.  Of course, as always, this is a product that needs to be applied in the shade to prevent premature drying of the product as it's being worked.After grinding on your flat panel surfaces, this is the product one wants to follow-up with to put the final polish on the surfaces that everybody sees.  Whether one preps their paint surface with "Ultra Cut Compound" or "Medium-Cut Cleaner," one "NEEDS" to follow up with this product and a soft sponge rotary cleaning pad to bring out the best in their paint.The look of satisfaction one gets when removing this product's haze is wonderful......now one can apply the final wax or sealant in good faith, knowing they've done their best to bring out a deep, health paint shine.Considering how much we spend on buffing machines, pads, washes, micro cloths, rubber rejuvenators and tire cleaners, this is not an expensive product and if using for daily appearances of the upper large panels like the hood and fender tops, using this product on a regular basis, this product will last a long time; in my opinion, very cost effective.

I bought the Jeep Wrangler Slush Mats for my 2012 Jeep Wrangler 4 door and I love the way they look!  They are heavy duty and stay in place.  I shopped around for floor mats, worried that I wouldn't find what I was looking for and I am so glad that I bought these.  I could not have found a better floor mat and/or a better product!

I bought these to go in a 2012 Wrangler Unlimited (Rubi). The back seat mat took a few days to "relax" and conform to the curvature of the floor. The front mats still seem to be "bulging" and not laying flat against the floorboards. Hopefully, they will relax with time as well. I don't really have a pre-2011 Wrangler to check the fit in, but the cutouts for the transmission bump don't seem designed for the 2011+, preventing the mats from laying flat. I know they're properly lined up, due to the anchor hooks on the floorboard being in place.They did go on a recent camping trip that turned-out to be fairly rainy, and they did what they were supposed to do; trapping all the dirt, mud and debris. Their visual appeal is definitely an upgrade from the stock mats that came with the vehicle and friends have commented on their cool factor. I haven't popped the top and doors yet to see if they stay in place at moderate speed. They aren't as heavy as I expected. I know the factory mats in the back seat wanted to take flight anytime I went over 35 mph.I like the fact that they're Mopar and Jeep branded, but will always wonder if I should have gone withRugged Ridge 12987.01 Black Front and Rear Floor Liner Kitor Quadratec mats (Rugged Ridge rebadged) for a better fit. I "think" that these are made in the USA, which is a plus, but not quite sure.

Product shipped fast and arrived well packaged.  I like the look and fit although I wish the mats were a little deeper and wider. The price also seems high to me but that is a mopar problem not a product problem. Overall I'm happy with the purchase and think they look great in our JKU.

The boost is setting is smoother than on the Prodigy, and the controller works very well with my trailer.  The only problem I found was that while the controller works quite well in the nearly vertical position, the display is designed to be most visible when it is close to horizontal and in the near vertical position the lower portion of the digits is difficult to see.  This however is pretty minor, and the quality and function of the controller makes up for it.
worked well. towing a 6000lb+ travel trailer. easy to use and easy to adjust. wiring was a snap. factory wiring has color code on all the wiring.

This is one AWESOME brake controller!!  Easy to install, easier to set up to your liking, and testing the brakes before you roll allows you to adjust each day as needed.  I also like the "Boost" function to be there just in case I find myself going down that big hill in the rain and having to stop in a hurry.  This is a plug and play controller!!I have not hooked up a brake controller since the 80's when I had to tap into the hydralic lines of the tow vehicle.  Tekonsha has made this ridiculously easy.  Choose your brake controller, find the correct adapter, 5 minutes later it is hooked up and ready to go.  This is one impressive company to make this so easy!!Aug 01 2013 Update.  Took the 31' RV from San Antonio all the way to Jacksonville Fl., down to Key West, and back the Western edge of Florida all the way back home.  Wonderful trip and NO PROBLEMS with braking thanks to this great controller.Do yourself a favor, spend just a little more and get a great controller you will not have to worry about being there when you really need it...

Have made a trip to Kentucky and back and Chicago and back without a problem. Hopefully these are the last set I ever have to buy. Very happy with purchase and fast ship from Amazon.
summary: This is the bumper cap you want

reviewText: These work great on our travel trailer...normally they stay put and do not fall out...but we had one come loose somewhere??? So needed to get a couple of replacements.
So far after 1 season of camping these caps have been holding on. Just remember you need to order 2 as they are sold individually.

This is a great idea for you square RV bumper end cap. Just put it into the end and push the center of the cap to make it expand into place. Mine feels a little loose inside the bumper but after a couple road trips it's still holding.  We'll see.
Have not tried until we go camping.  I think it will be better than the original equipment.  Will update later.

The bumper plugs that came with my camper kept coming loose and falling out. Found these on Amazon for cheaper than on sale at Camping World and my problem was solved. These never come loose and are easy to remove and replace.
Thick, heavy duty rubber construction.  No screws or brittle plastic to worry about.  Slides right into the boxed bumper end.  Should keep those hoses in places.

I like this tool better than the ones without the long nose.  This extra reach makes it a lot easier to use in tight spaces (where I most commonly use zip ties) without having to position the ties just right.  The adjuster has a pretty wide range, though it does take a while to turn it all the way from one end to the other.  Works reliably and smoothly.

My brother undertook the task of fencing our garden area with hardware cloth covered by aluminum screen to keep both rabbits and grass clippings out of the area.  I'd purchased a lot of zip ties for the project and spotted this little tool while doing so.Since the reviews indicated it was worthwhile and the price was so reasonable, I decided to add it to my order.My brother had never used one of these tools before and said it took a few tries to get the hang of using it, but it saved him a lot of time and effort.  Definately worth having on hand for those jobs that require using more than a couple of zip ties.

It'll take forever to crank it down to a decent tension. Other than that, it works very well - I used this on a good number of zip-ties this weekend (hard to access areas), and it pulled them in tight, and cut them perfectly, every time. It even works on metal zip-ties, as well - but only sometimes. Sometimes the teeth will grip the metal, sometimes it won't.Still a great product though, and I'll be holding on to it for future use!
received this today and had to use it to finish off a job I had been doing and it worked great worked just like they said it would. It seems to be well made so it should last a long time.

I use to tighten my zip ties like everybody else with a pliers and cut with a wire cutter. This tool does the job of those 2 tools. and does it well. One can cut the excess tie as short as one wishes. Price is good . I give this tool 5 stars.This is an update the second and third time I used it the cutter after tightening the plastic tie, cut the tie too close that the tie fell out. I will maintain the 5 stars. I probably have to adjust my technique.This is an update. This gadget actually works well. I hand tight the plastic tie as much as I can then use this tightener and I make sure that the ridged part of the plastic tie is engaged to the tightening mechanism of the tightener.
the pliers are awesome for removing plug wires on a hot motor. just be careful no to burn yourself recommend

Trying to extract the spark plug boots from the plugs on my 5.3L, '01 Suburban, I found the plier grips are too far apart to get a good hold on the end of the boot. Trying to reach the boots is awkward enough, then trying to keep a good pressure on the grips is not easy and i have large hands. But they work okay in the easier locations, such as the two front plugs on the driver side. But the plugs have never been changed in its 160k miles and 12 year old life. So the boots are stuck pretty tight. The pliers are well made, just need the grips made a little closer. A better design would be to have an ability to tighten a clamp on the end of the boot or metal shield that would have the holding power while pulling to dislodge the boot. The spaces around the plugs are just to tight for hand gripping.
An excellent tools to reach those hard to get plug wires.It will also minimize any risk of pulling older wire from the boot.
summary: Great tools to get to those hard to reach plug wires

reviewText: Reaches the back plug on my Ford Ranger with little trouble. Simple, straightforward tool for every tinkerer's garage. Happy to see it's made in this country.

It made it much easier to replace my spark plugs and for the price, it's well worth it. I was using a pair or regular pliers but they would often damage the spark plug wire. That is not a good thing if you are just replacing or checking the spark plugs. It is not perfect, due to the shape and size I was not able to reach one of my spark plugs to pull the wire off. I have not found any tool that could do that yet...
Allows you to get a proper grip on the leads and not burn your fingers on the exhaust headers !On the LS2 I work with the plug caps nearly touch so this is a winners.
summary: No more burnt fingers or pulled boots.

reviewText: Luckily I had this set of pliers when my Lisle 51250 puller broke on me.  The only downfall to this tool is that the rubber handles slide loose.  I think I will need to add some adhesive into the rubber handles and slide them back on and see if that helps.It would be a bit ergonomically-friendly if the handles were round like regular pliers.  These are very flat, thus being a lot more sharp on the edges.
Cheap little mod that is cool. Took me 20 minutes in a freezing garage to install. I did notice as the weather got colder the ram went a little slower, but thats to be expected.

This took all of about 5 minutes to install.  The kit comes complete with thread lock and install tool for the proprietary rivet like wedge that installs in the tailgate hole.  Be cognizant of the install tool and the directions.  Do not over tighten the wedge or it will strip.  I did not have any problems, but I can definitely see how other people will over do it on the calibrated elbow.  Follow the directions and mark the nut and do not turn the allen key.  Only turn it 9 complete 360 degree revolutions.  Great product and now I can just unlatch the hitch and will free fall slowly.  Thanks Dee Zee for a great product.  (Will also fit with aftermarket taillight guards)
summary: Great addition and super easy install

reviewText: The kit has been updated as other recent posters have indicated.  The upper plate the shock mounts to is different and works perfectly.  No issues with washers not fitting, etc.  Installation is a breeze and so far the shock is perfect and the tailgate drops without any thud at the bottom.I am completely happy and would absolutely recommend this product.2012 F150 FX4
Not sure why these don't come stock!!!  Extremely helpful when you have your hands full.  Tailgate drops slowly and predictably.

This is a must have item for any pickup truck!  Face it, today's pickup trucks have heavy tailgates.  Trucks are being used by everyone in the family too.  My wife has trouble opening the tailgate when running to Lowes or Homedepot.  It's too heavy for her.  So I got on the net and did some research and found the DeeZee Tailgate Assist.  Hands down this is the best 30 bucks I've spent on my pickup.  It is worth every single cent!!!  Now my tailgate on my 2013 Supercrew opens with 1 finger and slowly opens wide nice and gentle.  Installation is pretty straight forward.  The directions and illustrations are accurate.  The kit even includes the right sized torx (star bit) wrench!  It does need a 13mm wrench but a small/med crescent wrench will do just fine.  No issues with the unit pinching or crimping the support cables.  They must have done a redesign because this device does not relocate your support cable at all.  It just requires you to remove it inorder to put a flat piece that mounts the assist piston.  Then you re-secure the OEM cable support mount back on the truck.  Nothing changes in relation to how or the location of the OEM cable supports. It is incredibly easy to install on the 2013 F150 Supercrew.  It took me longer to walk to the beer fridge and get a fresh cold one.I don't plan on buying another pickup anytime soon.  But if I do, this item will be the first thing I get for any new truck I buy.  Yes... it really is that great.
summary: A Must Have For Your Pickup!

reviewText: the tailgate does weigh a ton. I have installed a master lock and this both from Amazon. The directions were not that good. I used the comments from a few other users to get it installed correctly. After the install it worked like the ads. Nice. Again 5 star product with a 3 start install guide. Also the Nut-insert thing could be improved. Overall if you have a newer truck that has back up camera, man step, etc. you need this.
summary: now my 2013 F150 tailgate is complete.

reviewText: I bought this item and it installed easily and worked well.  All of the parts were there and I am glad I bought it.One caution though.  On my 2006 Dodge Ram 2500 Diesel the tail gate has a cable installed on both sides to hold the tail gate in the level position when down.  The install instructions tell you reinstall this cable on the same side as the tailgate assist after you replace the required parts.  There is a rubber grommet that goes on this cable to keep in in a safe position when you close the tailgate.  I found that this rubber grommet did not work well and once when I closed my tailgate the cable got caught between the tailgate and my tail light and cracked the tail light.  What I did was remove this cable and relied on just the other cable on the right side and the Tailgate Assist on the left side to hold the tailgate in the open position.  I have done this for the past 2 years with no problems and have stood on the tailgate several times.  Just my solution.
summary: Great item but one word of caution

reviewText: Everyone seems to have issues with the countersink, but if you have any mechanical inclination an basic hand tools it can be done in about 10 min. Works really well too. I keep forgetting I have it and surprising myself when it works and I don't have I drop what I'm holding to slow the gate down
summary: Really easy to install if your at all intelligent

reviewText: this thing is simply awesome.  not to mention so simple and easy to install.  another thing i had to buy that should be standard on all trucks.
Easy install.  This should be stock on all Rams.  Makes 100% easier when your hands are full.  Tailgate lowers slowly.

the idea of this is fantastic! The directions are very plain and not the well laid out. The first step of install is confusing. Maybe this is not the right model for my truck but per Amazon "check if it fits" it is supposed to work. I cannot get it to tighten right or even start the install properly. I went to youtube to find a video, i watched and then tried the install again. Still it wont work. I plan on calling them tomorrow to talk to customer service we will see how that goes. If they assist me with installation i will comeback and update my review.

For ANY pick up truck owner - this will be the best money you have EVER spent on gear EVER!!This little thing is hands down an unreal item what enables you to do so much with hands free without dropping a hefty tail gate on something or crushing your fingers in the process! I can't over emphasize enough how awesome this item is and for the price it is worth EVERY RED CENT!Thank you Dee Zee and Amazon!

in fact you can push the tailgate up halfway and let go - it will stay there for a few seconds then slowly drop back down.  we had it installed at a garage... note you need one of those star screwdrivers to install (at least on a dodge) - we have 08 3500 ram
it makes opening the gate very easy and I am thinking to keep one extra in case something happened but my only comment is that it needs thinner washer or shim because it scratches the paint.

We have a 2009 Dodge Ram which we use primarily as our ski-trip vehicle. One of the things is when you are walking back to the car with skis and poles in your hand and you need to set the tailgate down. Normally it's a struggle to prevent dropping the tailgate with a bang (or dropping your skis or poles on the ground and having to bend over in ski boots to pick them up).Same goes if you have your hands full when approaching the truck.So for fathers day I bought and installed one of these, and it's great. Now we just walk up to the truck, pull the handle, and the tailgate opens smoothly and nicely - no thud or bangs. The tailgate falls to about 45* right away and then lowers over the next 5 seconds or so. It has worked fine in both very hot and very cold temperatures.Another advantage is less scratches on your tailgate, since you are touching it less because you don't have to baby-sit it down.Install was a breeze. I took my time and it took me 15 minutes. You could get it done in about 5 minutes if you really wanted.I don't think we'll ever own a truck without one of these now.
summary: Awesome must have for your truck!

reviewText: Anyone with a full-sized pickup tailgate should have one of these.  All trucks should have these from the factory.
I installed exactly as the directions said and I have a rubbing issue. I fixed that by using washers. Great product makes lowering the tailgate smooth and easy.
Large, absorbent, and of high quality. For the price you won't find anything better. Since this is a waffle weave towel it won't leave little fibers on the car, either.
There is a lot of towel there for the money. I'm glad I bought 2. If I ever need to buy something to get free shipping, This is it.

A VERY SKINNY TOWEL THAT HOLDS A LOT OF WATER.  I USE IT TO GET ABOUT 95 PERCENT OF THE WATER OFF OF MY VEHICLES.  I THEN FINISH THEM OFF WITH 2 SMALLER MEGUIARS TOWELS THAT I'VE HAD FOR MANY YEARS.  IF YOU USED 2 OF THESE YOU COULD DRY YOUR VEHICLE COMPLETELY WITH NO PROBLEM.

Roughly 3 feet square (39x33.5") this is a decent quality towel.  A few loose fibers, but nothing to speak of.  Seems to be of good quality and as the other reviews attest, eminently suitable for the job of drying a car, boat, or similar.  The price seems fair to me and the quality seems good.  I recommend washing by hand.  Do NOT use fabric softener or bleach as that will ruin it.  Good quality at a fair price = 4 stars.
This works amazing for drying your car! It literally soaks up all the water when you glide it over your finish! The size of it lets you dry at least 2 cars quickly! I would never go back to a shammy!

I noticed other reviews on here with snagging problems, I have come across the same problem. It does a really good job at getting all the water off of my vehicle. Fairly nice towel though and a good price.

Nothing beats this drying towel in terms of absorbency, size and price. Previous towels I had were armorall chamois, meguiars waffle weave and duragloss. The duragloss i had was excellent but pricey. When using the Viking, do be careful of the towel's criss-cross fiber threads that run across your car as you wipe it down. They may get stuck at edges, corners, wipers and rubber linings of the car. Do NOT tug at the cloth any further as this may cause a hole in your towel as the threads become dislodged.
summary: Very absorbent and huge drying cloth but note the fiber threads

reviewText: I was a tad hesitant to buy a "lesser name brand" towel, as I had purchased some of the Chinese crappy ones off eBay and they are not worth using as toilet paper!!The Viking works as well as the $9-$10 towels that are much smaller. They do not induce any swirls or scratches if you know to not grind the trimmed edges into the paint.When I eventually wear these out, I'll buy more, but, that won't be very often as they have held up quite well so far.
summary: As good as the best for much less

reviewText: Was amazed , how well it dries the car. I bought two of these one for a gift.Does very well on a Black SUV with chrome. And a Sports Car too. From reading about it "getting snagged", I never had that problem. Does the job better than some other more costly ones. I hope this helps.

This towel has a lot of absorbing area.Does a great job of taking the water off.I would recommend this towel for anyonewho wants to dry their car quickly and streak free.Show Car Guys 3 - Pack of Ultra Yellow Plush Microfiber Towels 16" X 24 "- At 360 GSM This Is the Ultimate Microfiber Cleaning Cloth-this Big Ultra Plush Has Micro Fiber Material on One Side - The Other Side Consists of Medium Terry Microfiber Material.

this is my fist time using a waffle type microfiber towel, this beets the crap out of normal microfiber towels. It works great, i use it with detailing spray and also to dry off my car. There is one thing that is a problem for me and that is it's big, 3 foot square. So I borrowed my moms zig zag sewing machine and sewed two lined down the middle of the towel and cut between the sewing lines which made me two smaller towels. I have tried the waffle towel you can get at target but there is no comparison, this is much better.

Have been using old towels but for my new car wanted to not use the silicon water remover blade.  This was recommended and works great.  Also purchased a blower designed to remove water.  It works for the wheels and mirrors but not the body surface, just not large enough.  This large drying cloth works perfect for those areas.

these suck up lots of water....lots! i would recommend them for anyone who ewashes the car alot, and hates drying it off.  these make the job much easier and quicker.  keep two handy and you will never use a towel again.

I bought this towel while looking for a cheaper alternative to my Cobra and Chemical Guys drying towels.  The search goes on.  I have washed this towel countless times and it still leaves blue fibers all over my car.  It also isn't all that absorbent.
Bought a few of these for drying the family fleet when we are done washing. The work well and drink up the water. After a few washes I just throw them into the wash and they're ready to go again.

I actually bought it for my motorcycle and must not have paid to much attention to the size that was listed.  It reminds me of this "Big Blue Towel" I purchased to clean my cars in years past.  Either way, this one is quite comparable and will do the job of drying your car or bike without streaks.  Just do not use it near part of the car that like to grab, as this will easily snag on them.
This thing is BIG, almost too big, hard to keep it from touching the ground. can easily dry an entire car of almost any size with this.
I have tried a number of drying towels and this one is by far the best. I can dry the entire car and the towel barely feels wet. It is great at absorbing the water and not just pushing it around.
summary: Best drying towel I've ever used

reviewText: I love this in reality, but it has a short coming... 1st of all.. I can dry my entire Range Rover with just 1 towel..and not even have to wring it out a single time.  My only complaint is that it seems to snag on the raised lettering on my truck fairly often ( you'd think I'd figure out a way to keep it away from them!) but because of the snagging I've got little threads sticking out all of the time so I'm curious as to the long term durability...other than that minor flaw...I think this is a great product!

This towel is really great for drying your car.  I can do the whole car easily without needing to wring it out once.  As other reviewers have mentioned, it does tend to catch on corners if you are not careful and mine pulled a thread out about an inch.  I still think it is great but if it was woven just a tiny bit tighter I think it would be that much better.  Still the best towel I have found for drying off my car, will buy another when this one is used up.

When it comes to washing a car, I think the most frustrating thing is having to dry a car somewhat quickly, especially if it's a toasty day!  This towel really does make quick work of drying!  With a HUGE span, you can dry off a car in 5 minutes, including all the nooks and crannies, and be on your merry way to cruise around in your freshly cleaned ride. ;)I personally would recommend people folding this towel so you have many sections to work with (and so it doesn't snag on anything!).  Start from the top and move your way down so that any excess water and be pushed down towards parts of the car you haven't dried rather than having water drip on where you JUST dried (now wouldn't that be annoying?)Good product! Does what it was designed to do and it's not limited to cars!  Universal use, GIANT span, and super effective water pick-up-ability.Recommended!
Great towel!it will hold a lot more water before u need to wring it out,I'm skeptical about cutting it up into smaller sections fearing it might leave lint from the frayed edges.i highly recommend
This works well, but I do need 2 or 3 to dry the Suburban.  They pick up water well, but fo get snagged easily by the name plate, logo, etc, and pull threads.  Overall, though, good value for < $10

I wanted to love this, but it snags a lot on badges. This towel definitely soaks up a lot of water. I can dry my prius with just 3 wrings. But the down side is if im not careful, it'll easily snag on the toyota badges on the trunk. I'm guessing it'll last me another few months of once a week washes. After that I'll look for a more durable drying towel. its definitely worth a try if you take your time drying and stay away from sharp edged badges.
Good big size and works pretty well. My only complaint is that it snags on literally everything that is not flat on my car!

This thing will dry your puppy up in no time! Streak free too! You have no idea how much time is saved by using something like this! No more cotton towel leaving white lint all over the whip! A+ product...thx Viking!

One Towel to dry my whole car.  I don't even have to wring it out as I go.  No streaks left but watch any trim.  Any snag will cause it to visually look bad, but the towel works great either way.  Highly recommended.  Machine wash/dry and you're good to go for the next wash.
THIS IS A GREAT PRODUCT...WISH I'D BEEN AWARE OF IT YEARS AGO...MUCH FASTER AND BETTER THAN AN EXPENSIVE  CHAMOIS...PROMPT DELIVERY WELL PACKAGED....GREAT..THANK YOU...

Very absorbent towel- and a good amount of it.  I have a larger vehicle, so I did have to squeeze out the accumulated water a few times- but that's no surprise.  Maybe one day I'll purchase a few more and enjoy a quicker drying "experience".  I would repurchase this item.

This towel is huge and makes it easy to dry a car with. Don't listen to other peoples' exaggerated reviews. No, you probably can't dry a whole car without squeezing the water out once or twice...at least you won't dry it properly. Maaaybe if you're drying a Miata-sized car. Either way, it's still very convenient as you can dry a whole car in just a few minutes.The one issue I have is that the towel snags on pointy edges (grill, emblems, tail lights, door handles, etc). This causes minor tears in the fabric. It's still working fine for me after maybe 10 washes, but it probably won't last as long as it should because of the constant tearing.Pro tip: Remember, this thing is BIG, so ensure you don't let the towel touch the ground when you're drying the lower areas of your car.

My first waffle weave drying towel was very expensive when I bought it at a local auto parts store. It was a name brand and I was very happy with it except for the price. When I decided to get a second I looked online and decided to give this one. I am glad that I did.It is just as good as the name brand one that I bought locally at a much better price.I put a lot more effort into detailing my car than most people do and quality is important to me. Like I said I am very happy with this towel.
summary: Excellent towel for a serious detailer and a very good price

reviewText: Most importantly it will not scratch your vehicle.  So this is why the 2 point deduction:  When other reviewers say it will snag on anything, believe them.  - 1 point.  Once the towel is fully saturated, in my experience, you might as well have another towel on hand because this one will not perform any longer.  - 1 point.  Actually once it reached the point of near complete saturation, it started leaving streaks and wringing it out does nothing to resolve this problem.  I would have given 3 1/2 stars had I been able.  I do recommend purchasing this towel as I have nothing to compare it to.  What works for me is water blading the large areas first and then going back over difficult spots with this towel.

Very absorbent material. Not like most microfiber materials. If you work with your hands and have calluses that microfiber acts like Velcro with then rest assured this isn't like that. I have bought a lot of microfiber rags towels over the years and this is by far my favorite. One caveat though... It's a very soft material it WILL snag quite easily around sharp obstacles like chrome badges.
This thing is HUGE! its drys very well, and does not scratch the paint finish, for the price it beats all!

It is a decent quality towel for the price but the towel seems to bleed the blue when I wash it with other microfiber towels. I am sure there are better quality drying towels but at this price it is hard to beat.

I was expecting something better after reading all the reviews.  A lot of people mentioned snags and mine came shipped with 4 of them.  It did snag on a place that caught me off guard but that was my fault.Overall it's OK. I used smaller microfiber towels that I had purchased from Costco years back and I don't think it does anything different then they did. You have to use more than this one towel but that's the only difference I noticed.
This is fine for polishing wax or polish off the car but honestly is too samll for "drying" so go for something bigger.  Lots of options on the Chemical Guys site that work.

I've been using using leather chamois, the absorber, and microfiber for drying the car but this towel is really remarkable. It sucks up the water and holds it very well. In fact, it retains water so well that it is hard to wring the water out to continue drying the car. Although you can dry a whole car with one towel, i bought two to get the car really dry.  It's a good investment.The one con is that this towel snags VERY EASILY. probably due to the effective waffle weave. i've been able to reduce snagging by re-training myself to blot the car dry, instead of wiping/dragging across surfaces.
summary: Probably the best way to dry a car.

reviewText: Yes, it SUCKS up a lot of water.  I didn't pay attention to the 9 square feet when I bought it.  So when I opened the package, 9 square feet is a lot of towel.  I've been using terry cloth for years and have gotten worn out.  I bought this to replace them, and it does its job well.

I actually ordered these after reading a review by a woman who said she uses them to wash the make-up off her face! I thought these would hold up well, and liked the oval contoured shape for this sort of use. I also thought these were well priced for a package of 6.When they arrived however, they were not the oval ones shown in the picture, and they did not come in a package of 6. For this reason, I did not give them more than 2 stars.  Though I do think they are nice, thick quality, terry covered pads, they are not what as shown in the ad's picture, and I was very disappointed to find only 4 in the package.
These applicators work very well in spreading the wax evenly. They clean up well and I can see they will last a long time.

These wax applicator pads have been put to the test the last few days. There is hardly any nap to the pads, so after applying wax to a body panel much of the wax that you apply to the pad gets absorbed into the foam insert. These pads seem to be easier to use once a fair amount of wax has been absorbed into the applicator - you could say the same about any other wax applicator pad.Anyhow, there's some beautifully detailed cars around here, and these applicator pads played a role in that.The stitching on the side of the pads looks like it will fail, but the stitching seems to be strong.These pads were placed in the washer machine and cleaned up w/ hot water and normal wash detergent - with a small amount of bleach. They held up well after two separate washings and they look like they'll last a few more uses.I even took a couple of these and threw 'em in the clothes dryer - to see how they'd hold up and they look pretty good.These pads offer great value at a very good price - Highly recommended.
I really, like these pads and great Price to; cheaper than Walmart, And no lint. I use these for cleaning and putting leather balm on my leather seats.
Excellent deal. These pack will last you literally forever. They are so durable even washing with the hottest water and with the most aggressive soaps.
summary: Excellent to apply paste carnauba wax. Very durable

reviewText: These are one or two time uses and then toss then.  You want a lasting pad go with foam.  These don't suit my needs but they are what they say they are.  I have nothing against the product it just didn't work for me.

I used it to apply waxes, with cleaners, and for leather care products and they held up well.The foam is a bit denser than the Lexol pads and the terry cloth feels softer.When I clean my leather handbags, shoes and sofas, I like to use these terry cloth pads because they help with rubbing away grime and stains better than just the microfiber cloth. If I just condition the leather, then I use the microfiber cloths.I washed them and put them in the washer, even put them in the dryer and they are fine.Obviously, they don't last forever and depending on how soiled you get them, they last longer or shorter.These pads are the great value, a pack of 6 for about $5.17, that is about $0.86 for one pad.

These are no cheaper, or smaller than any of the name brand pads - but they cost a fraction of the price.  I use these to wax, and to apply leather conditioner.  They've worked great, and I have no problem recommending them to others!

I love these little applicators, great price for a 6 pk.  I like detailing my cars regularly, so when I use a spray wax on my cars, these pads worked great, spread the wax on evenly and buffed off to a great shine.I washed the wax off the applicator pads with some dish soap....they appear to look near new still....I will buy some more when the time comes...could be a while as these seem pretty durable. Worth it for the price

I would rate these 5 star if they had a slightly deeper pile of terry towelling. It's a good idea to wash them first if you're doing the interior (e.g. Leather seats) as they let go of a little fluff here and there. I like that the foam layer inside is not too thick to absorb too much of the solution being applied. Good value for money. I'm not sure I'd use them for high end waxing as the terry pile is not particularly deep and could be slightly softer. I'd recommend these for at least the interior and trim.
How often have you started to wax your car and opened your was and the applicator is dried up and or dirty looking?  I rest my case.
I use it to wax/polish manually corners that is hard for my polisher to reach. I also use it to spread wax material just in case I miss some areas
this is just like having a hand computer for auto in your hand to fix the problem with your automobile

This unit does everything it says it does. I even tried out the ABS on my friends Dodge Intrepid and it told exactly whats wrong with it. I can't say enough about this unit. It does do what it says it does.

it took a week of going to different sites and reading customer reviews plus time at manufactors home sites there were plenty of negative reviews on many models but on this unit the worst complaint was wanting a larger case. like any tool it takes practice learning how to use all the info available ,The ABS circuit is a plus I own a small used car dealer ship but it has already paid for it self in pointing out driveability issues other brands had reliability issues or customer service issues but so far it is a winner. the hardest part is sometimes finding the defective parts location under the hood I go to my local parts store and they have made use of service manuals for free ( chilton )I like buying from Amazon because of there willingness to work with you if you do have a problem

This scanner is really a handy device for your average garage mechanic.  This has already helped me by saving a lot of extra time troubleshooting.  Above that, it gives a level of detail that basic scanners can't even come close to duplicating.  It seems a lot of thought has been put into this scanner.  The cable is long enough so that you can read it from the engine compartment if you wanted to.  It has the ability to record data as you're driving.  It can save codes, and allows you to assign them to specific VIN's (for viewing later on your computer).  There's a lot more you can do with it too, if you're willing to pay for extra options.  The only issue I have is they try to get you to sign up for some monthly fee to research the codes you pull.  I don't feel its needed, I haven't signed up for it, and I think it should be a free service (for the cost of the device).  The scanner gives more than enough info, and if you need more detail, Google does a great job of that... for free.  Even with that, I'd still recommend it to any garage mechanic looking to upgrade their scanner tool.
summary: Well built, and provides lots of information

reviewText: When I purchased this unit I was concerned that it wouldnt work on my car. A 2008 Chevrolet Malibu (New body). Surprisingly it not only shows the Engine Data. But also reads the ABS codes. Not that I've ever had an Engine/ABS light on. Now I know I have a tool that will when it does. I can compare this to my older Snap On MT2500. Which is a good scanner. Not just a code reader. But I find the Innova 3160 easier to read. Havent had a chance to test it on a CAN equipped vehicle.

Just the tool I wanted, Have been waiting for it to go on sale and Amazon.com did it once again. Priced it at my sale price, so I bought it, a must have tool for all auto. pros. to work on the new cars that are coming out. Thank You Amazon.com for this gift!!
summary: INNOVA 3160B ABS/SRS+PROFESSIONAL CanOBDll Dignostic Code Scanner

reviewText: After a considerable wait of several weeks I received my scan tool. I read the instructions (very brief) checked for updates (none available) and tried the tool on my 2008 4runner.The tool gave me a green emission control system light, no active codes, and a cryptic security system DTC that it could not clear. I unplugged the tool and started the car. No CEL, everything seemed fine UNTIL...I took it for a drive he next morning and after about 5 minutes the CEL and the VSC malfunction lights illuminated. After returning home I hooked up The scan tool and it had logged 20 malfunction codes! (first time in 5 years this vehicle had thrown a code)I attempted to reset the codes, the scanner said they were erased, and when I rescanned the codes returned. After several attempts I disconnected the tool and drove the car... The CEL was off but I noticed that several dealer settings (security system, headlights, seatbelt warning) had all been removed and needed to be reset.  I checked the scan tool one last time and the 20 codes remained, along with a yellow emissions status indicator.Well, for 200 bucks, this was a total bust. Did more harm than good and went back to the seller.
This will pay for itself in a timely fashion.  Easy to use.  I have not found any issues so far.

The downloaded PDF manual fails to cover the PC link program.Needed to up date the product Firmware, (which it will need)so, I installed the software and clicked help, in the app. and it too has zero help. just links to , innova.The PC-link must install MS-SQL and one other package first. (a fully updated windows 7 , did load perfect)but im off to buy a USB cable ...The Scan tool works great. (USA market cars , all)I use alldata.com for pure data on specific cars. and FSM's,, I will not use the, repair solutions links.I will review only the tool. reviewText: This reader is the best available as far as i know for the price. It does everything: obdii DTC codes for all cars even new ones and also does SRS an ABS codes from all domestic cars and honda acura or toyota lexus . I tried it on a suzuki xl7(DTC) an honda civic 2010(SRS) an Dodge caravan 2006(SRS and ABS) and my 2003 acura rsx (DTC and SRS). Information given by this machine is manufacturer specific and is well described. Comes with a usb cable for live data recording and transfer on PC. I am very happy with this purchase.

I bought this to diagnose the ABS fault in my 2005 F-150 -- the device said it was the rear differential speed sensor and it was.  The INNOVA 3160 cleared the fault after I made the repair.  I also tried to diagnose the ABS fault on my 1997 Jeep Grand Cherokee -- it can talk to the engine sub-system but not the ABS sub-system.  I think the INNOVA 3160 pays for itself in one repair, because visiting the shop is costly, and will lead to more repairs.

i loved it even though it is a bit difficult to get used to it since it is my first time to use such tool. the only thing i have to mention is i tried it with 2000 Lexus and it could not connect i don't know what was the issue but i will try to contact them. overall it is great and worth the money.

I'm not sure why every type of code reader is coming down in price but offering software to load on your laptop to store, compare, print, and submit to a group of mechanics to analyze your data.The reason I gave it three starts and thought about two is the fact that this code reader is connecting to your car's master computer but utilizes the Internet to download updates etc. Yet instead of using an Open System Operating System or creating a Mac Version, which if there was a Mac OS X version, a mechanic wouldn't have to lug around a laptop but could use an iPad.Plus, I have used Windows and Windows Servers for 26 years and paid quarterly subscriptions for Norton, Symantec, etc. and still Trojan Horses would infect the server. WHEN SOMEBODY DIES BECAUSE THE MASTER COMPUTER IS INFECTED, INNOVA WON'T BE AROUND ANYMORE!!

This is the second time I purchased this tool.The first time I bought it just because I thought it would be a neat tool to have. Plus I liked the live data feature. When I received the tool I immediately plugged it into my car and watched the live data. Unfortunately, this was the extent of what this tool could do at that time because I had no trouble codes and everything else was working perfectly. I decided to return it simply because I did not really have a use for it.A few months later, I purchased a 2003 Dodge Caravan and my sister purchased a 1999 Ford Explorer. Both had check engine and ABS lights illuminated on the dash.I made sure to reference the online user manual before making my purchase again to double check that the scan tool would read the ABS codes on these vehicles...and it does.I ordered the scan tool again and immediately plugged it into my Caravan to check the ABS code however, it didn't give me a code, it just gave a brief description "rr circuit fault". I knew this was the rr speed sensor, so I replaced the part and cleared the code and everything is just fine now, but I was a bit disappointed because I was expecting this tool to give a more definite code AFTER ALL, IT IS SUPPOSED TO WORK WITH THE CARAVAN.I haven't had a chance to check out my sisters Explorer, but I am guessing it will give a pretty generic description.Another thing I would have liked is a USB port/cable instead of a serial port/cable. reviewText: This has saved me big bucks on repairs and diagnostics. Easy to use and easy to read. If I charged for every time I have loaned it out I would have paid for it many times. A great tool at a great price. You can spend more and get less with other brands.

This works wonders for what it is. I used it on my Saturn and although it isn't covered in some of the very detailed scans, it works as intended. I can def save some money having my issues known ahead of time and be educated enough before hitting the dealer or mechanic.

I have been wanting to get a code reader for some time to check on check engine light codes. This one not only checks the codes for all newer OBCD-II vehicles and allows you to clear them, but will scan some ABS codes as well. This code reader is half the price than the same one from my local auto parts store. Great value for a good product. My only complaint is that the cable included with the reader for the computer is serial port instead of USB and most modern computers do not have serial ports anymore.

This product works great. Easy to understand and use. A must have for the do-it -your-selfer. It will save you time and money the first time you use it in stead of going to the dealership at a cost of $150. just to hook it up.

I've only used this once but it worked perfectly. I really like the way the codes come up with the definition. saves you from having to look up the code in a book or online. A must buy for any at home mechanic.
summary: Reset my Honda Accord SRS light without any problems

reviewText: Fantastic unit read my ABS codes on my F250 and Merc Mountaineer not a problem I had a ABS lite on my 250 scanner told me what sensor to check It was simple a chunk of cardboard that had been ran over and wet that got into the sensor hole and it could not see the toner ring.. saved me a few hrs looking as I went right to the corner that had the problem.. One the Mercury It showed misfiring on cylinder 6 my other scanner Actron never found it as I've scanned the issue of a miss with that actron several time it never read that code this one hit it the 1st scan coil pac had a bad section on 6 problem solved

I have a 1964 John Deere 2010 (model) Diesel crawler tractor.  These are rather well known for coolant leaks into the oil from some rubber seals around the cylinders where they meet the block.  It's a big job to open up the engine and replace these rubber seals.  While I don't know for sure that this is where my leak was, it is likely.  I was loosing a quart to the oil in a couple months when it sat around and some when it was running as well.  After adding the K-Seal and a dozen heat up cool down tractor uses, I don't seem to be getting anymore coolant in the oil.  I bought a second bottle of K-Seal to keep around.  I think that this stuff works, at least in my situation, it has.

Well, it did work. Repair shop said I have a gasket problem. One (1) liter of coolant in my reservoir would last exactly two days only. I put this product in the reservoir Friday morning and went to work. Got back home and didn't drive over the weekend. Monday morning and still no empty coolant indicator. Drove back home, and still no warning. I am guessing it did work. If this lasts two weeks, then it is all worth it.
I bought two bottles because I was a little skeptical that one little bottle would work. I wasted my money because one bottle did the trick!

Variables (changes among customer)1-Cherokee 4.0L inline six2-Clean radiator (aluminum/plastic)3-New radiator cap (16 pnds)4-New dual-electric fans (11' height)I recently bought an '87 Cherokee which its radiator was modified (from an earlier Jeep). I notice a small leak on at the top part of the aluminum cells, which worried me due to the fact these engines can become very hot very fast, but I wasn't ready to spend some extra money for a new radiator, however the current one is rust free and unclogged.After an extensive reading and amazon research, I decided to get me one K-Seal to pour it according to instructions. While the engine reach healing temperature I got distracted admiring the engine bay.......... guest what? all of the sudden ...leak was gone. It took only 5-8 min to completely seal it up, very impressive. I didn't drove it during the "healing", I just left the engine at idle for about 10-15min and pray for a miracle.The chemical is almost odor-free and you can see the sealing particles on the liquid while pouring it. I'm not sure if the price is correct, but hey...$15 instead of $145; is an humongous gap.I'm not a big a fan of chemicals rushing thru cooling tiny holes on an engine, but this K-Seal is wonderful, if ever find myself again in a similar situation..........K-Seal will be the answer.Bottom line I recommend this to my friends.

One of my older vehicles recently was afflicted by a rather significant leak at the heater core.  Larger enough that I could see a small but steady stream from beneath the vehicle.  Replacing the heater core would have been a major job requiring removal of the entire dash, seats, and more.  I was debating if the time had come to send her to the crusher.  With very low expectations, figured I would give this produce a shot.I stopped at the local parts store and joked with the counter person that I was buying a bottle of "miracle in a can".  He replied that people had actually had pretty good results.I got home. poured it into the radiator and expected it not to work.  Sure enough, after a few minutes the leak seemed to stop.  As the car reached full operating temp I again noticed some leaking and smugly assumed I had been proven correct.  But alas, a few more minutes passed and the trickle went to a drip, and then to nothing.  I let it run for a good hour with a pan underneath.  Sure enough, it worked just as advertised.  The leak has not returned.  The rest of the system is working as it should, temp guage right where it should be, heater blowing hot and dry.  This tells me that it fixed the leak and has also not blocked up anything it should not.It is extremely rare that any of these "miracle in a bottle" products live up to their claims.  This product did what it promised and saved me considerable $$$.  If you are facing an expensive repair, it is definitely worth giving this a try first.
summary: It actually worked!!! - Fixed my heater core

reviewText: I bought this hoping it would suit my needs.  I wanted to secure my helmet to my bike while I was in a store or not on the bike. reviewText: I use this to hold my second helmet in place on passenger seat, and have yet to see it move. Hooks leave a little something to be desired, but all-in-all I am super happy!
Comes in handy when you have more to carry than you can fit into your saddle bags. Glad I bought it.

I haven't used it yet but it is certainly made well. Triple bungee cord on all sides where the clips attach. The clips are large enough to fit over the grab bars around the seat of my electric scooter. They are sturdy plastic and won't scratch the paint. It stretches out a lot so you can carry large items and is small enough to carry something as small as a helmet.Good item and with free shipping and no tax the price is okay.

This net is plenty stretchy and can hold down quite a bit of stuff.  I took a long weekend trip on my Honda Shadow and it kept my duffel and small backpack snug against the back seat.  My only complaint is that the rubber tips on the hooks (that keep them from scratching your fender or whatnot) came right off.  I superglued them back on but not before I lost one of them.  Kind of poorly made in that area, otherwise it works well.  Can't beat the price too.

The hooks are made of steel wire with plastic tube over the wire.  Each hook is supposed to have a rubber-like cap over the end. The caps are there to prevent the bare metal ends from scratching your motorcycle or bicycle. I saw at least one other review where the purchaser super-glued these tips on after losing one.  I ordered 2, and both arrived with at least one tip already missing.There were also more long loose ends flailing about than seemed necessary.  Sure, I could have cut those shorter and melted the ends to prevent fraying, but I should not have to.Mine also smelled pretty bad, but I assume that would dissipate pretty quickly.The quality is just not very good.
Works great for helmets and other random things you might want to carry.  I've used it for anything from a bag of fast food to a 1 gallon can of paint.
Holds stuff on the back of the bike just fine.  Have had some heavier stuff back there.  Strong web, good hooks.

Bought this to hold a small cooler on the back seat of my Goldwing, and it did a great job. Would recommend it. The only issue is the small rubber tips on the end of the hooks tend to fall off, but throw some glue on them right away, and you should not have a problem. Not a real big deal, but still a small hassle. Other than that, it worked great.
I ordered this and so far have not needed it or tried it out. I do store it in my saddle bad in case I may need it but that's about all I can tell you thus far...

This Cobra power inverter is working very good so far, though I have only used it a few times to power my Omega juicer at 150 watts. It is pretty silent, only being heard when the fan comes on momentarily, then is silent. The fan has not been loud yet, although it may get louder if the surrounding temperature exceeds a comfortable level. That remains to be seen and I will update my report if the situation changes.
I like it, it works great and adds extra convenience, I would buy this item again.  Good price also on this item.

Purchased a more expensive inverter that did not work, returned and purchased this. worked perfectly out of the box and has continued to work through freezing cold/hot conditions. the dual connections also make it great for traveling/temp mounting in an additional car.

I bought this to wire it up in the glove box of my truck.  I have it hard wired to the fuse block and so far so good.  I only charge one thing at a time so I don't know if there's an issue using both plugs, but bang for the buck I recommend it.

I bought this inverter just in case the power goes out, and I will use it to ignite the burner on my gas water heater, which requires only 3 watts. For the price i could not get anything near this one at Home Depot. I did not want to get a generator because the power does not go out often where I live and this takes a lot less space and no maintenance.
We have two now.  We use it in our rv when we want 110 ac when we are boondocking.  It is wired directly to the battery otherwise the output is pretty limited.
Great product! Easy to use and compact.  I really like the USB port feature on it. It works great in my camper to watch DVDs and charge my cell phone.

I bought this to mount in my work van for the purpose of charging the batteries for my cordless tools. It mounts up easily, hooking it up is pretty straight-forward, and so far it has worked fine. It's best to use heavy guage wire to the vehicle battery if you can.

Received this the other day. Tested this in my car using a cordless phone and a lamp light. Worked very well. The first time I use it I hear a beeping alarm that seems to come from my car console. Listening to the beeping alarm again I heard it from the inverter itself. Referring to the manual the cause of the beeping alarm was from a low voltage of my car battery. Charged the battery, no more alarm. Price is good.

Pros:- 2 AC outlets and a USB power port- Compact size- Cooling Fan that actually moves airCons:- Won't run my electric drill (but that thing dims lights in an entire house)I hardwired this into my truck, so I cannot say anything about the battery clamp cables or the socket connector for this item. I can say though, that the inverter has been working solidly for months and I have not had a single problem. There are certain things this will not run, such as a Brother HL-2140 Laser Printer, or an old electric drill at full torque.Overall, I am very pleased with this product, and the price it sells for, would highly recommend it.

Well my usb port on it never worked, but since I'm permanently mounting it behind body panels in my car, that wasn't a concern. The AC outlets work great (running extension cords from it in the car to the locations I want an outlet). I haven't fully tested it load wise, but it handled 150-200 watts fine. I would recommend it, for the price, it can't be beat.

PROs - works well enough to keep my laptop/tablet charged up using the cigarette lighter.  If you want to get the full rating out of it, safely, I'd recommend that you wire it directly to the battery.Indicator lights workAlarm if pulling too much currentCONS:  Would like to have an extra foot or so length on the cigarette adapter cable.  Not enough to take a star off.My wife had no problems on holiday over the summer plugging her 17inch Dell Laptop while driving.  Enough power to charge the battery and use the laptop at the same time.
