reviewText: We have a 2011 Holiday Rambler with a Parallax 7155.... We've gone through 2 batteries since 2011, and just recently the OEM converter began acting up.... charging for 5-7 minutes at a time and then not charging for hours... There were other times it would over charge the battery causing it to boil over....  Bottom line here is the OEM converter's stink... Most are made in China and don't last for more then a year of constant use...After I installed this, we immediately noticed a huge improvement in all our 12v lighting and accessories.... It only took about an hour to install and so far it works excellent.....  Very pleased with this purchase.
summary: Probably one of the BEST RV upgrades you can do!!!!

reviewText: This is a great upgrade that will pay for its self by properly charging your expensive batteries. Replace the garbage WFCO converter that came with your RV. The install is very straight forward, search around on youtube and you will find a video or two on the install. If you are considering cable upgrades it looks like the lugs will accommodate at least 3 gauge and maybe 2 gauge. (4 gauge fits with ease).

I replaced our non-working 12 volt converter with this.  I did have to replace the included distribution panel but it was not as difficult as I thought it would be. The charger works great and regulates the voltage to the battery for storage.  I leave the trailer plugged in all the time now and it doesn't boil out the battery like the stock one would.Took about 1 hour to install
summary: More 12 volt and better battery charging

reviewText: We are so happy we decided to upgrade our travel trailer.  Two AC's running, Hot water heater, fridge and convection microwave and we don't trip the breaker in 97 degrees outside.

As with everyone else who purchases this item, I have a trailer with two sewer connections.  i will do my best to NEVER buy another trailer with this configuration.  The first time I hooked everything up, out of the 7 connections, I think 3 of them leaked (including at least one on the Y fitting).  It was probably user error coupled the crappy bayonet connections used on almost all RVs.If the existing one breaks, I'd buy this one again if I couldn't find anything better.  As always, Amazon price was much better than anyone else.
Camco 39812 RhinoFLEX RV WyeNeeded this item to hook both grey and black tanks together on our new camper, and wanted to stay with the Rhino products
I have 2 drains on my trailer and this allows me to leave both open to the sewer and not have to switch the hose from outlet to outlet!

I have a travel trailer with three waste tanks. When I go to a RV Park this is the only way I can utilize the sewer connection and cover black, grey and galley tanks at the same time. Product does exactly what it is supposed to do and no leaks.
summary: Camco 39812 RhinoFLEX RV Wye Works excellent!

reviewText: This is an excellent product! When we purchase our new 2014 Rockwood Travel Trailer it had to gray water hook up. This product is what the doctor order. It works great too. I would recommend this product to anyone.
Good study quality plastic, just as I would expect. Tabs don't feel flimsy and I don't anticipate any issues. I hope the swivels never leak.
summary: More compact that it appears in the photo, which is a good thing.

reviewText: Recently upgraded the RV to a larger one with a swing-boom.  I was using a 15' RhinoFLEX hose which worked when it was compressed, but I wasn't exactly pleased.  I switched to the 5' length which turned out to be a perfect fit inside the boom.  I can attach a five inch clear adapter between the 5' hose at the end of the boom and the 15' extension hose to check the drainage of the holding tanks.

Camco 39764 RhinoFlex 10' Sewer Hose ExtensionCouldn't find that length other places, and was a good price.Can wait to use it on our new camper, we have 2 grey and 3 black tank we have to hook together.
Best sewer hose on the market. Works great and is very durable. Works great with the 15 foot sewer hose.
I picked up this extension "just in case" I needed it and the very next RV park I stopped at I needed it.  Great value and quality

We're full-time RV'ers, and we think Camco's RhinoFLEX RV sewer hose system is THE BEST.This 5' extension comes in handy when one 10' hose length isn't long enough, yet another 10' length would be too much.  We carry two 10' lengths and one 5' length in the rear bumper of our RV.

I already have the 15' Rhino kit. Bought this because we camp at regular campgrounds and for the past two years (dumping at least 20 times) have never needed anything longer than 5' to reach the drain at dump stations in state and federal campgrounds. Took the elbow off the 15' hose and exchanged the terminal end on the 5' so now the 5' will become my primary hose and the 15' the extension if I need it. I keep both in a Rubbermaid container along with the drain attachment for the elbow. Amazon had the lowest cost that I could find. The Rhino hose appears to be very good as the 15' hose I've been using for two years still looks new.

I had to purchase two of these to extend my 15' Rhinoflex hose.  It fits perfectly with no leaks...but...as someone already mentioned, MAKE SURE that the ends are wound securely and locked down before using.  They are NOT always wound all the way or locked into the couplers.
summary: Pricey for 5 feet but does the job ...

reviewText: The Rhino series works well and appears to be durable.  When working with this unpleasant part of camping, you want a system that minimizes your exposure and time.  This extension will be added to my storage compartment for those times when the main hose won't reach.It's great to have the quick connect and disconnect.

A good sewer hose for sure but you must be aware that these will not fit in anything the R.V. people have for 4" storage. The pipe itself is 4" but the bayonet fittings make it bigger and therefore will not fit in a 4" pipe as was built into my R.V. I ended up making a hose holder out of 5" fence pvc fence post and strapping onto the r.v. The hose itself is really good but be sure to follow the instructions and get the ends on tight. Had a mess on my hands when one end came off during a dump session. Not the hoses fault as I hadn't tightened it on properly.
summary: Good product but beware of the size !

reviewText: Well, this is the stinky slinky that holds its shape, they are not marvelous or magical, but it works for its intended purpose.  In a selection of low quality products, this one is slightly better then all the rest.
summary: Good procuct for a crappy job

reviewText: I was concerned about the fit to store it in my 4" bumper but it fit perfectly.  The hose "accordians" down to a stiff compact tube

the ends are too large around to fit into the storage area.  which means now i have a stinky sewer hose in a garbage bag.  not good.  this is basic stuff - sewer storage diameter is pretty much standard in all newer rv's (less than 15 yrs old). so its its not rocket science to make sure the hose and its permanently attached fittings fit into that area.
summary: good quality but doesn't fit in standard rv sewer storage

reviewText: I purchased this RhinoFlex 5' Sewer Hose Extensinon Kit with coupler and it was nothing but a BIG Problem while on my month long trip.  I never could get the couplers connected so had to hold them to the end of the hose when dumping my motor home.  I ended up not even using the connector to the dump but just feeding my hose down in the hole.  I had to do this as the other coupler came lose and had to hold it on the motor home outlet so my waste wouldn't spill all over the place.  Some guy emailed me and told me it took him forty minutes to figure out how to connect the couplers but it was a peace of cake after that.  (I have had it and will not even try to do this!)  I am thinking of returning it but I threw away the box and it is too much trouble.  I do not see how they  would sell such a product knowing the couplers are so hard to connect, if in fact, you can connect them.
It works but the fittings won't fit inside my 4" square bumper. The Valterra brand does fit. So there.  ~Pegleg~

This is an extension kit meant to go with the RhinoFLEX sewer hose dump kit.  Don't buy it thinking it's all you need to connect your camper's dump valve to a sewer/RV dump site.  No - this is meant to hook up to the main kit and extend its reach by about 5 feet.  It's great RhinoFLEX quality.  Better to have it and not need it - than to be 3 feet short at the campsite.  They usually sell cheap sets at the campground.  Get it now!

I've used a variety of sewer hoses since starting out camping.  I've gone through many, and I have to say this brand is the best or close to the best you'll find.  The RHINO type is very rugged and takes abuse.  I have the 15 foot hose and this 5 foot hose.  This 5 foot hose can be used alone when you're at a dump station and don't need a full size run of hose.  Or you can use this to extend your 15 foot hose to 20 feet.  I also use this hose to attach to a portable grey water holding tank (blue boy), and can take it to the dump station with the blue boy to dump.  I should have purchased this years ago, which would have saved me many headaches.
Great hose and rugged. I like the connections far better than the other brand and the rhino is a very tough hose.
We bought all one name product and it appears to fit our needs.It also appears well made and suits our purposes.

It's hard to say that you love a sewer hose, but I do.  We've gone through so many cheap hoses during our 10 years of full-timing, and we are glad we finally found this heavy duty hose.  Buy one and you won't be disappointed

So far I have't done a 'RVing" such as in the movie.  Once you get used to screwing the ends on they are easy to use.  I have to take my ends off because the pipe will not fit into my holder which isn't the fault of Camco.  When you connect to the RV just make sure you tighten the connectors up, I had a little leak but once I tighten it up they it worked perfect.

This Rhino hose can't stand UV light. In direct sunlight if you leave one attached to the RV it's come apart in just a few months. Mine came completely apart in several locations and had to many pin holes to count. The cheap hose I replaced this one with from Walmart has been out in the same light in the same location for over a year and a half and still looks like new while the Rhino was in the dumpsters in one third of that time.
summary: Don't leave out in the sun.

reviewText: I would recommend buying the extension....just in case.  Tough material.  Fits perfectly and have never had an issue.  When it comes to dumping.  No news is good news and I'm glad to say I've got no news to report.  I've used this from day one and will never use anything else.
The swivel connections make it a lot easier to use than some of the other products and reduces the stress of dealing with this aspect of camping.
I have tried various other hoses, none compare. If you need a new RV hose, look no further than the Camco RhinFLEX hoses.
This setup works great and easy to use. You will like the clear view section; no guessing when draining is complete.
summary: Better than one that came with camper

reviewText: i took my rv out this last weekend and used this hose man its awsome not one drop on the ground and its high quality will last a long time huge upgrade from the cheapo i got with my trailer.

As long as your "stuff" flows down hill, this will work fine.  I bought this about 4 months ago and have used it quite heavily in that time.  Until this weekend it worked great, but I now see it has limitations.  The sewer connection I used this weekend was actually slightly higher than the outlet of my travel trailer (I have a very low-profile trailer). As a result, the hose stayed full after I emptied my tanks.  The problem was that with the hose constantly full of water the trailer side fittings leaked. It was a fairly steady drip and no matter how tight I tightened the fittings, they still leaked.  I am going to put this away as a back-up hose and try theValterra D04-0250 Dominator 15' Sewer Hose Kitnext.

I bought this knowing that I needed a hose but not really knowing how to use it. Having had it for about six months and having used it on about 15 occasions at different parks and RV parks I can tell you that it comes with all the attachments necessary for successful RV dumping, it's very high quality. If you have a large RV and will be permanently attached, this hose might not be long enough. For my 26 foot trailer and everywhere that I've been, it is more than long enough to reach.

I really loved using this hose compared to others I have used. It goes on so easy and is easy to flush out and then store. I found this same exact product in many RV stores and this was much cheaper here on Amazon.com and was the exact same product. Would buy again

I have other sewer hose drains but this one is better quality, when pushed together it could stand straight out or you can angle it in different directions.  I shouldn't have to purchase another because of the quality, but if I had to I would buy another.Some sewer hoses do not come with the end that connects down to the sewer & this one does.Good Luck

The locking fittings are a great plus if you use them you wont get a leaky yucky mess to contend with its the best system I have used. I have had over 8 travel trailers over the years and the hose is tough and very durable this is the 3 rd. Camco in the last several years. I've had some hoses that didn't last 3 months . We go out 4 to 6 times a year for weeks at a time .Its too bad there are a few campgrounds that don't have  threaded pipes you still need to keep the old tapered rubber cone for them .
summary: take the YUCK out of sewer hook ups

reviewText: Used my Rhino for the first time this last weekend.  I decided to run it with a little gray water first to make sure of no leaks and I'm glad I did.  It leaked at the fitting connected to the TT.  I had to un-screw it and cut it a bit and re-screw it on.  After that we had no leaks.  For the top of the line hose I expected it to not leak out of the box but now I've got it fixed I'm a happy (and clean) camper.
summary: Nice product for the most part

reviewText: this is the best hose EVER. the universal adapter is great, the hose stows easily, the length is perfect, i mean seriously, why wouldnt everyone have one?

Bought this for my 16 foot travel trailer.  This is a flexible but very rigid design - highly recommended.  Makes using the "stinky slinky" a much more easier affair to manage.  My only complaint is that the attachment accessory that it comes with to attach to sewer drains is too big to store in the bumper, so it has to go inside the external storage compartment.  Oh well!
summary: Solid, quality construction and easy to use

reviewText: Great for RV.........Camco 39761 RhinoFLEX 15' RV Sewer Hose Kit with Swivel Fittings....The best out there for your RV very happy and glad to get it through Amazon!~
This was a replacement for the old grey one i had. It world great. Strong plastic, i'll see how it holds up in winter

I took a chance on this. Our drain hose is well used and at this point pretty sketchy. Needless to say, I decided to order this with some other items and this is much nicer and love the fact it comes with the hose caps and everything you need. I can't speak for the life expectancy of the product, but if I get one season out of it - given the price - it's a great buy!

If you have ever tried to empty your black tank with a stock p00p tube then you will have an enormous amount of appreciation for the rhino hose kit. It is sturdy, it won't move on you once you pull the handle, and it has caps to seal in the freshness once you are done.The bad...like everyone else says, it will not fit in most standard p00p tube compartments. The bumper storage on my TT is 4.5" and I would have to take the ends off to store it (easy enough....when it is clean). Fortunately, my TT has a small compartment with a door that is not big enough to store much else so I simply store this in a dedicated lock-tight container and put it in that compartment. Now there is room for my fishing poles in my bumper :-)If you can figure out how to store it properly, I think that this is the best one on the market right now.
This is named Rhino flex for a reason. it's very sturdy and holds it's shape very well. I'm going to have to buy another section, 15' was just a tad short.
Best sewer hose on the market. Works great, very durable and hase all fittings to contain foul order when stored. Works great with the 5 foot sewer hose extension.
this works great and it has fit every waste station and situation we have needed it for with no problems

I have tried them all . Nothing in all the years I been Rving have I been so pleased with something that does what it says. In this case stay together tight and shapes into place as you need it. Plus you can get 5 foot section for those once in awhile situations 15 feet wont reach. A simple twist and you connect with extra in a second.The best part I love of this product is when you finished dumping tanks and now you need to pick it up and store it away. It condenses down to 2 feet tight strong and you simply hold each end and aim it for you storage and away it goes. No more spilling or crazy fighting to put it away without Unravelling . Great product.
summary: Best rv sewer product to hit the market

reviewText: Heavy duty  hose clicks to shorten and lengthen seems like it will last a long time and when you shorten it all the way it stays. No longer wiggling around like a snake when storing it. Well made with heavy duty connectors that don't leak.I will get more in the future

It's better than what came with my RV, but it could be better.  The fittings are a very tight fit in my bumper, and putting it together every time can be a pain.  However if you are using it for a full-hookup spot rather than just at the dump station, it would probably work well for that.
summary: Better than the what came with my RV

reviewText: This thing is the Tonka of RV sewer hoses.  It's tough and ready to take on the worst part of your camping trip.  The dump.  The best part of the package is the end caps that you can screw onto the hose to keep any remaining juices from spilling out all over the place.  I have read others complaining about how this hose will not fit in the bumper, but it will if you unscrew the plastic end pieces.  However, that is a pain in the arse.  The better way to do it is to go to your local home store and buy a 4 foot piece of 5" PVC pipe, and mount it under your RV by the dump station.  That way, you can have quick access to it when you need it.  The pipe stays relatively hidden if you locate it near the frame.  Just make sure you put vented ends on it so that the hose can dry as you drive.

Cousin Eddie from Christmas vacation would be right at home with this! Seriously though, a vast improvement/upgrade to my previous hose. Great quality, excellent fittings. Don't leave home without it.

I've been using a Prest-O-Fit brand sewer hose system for the past 7 years.  It's held up well, but the fittings and hoses were pretty worn and about due for replacement.  When I started researching whether to stick with Prest-O-Fit or try something different this time, I began noticing the RhinoFLEX systems in use by other RV'ers.  I took a closer look at the RhinoFLEX and really liked the tough construction, the locking swivel fittings, the dark hose color (won't show dirt as much), and especially the way the hose accordions and stays put like a bendable drinking straw... something my old Prest-O-Fit hose didn't do.  So I decided I'd go with RhinoFLEX this time.I just received my RhinoFLEX order and set it up...I never thought I'd say this, but WOW, it's a BEAUTIFUL sewer hose system!  Camco really did a great job with this product!
summary: It was Time for an Sewer Hose Upgrade

reviewText: This hose is the cat's meow. It is rugged, very flexible, and it compacts nicely. It comes with everything you need to hook up to any sewage pipe. LOVE IT. MUST GET.

If you have ever seen the movie RV with Robin Williams, then you know what can go wrong. This hose came with plugs for both ends, wow, no dripping when you carry it. I used it for the first time this Easter, and I wish I had bought one sooner. Amazon made it easy, they had it for the best price and free shipping - what a bargain. This wit the Super Flush 2 makes a dirty deed a lot less dirty.
All I can say if you get it together right it does not leak and when doing this job that is what you want.

I have had this for over a year now and have no real complaints, except for a drip here or there, but that was due to the connections getting loose - I am gal I did not get the cheaper hoses, as this one has done well.

I'm a newbie RV person (though I'm 74 years old) so I hit the keyboard and took the advice and comments I read when choosing a sewer hose.  This sounded like a good unit at a reasonable price.  I have used it only twice so far - having the caps has kept any left over water from getting in my storage container.  The elbow fit nicely and the unit worked well especially since it has rotating ends. I didn't need to extend it very much.  Will update this review after using it extended more. I followed the warning labels on both the pipe itself and on the box to tightened all the connections before using for the first time.  I agree with another reviewer that it would be nice if they came from the manufacturer already tightened. I was out for my first extended trip and ended up buying at Walmart (for almost exactly the same price - but I had to pay tax) because my holding tank was filling up.  I usually think ahead better and order from Amazon. UPDATE: April 2014: Used for two summers dumping about 20 times. My experience: 1) When pushing it together after extending it be sure to leave one cap off as it won't retract if sealed at both ends. 2) Be sure it is attached to all four pins on the RV before opening the valve. It has held up well with no leaks (when attached properly).  Since we only use regular dump sites I plan to buy the 5' extension, move the elbow from this 15' to it and move the connecter from the 5' unit to make the 5' my primary and the 15' the extension for any time I need the extra length.  So far there was only one time I wasn't within about 3' of the dump site drain.
I was looking for a good sewer line kit and I found it here. it is the rv sewer kit I wanted, price for the kit was great and so was the shipping.

I purchased this at a dealer so I over-paid for it, but it has worked great for two seasons.  I love how it collapses to a fraction of it's total length.  Also the sewer end screws in to most inlets at the parks we've camped at.  It does disfigure if you step on it, however...but I've never had a leak.  It's been very reliable.  For $30 it's a bargain !!

It is hard to get excited over a sewer hose.  This kit seems relatively well made and has several attachments.....  I find changing hoses regularly is a good idea.  Your camping neighbors are not impressed when your hose becomes brittle and breaks apart
Light weight, hose seems thin but these things never last very long anyway. I think it will be fine if I am careful not to drag it across the ground.

If you're not too extended, these stay strong enough that you can curve it to where you want and it will still stay held up without any supports while the water is running thru it.  Connectors are great, go on easy and stay on snug.  If you need to change fittings, like you have an extension piece or something, just unscrew the fitting off of the hose.  The end-caps are also great, nice to close them up and not have any leaking.  I won't buy any other kind now.  I bought an extra to keep at home, including an extension since I'm not quite close enough to my drain.

This kit came with everything we needed to empty our black tank. The tubing is very sturdy & the fittings fit together very well. There was no leakage while in use, due to the great gaskets on each of the fittings. However, we had seen a video about adding a clear 45* elbow to the top of our clean out. The clear piece that you purchase separately is a wonderful addition since you can easily see that your tank is clean, through the clear fitting. Since the dump station we used was close by, we only had to use one part of the 10' hose, allowing us to keep the other as a spare, or in the event we need to use a longer hose at a hook-up site. I had read that the Rhino is only second in quality to another brand. I was very happy with the price for this & if we ever need another in the future, we will be purchasing this brand again.
summary: Well Made & Very Easy To Use

reviewText: What can I say? It's a poop-tube...except, for this kind of job, I don't want anything but the best product money can buy. I want durable, clean, secure fittings, easy handling, and simple designs that work. You know what? Camco delivered. This is a quality product that was delivered in a timely fashion. It came assembled with caps for both ends included so there won't be any leaks or lingering odors when you store the tube after use. I'm happy, and my bumper has plenty of room to store this and the original as a just-in-case back-up.It was a snug fit, but if you rotate the fittings just right it fit fine in the bumper of my KZ Spree.
summary: I don't want anything but the best product money can buy

reviewText: Our new Casita trailer came with a really cheap, floppy hose.  We would have had to purchase fittings for it anyway, so I decided to go ahead and buy the Rhinoflex set listed here.  We use our trailer for three-season recreational camping and use the gray and black water tanks more than half the time.PROSThe hose is STIFF when it is collapsed.  Easy to carry, easy to slide into the bumper.This set comes with all the fittings, including end caps.  No more dripping hose.All fittings except the funnel-shaped piece that screws into the dump hole fit into the bumper. No more taking the hose apart before storage.We can extend the hose the amount (and shape) that we want and it stays put.  No more hose all over the place.Price was fantastic.My husband no longer complains about draining the tanks.  (Best PRO of all)CONSNone.
summary: BEST sewer hose we've owned.  Fits in a 4" bumper!

reviewText: Replacement for 12 year old RV sewer hose. Well made and seems like it should last. Has a good length and tight fittings. So far no spills or leaks. It's a stinky job but when the tank's full...

I love it! Never thought I'd say that about a sewer hose, but this one is really pretty cool. Very light, but seems really durable for the money, I guess time will tell. It actually compresses to about 3 1/2 feet, and is easy to store in the bumper, and you only have to extend it out for as much as you need, instead of having to deal with flaking out a bunch of hose, and looping it all over your site to hook up. Both ends swivel 360 degrees, so there's no hose flipping to connect to the sewer, and they have locking rings on both ends to keep the hose in place once secured, so there's no chance of the hose jumping out when the BIG SURGE comes when dumping! The sewer connection has a 90 on it, and a univervsal fitting that threads into most sewer dumps. Both ends have locking caps. Only one observation, but this is not a a fault of the hose, just a tip. Because this hose will actually compress into 3 1/2 feet at the slightest pressure( like pushing it into your 8' bumper)you might consider tieing a string to the end, and extending it out of the cap on your bumper, so you can pull it out if it slides to the other end during transit. Shipping was lightning fast. Just a couple days with normal shipping. Don't waste you're money on express, you won't need it.
Bought this for my new camper and the system is so easy to use and well built.  Easy to clean.

I love how this hose expands and then shrinks back down with little work. It's easily the strongest hose I've ever used and the swivel ends are a huge benefit. The only problem I've found is that it doesn't fit in my bumper storage but it does come with locking caps to keep it sealed up.
It is easy to connect, especially with the plastic support (Camco 43041 RV 15' Sidewinder Plastic Sewer Hose Support), easy to use and very flexible. Makes dumping a breeze!

In my experience Camco makes the toughest, most durable sewer hoses in the business. If you've ever had an inferior sewer hose split and spray its contents, as I have, you'll agree with me that buying the best is a wise investment. Camco claims to make the "world's toughest sewer hose." My experience with their hoses (and others) supports their claim.This durable Rhino Flex sewer hose compresses to a length of less than five feet but will stretch as long as fifteen feet. Some RVs can store the sewer hose inside a hollow four-inch square rear bumper. This hose will compress short enough to fit into such a bumper.The bayonet fitting on the "top end" of the hose fits the waste outlet of the RV, while the other end has a permanently attached 90 degree fitting that uses the included adapter to make a water-tight fit with many modern campground sewer connections. This sewer hose should stretch long enough to work at most campsites, but if more than one sewer hose is needed, this hose must be the last one in the chain. End caps are also included that seal both ends of the sewer hose when it's in storage. Then there's no dribble or drool.
summary: Toughest Sewer Hose for Recreational Vehicles

reviewText: hose works great and has all the required hookups needed at a camp site.  The only down side it with the hookups on it it will not fir in the sewer hose holder in the rv, so I put it in its own container and it works fine.  I also come with caps to seal up both ends while transporting.

Much easier to handle than those slinky type hoses. More compact as well. Fit right in the rear bumper expect for the large orange piece that actually fits into the park system. Great buy as well here on Amazon.
I haven't found the RV sewer hose I love yet (5 stars). This one works and if punctured or torn, the ends can be saved and only have to replace the hose coil.

OK I'm NOT going to say I "love" a sewer hose, but this is a great product and deserves 5 stars.  Whoever you are, you're BRILLIANT for designing this!  Just completed a 6000mile, 2+ month trailer trip and this setup worked flawlessly!  Never evn had a problem with it not being long enough to reach a sewer outlet.
summary: You will really appreciate this product

reviewText: Easy to hook up, easy to clean out, never leaked, very durable.  Would buy again if I needed another poo chute.

I have had many sewer hoses over the years. This one is the best for several reasons. It is well built, the head swivels and the sewer end comes off to allow you to connect to the screw-in type sewer sites much easier. It will connect to any type of sewer connection with ease. The other great thing about it is that by simply pushing the hose between one end and the other, it compacts into a short easily stored hose. I have another Rhino which is uncrushable which this one is not, but it also doesn't compact together for storage like this one. Only thing to be careful of is that you make absolutely sure that the connections to the sewer are tight before draining the tank.

to figure out how to place the end couplings on the hose.  However, once I did figure it out, I like using this hose. It is longer than the cheapie conventional hosse and the fittings make it convenient.  It's still a messy job dealing with RV waste but this product does make it easier.

We've set this up 3 times since we left on our trip April 27th. Today, the 3rd time hooking it up, the elbow completely separated from the hose. Now with about 1/2 roll of duct tape holding it on it's still dripping. Flimsy, there are others out there worth the $$$ This isn't!
Much better than the hose that came with the camper. More than I expected for the price! If you need one, this is a good one!!!
summary: Wish I could say I love it but it IS A SEWER HOSE...

reviewText: We beat this to death and it stands up to the nasty job! Flexible but rigid enough to stretch out long distant.  Collapses well for storage too.
Received product on time.  Haven't used it yet but it seems like a quality Sewer Hose.  Planning a trip within a few weeks and will evaluate after using the Sewer Hose.
summary: Sewer Hose Kit with Swivel Fitings

reviewText: We have used 5 different hoses and this is the best by far.  Solid made, sturdy, and it holds its shape really well.Sealable caps for both ends when not in use and it has an adaptor elbow on one end.  I havent found a connection yet it wouldn't fit.Only word of advise, where the elbow meets the adaptor you need some weight to make sure it holds together.  I have not had it come apart yet as it just clips together, but the potential for a mess is there.  Use a bean bag weight and you are set for a worry free connection.

I read all the reviews that indicated this one was the one to own. I have not been disappointed with it, although right now our camping has only been three to four times a year and mainly for weekends. The only bad thing that happened after several uses was the elbow came off the hose trying to dump. It appears likely to have been due to the collar slowly getting loosened over time with use as I was able to basically screw it back on tight - just something to be mindful of. I have been happy with the purchase!
summary: Good item living up to the billing

reviewText: Nice, well made sewer hose.  Buy one before your first camping trip.  The cheaper ones leak and have bad connections.  You want a solid, well-made hose that has tight fittings.  This RinoFLEX is all that!  Leaks are messy and stink!  The swivel fittings make connections easy and tight.  The connector has threads at different diameters so you can make a solid connection at any campground or dumpsite.
this product extends and retracts to fit in your bumper.  Nice product and glad to have it, ended it up throwing out the flexible one I had earlier.
Seems to be a quality product so far. Like the fact that they aren't like a limp noodle that's hard to control

I made my purchase from Amazon.  Best price on the web and famous service.  I seen the RhinoFlex in action after camping with friends.  They had purchased theirs at a camper store and paid about $12 more for their kit.  Hooks up fast and maintains it's shape.  Swivel system makes for a mindless attachment to your dump valve.
this did not work on my motorhome, so I returned it and am having the RV experts decide what to do with my setup
summary: RhinoFLEX 15' Sewer Hose Kit with Swivel Fitting

reviewText: This is a great hose, the fittings are very high quality and the water tight end caps are a godsend. It will fit in a 4" bumper, you just have to align the connectors properly. I have found that its easier to get it back out of the bumper if you load it with the straight connector going in first.

I took me a while to read the fine print on how to secure the ends. I had some leaking until I re-mounted the ends. With my 5' extension, the bayonet end of this one still leaks slightly. I bought replacement gaskets I plan to install soon.
summary: Works pretty well, but needs attention

reviewText: Forget those cheap made sewer hoses that come with your camper. Spend the money for these Rhino's and you will not be dissatisfied. These are collapsible and easily stored. swivel connections make them a breeze to hook up. Just remember to unscrew one of the storage caps prior to extending hose, otherwise the hose will not extend easily. this is due to the excellent seal provided by the caps.AAA+++

This replaces an older Rhinoflex that we have had for 5 years.  The old one still works but was getting rust stains on the hose which means the metal spring inside is exposed. This should work better because it swivels.
This blackwater drainage hose and connections is of good quality material and construction.  I can recommend it based on my usage of it in several trips in my RV.  Easy to use and to store.
This hose has been the best one I've seen. I have no complaints so far. Easy to hook up with no leaks. Really like how it shrinks down for storage.

For years I have struggled with floppy hoses that bend and expand which makes securing them difficult.  Once sewage loads them up they start flopping all over.  This is only a few dollars more, the connections are secure (I always double check any fitting) and the hose is far more sturdy. If you cheap out the consequences can be hideous.

Well designed and sturdy. Connectors work well and are secure. After I purchased it I found a newer mode that does not crush if you step on it. So far that has not been a problem but I have not had kids running around, etc.
Great hose.  I have used other hoses and keep throuwing them away. I hate those flimsy ones that tear and hard to store. This hose collaspes up well and is tough. I also like the locking fittings.

I purchased this when I bought my first camper.  It's so easy to use, much better than the stock one that the dealer gives you and less messy.  Has caps to close the hose so you can control any possible odors from the hose.  I wouldn't buy any other sewer hose.
We really like this hose and the fittings.  It has been the best dump hose we've ever had.  Don't try to skimp of your sewer hose.  Buy this one and you need to  buy another for a LONG time.
summary: It you really want a good hose, get this one

reviewText: Used this product for the first time today.  It worked great as described. It has easy to use connections. The tubes just fit into the bumper storage area.  I used another plastic bin for the elbow.  The end caps is a nice to have. I used them to keep the mess to a minimum after flushing the system.
Works good, but have to be careful with the ends. They tend to want to twist off the hose at times, but can be twisted back on.
summary: Works good, but have to be careful with the ends

reviewText: It simply works. Nuff said. (Wish it were longer) Is the standard diameter so it fits practically ALL hose carriers (but not some, check you hose carrier diameter).

Had to replace my old, torn RV sewer hose. Debated about paying extra for a premium hose, but I'm glad I did. This hose is heavy-duty & there's no reason it shouldn't last longer than my RV. Plus, the way it accordians allows the coils to be extended or remain compressed as needed. This makes it easy to customize the length & bends to accommodate the requirements of each hookup without having to deal with extra length.I'm well satisfied.
summary: A High Quality RV Sewer Hose

reviewText: Hose condenses into a stiff pieced, making it easy to store.  Caps on each end are a nice touch.  Only complaint is that the universal nozzle doesn't fit in the bumper storage bar.

This is a really nice, heavy duty sewer hose and I love the connectors and how the hose can be shaped and not just a flexible hose  like most trailer come with.  My pop-up trailer's 4 inch bumper has the bed supports riveted to it, so there are four protrusions on the inside of the bumper making this hose not fit.  I could remove the orange connectors to make it fit, but I decided to mount a Rubbermaid 1172 ActionPacker Storage Box, 24 Gallon on top of the bumper with square U-bolts and it works perfectly.  I am also able to store my Camco 43041 15' Sidewinder Plastic Sewer Hose Support and Tri-Lynx 00018 Lynx Stop 'N Chock Interlocking Wheel Chocks in the container!I love that this hose has two end caps to keep the liquids from dripping out, yuck!!!!
summary: Really nice sewer hose, but does not fit in my 4 in square pop-up trailer bumper

reviewText: I originally wanted just 4 caps, but after seeing pricing and the fact that I do lose them every now and then I just bought this pack and put the extras in my tool box. They look fine to me, but I drive a Honda Fit base model and don't care about looks, only saving $$$. So if you have a fancy car you may want to look into something nicer.
summary: good buy, good to have extras...

reviewText: Every time I have my tires rotated, it ends up with a selection of mismatched valve caps.  I don't much care exactly what the caps look like, but something in me wants them to match.  Yah ... I'm the guy who likes all the presidents facing the same way in my wallet.  A little weird but harmless. This will be nice.  If I get the car back with a mismatch, I can just pull one from my bag and replace it.  Also, some idiot stole an ordinary plastic cap from my motorcycle.  With these I can make them match again.
summary: I'm a little strange this way.

reviewText: This should be in every home garage. Caps get lost and broken all the time. For the price you cannot afford not to have them handy. Driving without caps may ruin you valves.I wish those were black to match most regular caps supplied with the car or tire change.
summary: Helpful to have in your garage

reviewText: Ever get your car back and it is missing one of these tire valve caps?  Well that is what has happened to me many times.  I decided to buy a big pack and I am getting my use out of them.

They're really cheap but well enough made to do the job. I no longer have to worry about losing valve caps and searching the ground for an hour trying to locate them. I just reach into the box of 50 and get another.One box might last you a lifetime.
summary: One box might last you a lifetime.

reviewText: Not much to say here except they match my TPMS stems pretty well and its great to have a bunch of spares
The software installed fine.  I can read the error code from my BMW.  The engine temperature read seems correct too.  I didn't try other functions.

I had to return this product because it was defective.The scanner failed to mate with my onboard computer on my 2004 Toyota Corolla.I purchased a CANOBD2 CAR READER,which was a perfect mate.I highly recommend the latter. Not that the ELMSCAN 5 COMPACT was a lesser produced product. I had to return it for the reason stated above.ElmScan 5 Compact USB OBD-II Scan Tool & OBDWiz Engine Diagnostic Software (423001)

This product works great. Plug it into your laptop then the port an click on the software and it pops up. You can read rpm, coolant temp, speed, intake temp, manifold pressure, any check engine code that is wrong with the car, and also your oxygen sensors!! Pick which  state you live in and it will tell you if you will pass! The spedometer just reads off the computer so im not sure if its 100% accurate. Great for mainly reading check engine codes!!
always satisfied with scantools! i have purchased several for my friends over the years and all of them are satisfied! great product!

I was able to get this device working without any issues. However the software is very limited and the USB wire gets in the way if you are trying to collect data while on the road. If I had to do it all over again, I would have picked a wireless device that sends data to your cell phone.
summary: Not bad but consider wireless alternatives

reviewText: Its more than just a OBD code reader.I purchased this primarily to diagnose and clear a CEL on my car.  To my surprise this item does more than that, it has quite a bit of features that I have yet to learn.  Definitely got my moneys worth..

A while back, I bought a ScanGauge II.  Great device.  Can't say enough good things about it.  I liked it so much, I installed it permanently in the dashboard of one of my cars.  Big mistake.  I've got several cars, and now I can't use the ScanGauge II on any of the other cars.  My multi-vehicle use ScanGauge II became a solo-vehicle use device like my Superchips Custom TuningSCT SF3 FORD Power Flash Handheld Programmer (3015)I needed something to use with my other cars, do a little bit more than just read & clear diagnostic trouble codes, and not spend a fortune.ElmScan 5 was my solution.  For the price, it's a lot better value than just some little code reader.  I'm able to "see" everything my car's computer sees, and it runs on my netbook with Windows 7.  The free software that the device comes with is sufficient for most users.  The "pro" is that you can upgrade the software and get manufacturer specific software for Ford, Mazda, & GM.  The "con" is that you have to pay to upgrade the software.  Who the heck wants to spend a few hundred dollars more?With a cable splitter, I ran myLenovo Ideapad S10-3 0647-2AU 10.1-Inch Netbook (Black)&Microsoft Windows 7 Ultimate Upgrade Package GLC00186 GLC-00186with the included software, alongside theScanGauge II 3-in-1 Compact Multifunction Vehicle Computer with Customizable Display.  I'm impressed by what it does for the money.  On my ScanGauge II, I can "see" horsepower, torque, and transmission gear ratio & fluid temperature - none of which I was able to "see" with the ElmScan 5's included software.  However, the Enhanced Diagnostics add-on gives me over 600 parameters that my ScanGauge II does not offer.This is a "must have" for any driveway grease monkey.  And you just look cool when you can plug a laptop into the car like those guys at the dealership do.  Never mind that you don't really know what you're looking at, or know how to interpret what all those displays really mean.

I had some trouble getting it to connect and the connection wasn't solid. None the less I was able to read my check engine light and read some data like fuel trim, rmp, etc. It's a great tool for $30.
summary: Works good for what it is

reviewText: one of the first scanners and disk i have works easy and better than all others ive purchased,id give it a 10.

I had no problem installing the software or hardware. I previously had a "Generic" Unit, this one blows it away. All the scantool.net software detects this as a "Real" Scantool.net tool.Note: I installed this on a Toshiba Netbook with no problem.
If you are a DIY person, this sort of thing is a must have.  The unit I got is a bit finicky, but other than that, having this product has saved me over 1K in repair costs already.
summary: Must have for the DIY guy

reviewText: This scanner and software does exactly what it says, if you need more advanced diagnostics you can also purchase better software.  I had no problems installing the software and hardware on my windows 7 laptop, and the software recognized the scanner just fine.  So it works, I'm happy.
summary: Does what is says - works great

reviewText: Installation and set up are easy and works extremely well. Has saved us hundreds of dollars in mechanic bills by troubleshooting simple problems that seem big. I have used this for my Chevy Blazer, Silverado, and more recently my wife's Hyundai.  Example: My wife came home and told me her car was bucking during acelleration from a stop. I hooked the scanner up to the car and my laptop quick scan revealed that there was a misfire in the #2 cylinder. clicked on the code resource (Must be online) and gave potential issues and what to check first. Replaced plugs and wires (cheapest possible fix first) then rescanned, still had the same issue, next step was replace the coil pack. Installed new coil pack that serves the #2 cylinder (10 minute replacement) reran scan and trouble code was clear, all is well. If I had gone to a mechanic it still would have taken 2 days and probably a couple hundred dollars. This scanner is worth 10X its weight in gold. Buy one now, even if your a novice.

This is a great tool to get you started in the world of OBD2 diagnostics.  Granted it is based on the cheaper ELM micro-controllers, it sill has enough spunk to get the job done.  With the bundled software you can get significant detail on your car's operating status, as well as reset MIL codes and check what MIL codes are present/queued/not-completed.With an ELM based chip, you are very limited on some of the more advanced features of the CANBUS.  Things like extended CAN addressing and modifications are not easy, and in some cases, not possible with an ELM chip.  If you would like more control over your CANBUS, as well as open the possibility of advanced CAN functions, you may want to consider a device that is using an MCP2515 chip.

I wanted to try and get this to work in linux under wine but couldn't. So I put windows on a different laptop disk a few weeks later. The product works and is very helpful to get data off vehicles. However, the extra software that builds graphs and other items requires verification codes that were provided on a piece of paper. I lost them and so I can't use more of the advanced tools.Imho, the number should be on the scanner, but keep track of the paperwork until you are sure it works.

Hands down has to be one of the best investments I ever made into my tool collection. In this day and age, an OBDII scan tool is a MUST, even for the garage mechanic. This product performs very well, and has handled everything I have thrown at it. I utilize this in conjunction with my laptop, which allows me to retrieve even more information via the internet. As long as i'm working anywhere on my property, I can pick up the wi-fi and use it in conjunction with the supplied software (mobile data can be used also). This is extremely helpful due to the fact that the program will help you find RELEVANT information regarding a solution to any trouble codes it may have found. And for the price, you really can't go wrong. A final note, this scan-tool includes only the adapter and software, and does not have any type of display. This tool requires either a laptop or a desktop in close proximity to the vehicle. In the near future I also plan to install the software on my cell phone and keep the harness in the vehicle, essentially allowing me to be prepared in case of any unexpected problems while on the road (myself or other motorists)

I've started to replace my interior RV dome lights with LED lights to reduce power consumption, etc.  These little bulbs work great for that purpose, however, they don't put out the same lumens as the 18W bulbs that I am replacing.  These are the very white LED's.  The warmer version of this bulb puts out even less lumens, according to the distributor's site.  The good news is that these only use 1.4 watts of energy.  The reason for the lower output is that these are the smaller 3528 SMD's (surface mounted diodes).  If you want more light, as I do, then get a bulb using the larger 5050 SMD's that use 0.2 watts per diode.  For example, theT10 Base 10 SMD 5050 LED White Side Pin10-30V DC Bulb, 1438WHflat bulb has ten of the 5050 SMD's and uses 2 watts of energy, and gives you 160 lumens rather than the 106 lumens of this bulb.  Another example: theWhite Bright SMD LED T10 Lighting Wedge 1415WH 2821, 2825, 168, 194, W5W, 158, 147, 152, 159, 161, 184, 192, 193, 901, 904, 916, 917, 918, 920, 921, 922, 923, 926, 927.bulb has thirteen 5050 SMD's for a total power consumption of 2.6 watts and perhaps 200+ lumens (I haven't purchased these bulbs yet, but the price is too good to be true).  I will do an update when I buy a few more bulbs including the super brightBrightest LED Replacements for Malibu Landscape light T10 Wedge Base 18 x 5050 SMD 12v Ac/dc, 1441WHbulb with eighteen 5050 SMD's and uses 3.6 watts, and puts out a whopping 288 lumens!  The size may be a problem, however.The bottom line is that this is a great bulb if you only want about 100 lumen of white light, which is equivalent to a 10 watt incandescent bulb.  This is also a polarity sensitive bulb: if it doesn't work one way, flip it over.

My stock crappy incandescent light in the cargo area of my 5 door car could quite literally not light up anything more than 6 inches away, and it was an annoying yellow light.This could probably light up my entire car if there weren't seats in the way.It's not really as long/big as it looks. It should fit just about any wedge socket (remember LEDs are polar, and only work in one direction, so flip it around if it doesn't work). I have a tiny little socket in the cargo area that looks like it couldn't fit anything, but this fit in it with nearly a half inch left.It's not my idea of cool white, it's very white, not at all yellow or blue. But that's good, I think the bluer they look, the more trashy it looks.
summary: Better than I could have asked for

reviewText: The Good.  the size is perfect, fits in tight spaces because they are only about1.5" long, the light out put is great for softer accent lighting when bright reading light is not needed and they are at a great price.  The bad, they get hot.  Almost as hot as the incondecent bulbs.  Not someting I would expect from an LED.  The Ugly, I will not trust these to be left on unattended because they get so hot.  I like to leave a light on in the RV when we are out but on these.  I have other LEDs that stay cool and will leave them on. I would not buy these again because of this.

We purchased this light to replace the bulb in our RV range hood.  It fit just fine and gives off a nice bright light.  It is a cool blue color and I would have preferred something a little warmer/yellower, but given the price, I think it is a great product.

I am getting a fast education on LED lighting after beginning to replace the bulbs in my trailer. This light puts out a very white light but it does not project a lot of light. (Does that make sence) I have dual bulb fixtures, I replaced one of them with this bulb. When the fixture is turned on your first reaction is wow that is bright since it is much whiter. However when covering one half at a time and looking at what is being lit you notice it does not project as much light. The 921 bulb I was replacing is rated at 270 lumens these are only 105. They may be good for other areas but I have no use for them. Bottom line look for lumens values for sufficient lighting.

I was hoping to use this on my RV's license plate holder, but the bulb is longer than the 194 incandescent bulb that was in there. I was able to use it for the stove hood light though, so all is not lost. Just thought I'd post a review so that others can consider its length before placing an order.
summary: Bulb was too long for my license plate holder.

reviewText: This power cable and its insulator, plug ends and terminals themselves are all heavy duty.  Made to last a lifetime.  There is no doubt that an individual that takes care of their personal property could get a lifetime of usage out of this cable. The right angle connector fits nicely into the Merinco 30amp/125 volt outlet and secures tightly with the threaded black nut that is integrated upon the right angle connector.The yellow, exterior cable sheathing is thick enough to withstand abrasions and any possible gouges or cuts that could arise.  Very durable composition.  Not sure how it would roll up in cool or cold weather, seems it might be a slight challenge.  That trade off is easy to deal with however when I do not have to worry about potential fire hazards when using this high quality cable.  I can sleep all night when using this power cord, not having to worry about some mishap due to sloppy connections, ampacity overlaod, etc;Chris
summary: Very stout, heavy duty power cable.

reviewText: The twist locking connector has become the industry standard over the last few years.  And for good reason.  The old style (through hole-pull out cord) had some real disadvantages.  Namely that there was big friggin' hole in the side of your camper.  Water, insects, small animals all had a way in.  Not a problem twist lockers.  But the problem that has been introduced is the idea that you have a fairly heavy cord pulling on it's own wiring and torqueing the coupler on the side of your camper...Enter the ParkPower Right Angle...  This is one of those "DUH" innovations that just makes you wonder why no one thought of it sooner.  With the cord's weight pulling straight down as opposed to jutting out and torqueing the plug the life of the cord should be much longer.  The cord itself is a genuine Marinco branded product with a 30A Hubble locking connector and threaded lock ring.  It's a weather proof 10ga cord and is designed as a drop in replacement for travel trailers and 5th wheel campers with 30A locking inlets.I do have one complaint.  My connection is a bit loose.  It's doesn't wiggle but at the same time it's not as firm to turn as the original was and as my 30A-15A pigtail is.  If the cord were bumped and turned AND the lock ring were improperly connected to the TT it could become disconnected.  However as long as the lock ring is installed this shouldn't happen.  And it's not going to come undone when it's in the vertical position, only when it's rotated about 30 degrees.  It does ship with a second lock ring for mating with the new style of Marinco inlets.  The locking ring has a notch which fits into a track and turns about an 1/8 of a turn making this a true twist on twist off setup.  I haven't changed the locking rings on mine yet though I do intend to.  I will update then.
Locks in securely.  Easy to handle with the nice pistol-grip.  The right-angle makes it unlikely to be tripped over, as does the bright yellow color.All around, it's great.
summary: Why aren't all RV plugs like this?

reviewText: I purchased this because I lost the one that came with my rv. I like it much better because it is more flexible, has the right angle configuration which reduces strain on the rv receptacle, and comes with a second connector ring that allows a simple bayonet-style attachment that is easier to connect than the threaded one I had before. I didn't realize the electrical outlet on the rv even had this bayonet type attachment possibility. A nice surprise when I received this cord..
summary: Better than the original that came with my rv

reviewText: Purchased to use with pp301elrv. Very well made, good-looking product.one of the best mods I have done to our rv!
It's a long yellow right angle locking cord.  I used it all summer at dozens of campgrounds and I always had power, so it must be perfect.
summary: It transfers electricity from one outlet to another exactly as it should.

reviewText: Spend a little extra and get this power cord, you will not regret it.  The hookup is fast and the cable is flexible.

This is a very nice cord that coils up nice and small (small enough to fit in a cable bag), and the right-angle connector means that the cord, as it comes out of the female end, isn't trying to pull itself out of the strain relief.  The pistol-grip handle is super easy to use, and alignment with the twist-lok socket on my trailer is quick, without having to check to see which tab aligns with which slot - just have the handle about 15 degrees from vertical, insert, then twist to vertical and to lock in place.  And, on my trailer, the included quick-connect locking ring is just right, making hook-up super easy.  Yes, it's a bit pricey, but I'm really happy with it.  Oh, and the bright yellow color makes it easy to see (duh!), so that I'm just a little bit less likely to trip over it.

This is a very nice cord set and it's 30 feet long.  Problem is that it's $20+ over many other vendors that show up on Google.  Shop arpound for this cord.Update:  8/4/2012 - After much price searching I've concluded this cord is priced about on an average with other cords of similar length.

The product description shows the size as 15x15x4 inches which is likely to be the size of the cordset when it is coiled but it tells me nothing as to the length of the cord when it is uncoiled - important information and as the seller is Amazon there is no one to phone or email to request the information.
summary: No information as to length of the cord

reviewText: Well I hope Amazon Returns goes smoothly, because just after I opened the box, I found that I had received a defective unit.The problem is with the rotating lens. In the 12 oclock position, the detente is loose and sloppy. How would you like to film 3 hours of video only to find out that the picture tilted halfway through?Other people have complained on the contour web site and contour said they will replace the cameras with loose detentes. I assume they will replace them with refurbished/repaired units, so thats why I went right to Amazon returns.A minor second problem is that the software installer uses a program called prcview.exe, which macaffee calls flags as potentially unwanted. I have installed tons of software over the years and none has triggered alerts from macafee antivirus.

Update 9-16-2010 This is no longer their top of the line cam - the new one is based on this camera but includes a GPS and tags your images with location.  You'll need their viewer to see the map movement as the video plays.Update: 7-2010Tonights episode of Dirty Jobs showed this camera strapped to a head strap for the host, Mike Rowe, who was 408 feet above the cement floor decending & window cleaning in Hawaii.  Troy chickened out on the first 100 feet so alot of the contour HD footage made it into the show.  By the 300 foot balcony they got troy on the ropes but his hair got snagged in the safely line and had to get his second "shearing" on Dirty Jobs - it was also filmed on contour HD cams 300' above hawaii.  The quality was as good as the cable company could deliver in their 6:1 re-compression of HD.  A full HD viewfinderless camera has value when you must get the shot.using a sandisk 16GB microSD card and the maximum detail [1080P] + best quality I could get 3 hr, 6 minutes of video recorded with battery leftover.  If you use the lower resolution setting the battery may be the limiting factor - I have not tried that yet.I bought this to produce a bluray disc of a police helicopter team, using a gyro stabilized canon professional camera in back and wanting a 2nd angle up front.  This comes with an adhesive patch that sticks to the side of the pilot's helmet to give a 135 degree wide field of view.  The integrated rails on both sides permit the ultimate flexibility in mounting the camera, and second options for this cam are car mounts, etc.The quality is GREAT.  The lens is the downfall - there is some pincushion effect due to the inexpensive lens and wide angle.  I'll deal with it for the price and the shots you can get with it, plus I can trim out the distortion in post editing.One note - the output is .mov which is fine for macs, but for pc's you will need to transcode if you run premiere pro cs4 from adobe as it does not import .mov natively.  Perhaps that is a good time to clip the edges where the bent picture is most noticable.Another factor to like is the simplicity.  With gloved hands you slide the top forward to record and back to stop, with a beep to start and and double beep to stop - it's very hard to mess up except for your horizon, which is why there are detents and lasers.Detents and lasers?Yes, - there are detents in the event you mount it on the right and left hand side of a helmet or rotate it in a mount.  The 2 lasers can be turned on to tell you what is level with resepect to the imager.  This is helpful when you rotate it but you must manually keep track of the bottom of the screen (below the laser points ) as you rotate it, otherwise your output will be upside down.For the price, you simply can not beat it.  Buy a 16 GB sandisk micro-sd card to go with itSandisk 16GB Microsd CardNote that they have a low packaging option which the card is inside a plastic carrier and inside an ESD bag but no box or other trash with it that goes in the landfill - smart packaging.One of the other great applications for this is taking HD video where you otherwise would NOT take your $3K camera - the beach - the water park - etc.  You won't get the absolute best quality but you will get 1080 p hd that is playable on macs or pcs in native players!Another great use is for children.  It's easy to use, inexpensive, and highdef.  For the kids who are beyond the toy grade cameras but not ready for a professional unit, this fills the gap.  Adults will love its simplicity.  On or Off - no fancy buttons to press, and everything complex is set while attached to the computer.Finally there is my use - have a 2nd angle view for use with NLE systems.  You can now do a/b video fades by time syncing the output from this camera with your primary cam.  Be sure to expose something that will sync the two that gets recorded on both at the start of shootng.I'm only deducting a star becuase of the pincushion effect of the lens.  I realize for this price you are not getting an HD lens, and I realize that HD will show any defects, but a few more dollars in the lens would have made this 5 stars - it is oh so close.  Be sure to pick up extra memory and batteries if you plan to use it at maximum definition because it makes some big files fast.
summary: Dirty Jobs uses this where big cams dont go /great 2nd angle cam

reviewText: I believe my camera was closer to 99 dollars as it's an older version. I bought it as a dash camera and also use it for sporting events and track days. Honestly it's not bad, but it's not great; looks a whole hell of a lot better than the old GO PRO's but the audio quality if not up to par, the mic on these gives up the ghost at around 25-30 miles an hour. I plan on getting a second recorder for Track days and other driving events and it will probably be a go pro gen 3. However I can highly recommend the Contour as a lower priced alternative.

I  like this model for simple use, the hard part was getting the sight pictucte set up without the helmet in the frame, the laser points are helpful, not in daylight in the feild, I have two of these  and my wife managed to lose bury my first one  so i havent had a chance to try the water housing, Not sure what class of card to get , the gopro HD2 requires class 10 mem cards, does anyone know if this is benifit this contour,. I purchased this unit to put on my motorcycle for taking videos of my ride.  Here is my initial impression.Size - Smaller than I anticipated and very light weight.Fit/Finish - Very nice feel to the unit.  It does not feel cheaply made, the exterior is metal and seems to be durable.  The only flaw I really thing this has in the rubber rear cover that caps the switches that adjust the video settings and where you put your MicroSD card.  Kind of cheap feeling there but no issues to date.Performance:Video Recording - Works very well in daylight or moving into evening use.  This has a very wide field of focus.  What I mean by that is: I first used this in my truck.  I mounted this on a RAM mount on my dashboard and placed the lens almost touching the windshield.  Ran the video for an hour or so and on playback, I saw lots of hood as well as my drive path.  You really need to experiment with camera placement to get more of the scenery vs car/motorcycle body parts.Have not tried low light recording but night recording plain is non-existent but then it is not an infrared camera.Battery performance - Very good.I recorded four hours of SD video with no issues on a 16gb card.  I am still playing with settings on best usages vs footage.Sound - it will record sound (got my radio as some background music in my truck) but not loudly and really isn't designed to capture it well in my opinion.Accessories:There are several types of mounts.  You will want to get an extension arm if you plan on using this inside a car so that you can maneuver the camera easily on the dash.  RAM makes some mount accessories as well that I have used for my GPS and Cell phone on my motorcycle and car so I stuck with that so I would not need to buy different vendor stuff.  Check around for your best choice of product.Overall Impression.  A good buy.  I am looking forward to springtime for some mountain riding and see how well it captures the twisty roads of the Blue Ridge Mountains in the spring bloom.Good luck.

I needed to upgrade my jack as I began to work on my car more and more. My previous jack was a craftsman  2-1/4 ton Floor Jack and using the OTC jack was a world of difference. The OTC jack had no trouble lifting up my cars whole front end, which really made it efficient by being able to place two jack stands on either side at once rather than jacking up one side at a time (it really is a big convenience).This jack is very light compared to others 2-ton jacks and I love the dual piston feature this has. The pumping action is indeed quick. The jack stands are also a delight. Very light, strong, and no bickering when putting the pin through the hole to set the height of the jack stand. The jack handle is a two-piece design and snaps togetherI've had the OTC jack for a little over two years and the jack failed on me while I was using it back in 6/13 (almost a year ago). I was working on my brothers car, on the brakes, jacked up the whole front, placed the jack stands, and that is when the jack began to fail. the Jack didn't make any noise to indicate the failure. What happened was the oil just started to leak out in fast amounts. I had to use my craftsman jack to take off the jackstands.I contacted OTC shortly after, and although I can't exactly remember what happened, the overall process was hassle-free and OTC ended up replacing my whole jack! I was very surprised they OTC didn't try to put the blame on me or whatnot. I did, however, send them pictures of the jack failing, the oil, etc (I'll post the same pictures up here, too).Since then, the jack has been very solid and still use it with confidence (of course, I am still using the jack stands, but this practice should be done with any and every hydraulic jack). I really like working with this jack so it would have been a real bummer if OTC didn't honor their lifetime warranty.
I am impressed with the quality of this jack and set. Very easy to use and I recommend to anyone.
summary: I dig this jack and set

reviewText: Overall, a good product. I did have to return the first jack I was shipped because it leaked oil all over my floor when I turned the pole to the left. The added jack stands are a great considering the price of this jack. Quality is substantially better than two or three units I had purchased from Napa.

I love buying quality products and buying them online.  This was no exception. I purchased this jack on a promotion for 20% bringing the total to around $240.This jack is great for a few reasons, which of course aren't inherit to this jack alone.1. It's aluminum.  After using steel jacks for so long, the aluminum is a real dream.  It's so easy to move around where I want under the car.  It's even easier to push around the garage. It rolls amazingly, partially by the front wheel design.  You may think it's not a big deal to push a steel jack around, but that's because you've never had an aluminum jack.2. The jack gets to max height very quickly with minimal effort compared to the craftsman jacks I have used which is a great thing.3. The jack stands are great.  They have a pin to lock them into place which makes me feel really safe.  They're also really light and convenient.4. Build quality seems great and the jack and stands are beautiful looking.  I'm totally pleased with my purchase.If you're looking to buy a quality product you want to keep for a lifetime this is it.

This is an extremely useful product.  I carry it in my RV for immediate repairs to something like a damaged roof, but it is good for so much more.  It sticks to almost anything, and the exterior white surface seems unaffected by sun and UV.  Here in southern Colorado, most plastic is quickly damaged, but not this white tape.  Even after several years in the sun, it looks like new on the exposed surface.  You still have to find the leak, but one application of this product is the end of it.

I have sealed my last two trailers with Eternabond, and will continue to do so with all future trailers. This stuff is phenomenal. No more maintaining the roof twice a year here in AZ. I can check the seals in under 5 minutes and get back to enjoying the camper rather than working on it. Read the instructions carefully, prep is key, and be sure to get a good roller.
summary: Save your roof, and your time

reviewText: This worked perfectly for my RV fix.  Was much cheaper than in town and I think it is going to last a long time.  The key to this super-thick, super-sticky tape (imagine 4x thicker duct tape with vinyl on top) is to CLEAN WELL and PLAN YOUR CUTS.  You only get one chance to lay this stuff down!!  I am very pleased.
This product does exactly as it is suppose to do for patching or covering the exposed areas on the roof of my RV.  Good product and it arrived as scheduled.
Front and rear top seal of the RV, PERFECT.  I have found other uses around the house as well, but it is great in RVs
seals tight, seals permanently, stays flexible for parts that settle or move, or expand and contract over time. I could almost re-roof the whole R.V. if i had enough rolls of this stuff..
Spendy but easy to apply & I think you couuld've patched the hole in the Titanic..great stuff

I have had good success and it seems to be long lasting.  The only problem that I have had was with surface preparation.  If you don't get it just right, it won't stick as well as it can.  In the areas that I did it right (not sure the difference), it is really on there.  I used acetone to clean the area but I think the surface may be too porous.  I think the surface prep material that the same company makes and markets must be the ticket but I couldn't find it here on Amazon.  I'll get some of that and see if it makes a difference and update later.

This stuff seals rubber roofs and many other things forever. Period. You need to read the instructions and the surface must be really clean preferably with solvent.You won't ever caulk again and it looks good.

I purchased this to repair a leaky RV roof.  I had a slit in my roof that was approximately 3 feet long.  Just a little cleaning and I was ready to apply the Eternabond.  This stuff is amazing.  If you are unsure, just buy a small amount, attach it to something and try to rip it off.  Good luck.  Once it's applied it's nearly impossible to remove without a heat gun.  A must have for any RV'er for those emergency repairs.
summary: Best product available for RV roof repair

reviewText: Purchased these to replace ones from Fit System, Model # 3891, bought from Amazon in 2012 and they where far worst for viewing obstructions when backing camper into tight spaces. The ones from Fit System are far superior for use in backing campers; you can see low tree branches, eves of buildings, carport post, etc. These mirrors look better than ones from Fit System and are easier to install the first time but they don't begin to compare to usefulness of ones from Fit Systems.If you want mirrors that are easy to install and look good buy these; if you want mirrors that work buy the ones from Fit System. Once you connect the ones from Fit Systems the first time they are a breeze to connect the next time.I highly recommend the ones from Fit Systems # 3891 from Amazon and half the price.

Once on these mirrors remained snug and in place for 14 hours of driving with no problems.  The mirrors have a snug adjustment, but that's a good thing becuase they don't bounce around very much while going down the road.  Some towing mirrors really vibrate while you're traveling and that can be pretty annoying after awhile.There are 4 peices to each mirror.  The mirror itself, the wedge bar to hold the mirror in place, and the bolt that applies pressure to the wedge to make sure the mirror doesn't move while driving down the road.  There's also a peice of stick on felt for the wedge bar so it doesn't rub your mirror.I had 2 problems with the design.1) The set srew that you turn to apply presure and hold the mirror in place was fine on the one mirror, but on the other mirror there was some much resistance when turning it that I thought I was going to snap the turn handle off.  After several slow attempts with some WD40 applied, it finally turned all the way in.  After a couple of installations the bolt has loosened a little and seems to be fine now.2) Wedge bar felt strip requires trimming, so it isn't cut to fit out of the box.  While this is a minor thing, it's still kind of a pain.  The other problem is that the wedge bar is loose when the mirrors aren't in use, so if you aren't careful you could loose the wedge and then the mirror would be useless.  The bolts stay in just fine due to friction, but I don't like having loose unattached peices on something like this becasue it never fails that at some point one of them will go missing and will probably happen while on the road.Overall these mirrors work well, I just wish they were designed a little differently.
summary: Did the job, but the products not perfect

reviewText: These do not give you the satisfaction that they are screwed on good. You can get them to work right if you mess with them and you definitely have to screw them down tight or they can fall off and ding your doors.

The design of this piece for the Tundra is pathetic in my opinion. It is not easy to get the thing on to where you feel it won't come off. You have to guarantee you align the circle portion on the back of the wedge with the hole so that the knob thread will contact it for proper clamping. It is not a guarantee of it staying on because of that and the rather flexible plastic shell. The ridges on the mirror portion itself forming a 'groove' for the wedge are too shallow to keep it in place while putting it on so it becomes a battle. Seems it would be better to have something like two velcro straps that would wrap around the mirror on the open end to secure it and making install easier and also if the ridges were higher to keep the wedge in the proper position. The mirror piece is not a real mirror (at least not in any real sense of what you a mirror to be) so don't expect any picture perfect view - it's adequate. I would not buy these again because I find it a meticulous pain in the butt to put them on and know they are on to stay. I'm an engineer and I hate inadequate engineering.
summary: Not the best but can work

reviewText: These serve their purpose , but fit on mirror is sloppy and the plastic lock down is cheesy. I've used them several times when pulling our camper. I remove them after every trip. I left them on once and my wife used the truck. when she got home passenger side mirror was missing. I actually drilled a hole on the drivers side so I can secure it with tie wire when in use.

I have had these mirrors for over 1 year and have not had the first problem.  When I got my truck I didn't want those big towing mirrors, so I tried these out.  Once you get them adjusted they will stay adjusted unless you push them with your thumb while taking them off like I do sometimes.  Also do not over tighten because they will start moving around a little bit.  But once you mastered on how much pressure to put them on with they stay put. I highly recommend them.  I drive a 2007 Toyota Tundra and they fit right over the standard mirrors  perfectly.
