reviewText: Purchased this plug to replace the one that came standard with our TT. Original strap broke after a year of normal use. This one is holding up well so far. *update May 2013 - time to replace the strap. Made it through one year of normal use. For $5 though, guess that isn't too bad.

My old plug cap had broken off and I liked the convenience of just being able to push this into the female end of the water line...instead of having to screw in a plug cap.  Very economical and I have ordered additional ones for backups.
The original plug was just crumbling and falling apart.  This universal replacementwas a cinch to install and fits great.  Nice essential unit for your rv rig.

This jump-starter, air compressor, inverter, is of excellent quality and usefulness.  As mentioned in other reviews, it would be nice if they included an AC power cord; and possibly a DC power/charging cord for the price.  This is a fairly large unit and takes up a large amount of room in a trunk or the back of a station wagon/hatchback.  It charges fast and has plenty of reserve power to start our motor home or inflate large tires. Great carry handle.UPDATE 19 May 2011:  The user manual was missing.  Now I need it to check something. Item itself is pretty user friendly.  Tried to download manual on website from manufacturer (UPGI.com) but no manuals or documents available from support.  None available from Energizer.  Tried Google.  No one has uploaded manual yet.  Finally found support 800 number for UPG Inc. which is also a wholesale/retail sales number.  Nice lady answered.  She took my name, email, telephone, address, etc.  Said she would "look around" for one and send it "somehow" if she finds one.Apparently, this is a "marketing arrangement" where they buy the use of the Energizer name, then import and distribute it.Design pretty good.  Sales-marketing good.  Support not so good.  Technical support essentially non-existant.  Downgraded to two stars.  Will post another update if I ever get the manual.
summary: Very handy product - but not much real customer support.

reviewText: This is a handy product i must say. An ALL-IN-ONE! But the fact still remains that the power inverter does not last to one's satisfaction. Infact, the power inverter cannot fill air into a new tyre. That is only it's disadvantage; Power inverter does not last!

This arrived well packaged in a manufacturer's box within a plain cardboard box within an Amazon shipping carton. No damage at all. What you get is the All-In-One and one of the most excellent operating instructions that are seldom seen anymore. It is written all in English using easily followed directions and outstanding illustrations. This is provided on a manageable 11" x 17" sheet that folds up to a 4" x 5 1/2" size for easy storage.AIR - To use the air compressor you simply pull out the cord that is located in a cubby hole in the rear of the All-In-One and press the connector onto whatever you want to inflate. There is a clearly marked pressure gauge on the front of the unit. The air compressor switch is located on the front right of the gauge and in a  box outlined in blue and marked "AIR". You can see this if you look closely at the online illustration. There are three different attachments, including a needle valve, stored on the back of the unit if you want to inflate a ball or whatever instead of a tire.JUMP - When using the Jump start feature you can check the status of the battery to see if it has enough charge to start your vehicle. There is a green "CHECK" button in the orange outlined JUMP square which is used to observe the battery status indicators. "GREEN" means ready, "Yellow" means partially discharged and "RED" means starting your vehicle is iffy and the battery needs charging. The jump cables are stored around the back and sides of the All-In-One and are clearly marked with a + for the red cable and a - for the black. An audio alarm will sound if you connect the cables backward.POWER - The power square is outlined in green. It has an AC outlet that provides 120 VAC power for appliances that consume up to 200 watts. There is a switch to the right of the AC outlet. There are two 12-volt DC receptacles which can be used to power up to 20 amps. They are located beneath the AC power outlet and switch. Charts are provided to assist with estimating both AC and DC usage.There is a small light on a cable that is nested in the handle.This unit weighs a tad over 20 pounds. There is no cord provided with this unit to charge the battery. There is a connection for an extension cord mounted on the rear of the unit.In summary, this is an All-In-One that is by far the best documented, best marked and esiest to use of any I have owned or observed. Every part is nicely stored and the unit is clearly marked for easy use. There is one negative that needs to be mentioned. This item was made in China. I try to purchase products made in the USA where jobs are in desparate need. I did not know this was made in China when I made the purchase and although I find no fault with it, and kudos to China for producing an unusually fine product, I would have preferred domestic manufacture.

Works great, but not worth $150.  $100 bucks tops for this.  You can get other brands that pretty much do the same thing for around 60-80.  This thing is quite heavy, but it has a big battery in it, so this is what i expected.  It is very easy to use and is a must have for an old clunker.

I bought this charger to replace an old charger (Duracell brand) that had worked wonders for me for years...but finally gave out.  This Energizer charger works really well and includes an air compressor, with which I topped off all four tires (added 10 psi to each tire...I know I waited too long to inflate them) and it worked like a champ.  Only drawback this charger has is it needs an extension cord to charge it (spent less than $10 on a 12ft one from H--- D----).  This model has a built in sensor to avoid overcharging, so you can leave it plugged in until you need it without overcharging the battery.  Very happy with this purchase.

Originally I just wanted a compressor but when I saw all the stuff this thing could do I figured I might as well get it.  I'd go so far as to say every trunk should have one.  It's one of those things you don't need until you need it and then you REALLY need it.I used the compressor when my tire pressure light went on and I realized the Toyota dealer had not been checking or rotating the spare tire -- it was low and that was setting off the warning light.I used the jumper on someone's minivan.  They held up cables and asked if I could give them a jump and I pulled this thing out and got them started right up, first try.I've used the power inverter to charge my cellphone but it will handle up to 200 watts so you can run quite a variety of things off of it.There's also a flashlight so basically it's a lot of great battery-related tools all in one package.  Just remember to take it inside and top off the charge now and then and you'll be all set.

For us this unit will serve mostly as an emergency power source for lights and for charging small electronics. The jump starting and air inflating features are bonuses and great resources to have.At first glimpse one can see the thoughtful design of the Energizer unit. The air, jump, and power features are clearly marked on the front A button to check available power is large, green, intuitive; unlike my Black and Decker power station, the color coded jumper cables are attached to system, one on each side. Each cable is designated with a large, readily visible plus or minus. For one not sure of the jump procedure, the steps are numbered on the Energizer with large numbers 1-2-3.Atop the unit is a lamp with flexible neck aglow with four LED bulbs.I haven't jump started a car with this particular unit yet, but I have used a similar unit for this purpose and it is wonderful to be able to do so without a second car. On brutally cold days, the Energizer will be riding shotgun with me.The portability of the air inflator is also very welcome. I've used units that plug into the cigarette lighter and require jockeying a cord while moving from tire to tire. Using this unit to inflate is fabulous. I did notice that the inflation is a tad slower with this Energizer than it is with my beefier Black and Decker 400 Unit.We haven't had a power outage yet so I had to simulate one. The Energizer powered a floor lamp for about five hours before losing steam. I had hoped for more juice. It also was able to power a small TV and a DVD player, but not at the same time. It could not run the power staple gun or an electric drill. A small cooling fan is readily audible when the power is on, but in a real electricity outage I don't think we'll mind the steady hum of the fan.The Energizer 84020 is great for the occasional jump start or as a standby to keep the car tires properly inflated - so much better than trying to find an air pump at a gas station. As a back up power source, probably not its prime intent, the Energizer is only adequate for light duty which is why I bought the Black and Decker to supplement its limited power. If I were to buy a third portable power unit, it would be something like the Duracell 600HD powerpack which offers 600W  peak A/C power.
Im sure the cable works good but i havent tried it to jumpstart a car. It says it handles up tp V8 cars. The thing i dont like is that it feels loose and cheap on the contact ends they might break
summary: Feels like its built with cheap metal

reviewText: Compact design makes it perfect to carry on my Polaris Rzr.  I needed something compact and lightweight.  Storage is a permium w/o looking like you're going on some remote expedition.  These cables allow me to have my piece of mind knowing I can give or get a jump start, and not drag around a bunch of unnecessary bulky cables.  Every ATV and UTV I own has a pair of these tucked away for emergencies.

Revived these cables quickly and they seem to be good quality. Haven't had to use them yet but they coil up nicely and fit in the spare tire well or any other small storage pocket. Can't rate them based on performance as I have yet to jump a car with them but they should work fine for most small vehicles.

Clearly these are not the super heaviest duty cables in the world out there, and I do have those for my truck which I use in the cold of winter.  But I recently killed the battery in my car while watching a football game on my notebook with an inverter, and I didn't have any jumper cables.  I don't need a heavy duty pair, just a small set I can use when I've been draining it...  This fits the bill.
I bought these for my son to keep in his car since I always seem to have to help him get his car started! At least now if he gets stranded he'll have something to get a jump with. Good price.
These are excellent for hand applying wax. They are substantial, thick, and durable, yet also soft. I much prefer these over the Meguiars applicator pads, as these are easier to hold.

Just got through using this applicator pad. Did not like it. Would not absorb the paste wax such that I could not go very far without having to dip back into the can again for more wax. Very wasteful of my time and my wax. My hand cramped while using it.  I now realize that I prefer a thinner pad.I see nothing 'premium' about it, and I have used lots of applicators over the years, including foam, microfiber, and even the little pad I got with my  P21s Concours wax.  All were better, IMO, than this one.  I like Smart Wax products, but this applicator was for me at least, a dud.Of course, your experience, along with your wax, may be different.
summary: Poor Applicator for Paste Wax -- There are Better Ones Available

reviewText: I'll start off by saying I am a professional Detailer at a high end shop in Kapolei Hawaii.  I wax every single car I do by hand and I needed a better pad then ones I used before I purchased these.  These are the best I have ever used in my 18 years in this field.  I used to get fatigued waxing cars not anymore. I will only use these from now on.  If you're going to take the time to detail your vehicle purchase these pads they make your life easier and the wax portion of the detail is more enjoyable.

These applicator sponges are great for auto waxing. They work well with liquid traditional waxes, as well as the new "clear" types like Turtle Wax Ice (the product for which I specifically purchased these). I really like the size of them - they are about 1" thick and 4" in diameter. They are very easy to hold - not as flimsy as many other foam applicators. They also clean up well for reuse, providing you do so right away.
these are good pads, might be a little more expensive then your local pads at auto stores but the quality is much better!
This wax will not leave residues on the rubber or trim on your car.  The carnuba wax leaves a great mirror image.  It applies and is removed easily.

I've used other Eagle products (their nano wax) with good results, so I thought I'd give this a shot since there was a rebate. So glad I tried it - it's the best shine my car has ever had! Plus,  no white residue on black plastic trim.There's one big catch, however - you can't let it dry or it's very difficult to buff out. You need to work on small sections. Wipe it on, then immediately wipe it off. A micro fiber towel works best for both application and removal. Working in the shade is an absolute must as well.One person can do it, but it helps to have two people. One to apply; the other to wipe it off. Working on my own it took me about 15 minutes to do the car (an Infiniti EX). Two people could easily do it in less than 10 minutes.I can't comment as of yet as to durability and longevity, but my car has never looked better. Even if it doesn't last as long as a conventional apply/dry/buff wax, it's so fast and easy to apply that I'll continue to use it. Highly recommend.
This stuff dries way too fast...stay away unless you have a Buffer Machine - Unimpressed!  Get McGuiars its soo much better.
summary: Horrible Wax - Stay Away unless you have a Buffer

reviewText: So I got this because it was free after a mail in rebate, is way easier to apply than nu finish but I am not sure about durability which is I think the most important thing to look for in car wax so you don't have to waste time. It was not rated too good by consumer reports, in fact it got the lowest score on the scale for durability. It is relatively on the cheaper side though,
summary: Was very easy to apply, not sure about durability.

reviewText: Eagle One is offering to rebate the purchase price on this wax until September of 2010, so figured I would give it a try. Keep in mind that I am applying this wax to an (8) month old, highly waxed, black auto and that this is a detail/finishing product.Normally, I wax the car at least two times per year with Mother's Carnauba Cleaner Wax followed by a coat of Turtle Wax Ice Paste Synthetic or 3M Perfmance Finish Wax (no longer made). There is nothing like the look of carnauba - the follow up coat of synthetic is for durability.Eagle One Gel Wax is everything they promise. It's truly a slippery gel and as such, very easy to apply - you don't have to rub it in, just wipe it on and buff it off. VERY easy and quick. The result if a fabulous carhauba gloss, and takes very little time.The caveat with this wax is that it is a finish wax ONLY - if your paint is weathered and in need of a polishing abrasive (polishing product), it won't really improve things much and it will indeed be VERY difficult to remove - not unlike using regular carnauba on such a finish.Second caveat is that it comes off very easily when moist, which is what the directions suggest. But if you let it dry, it DOES beomce more difficult to remove, although no more difficult than other carnauba waxes. So, yes, you are much better off doing one panel at a time. Most waxes come off much easier when a bit damp, so this isn't a unique idea...So, highly recommended for topping off a finish in good shape. Only reason I didn't give it five stars is because it isn't for everyone, but definately for the purist at heart.
Super easy to apply and wipe off. I just tried it so no idea yet on how durable it is, it should bee fine though since it has carnuba wax in it.

Got these for my '09 Accord since I had a mesh grille. Mainly got them for looks, but man were they a pain to splice and wire up. It isn't the fault of Hella, though, considering they just make the horns. Gave a GREAT touch to my grilled and my car overall!

The stock horn on my Evo sounded rather lame. Wired these in, in parallel, and they're not only significantly louder, but much better sounding! Not really a dull standard/stock honk noise that might be ignored. These are more likely to get the attention of any of the typical bad drivers that like to merge into you or do something else stupid/endangering. You can try to youtube these to hear the sound, but it won't do it justice. You cannot really tell how loud they sound at all from that, although you'll be able to make out somewhat how the "distinct" noise is, with the dual tones. And no, this is not obnoxiously sounding, or "too loud". You don't have to worry about being rude or annoying when you use these out in public (unless you're trying to be rude and annoying). Definitely recommend this product for someone looking to upgrade the wimpy sounding stock horns found in a lot of cars.

Everyone I know has these horns. After almost getting sideswiped even after blaring my puny German horns I decided it was time to upgrade. I installed these on a E36 M3 right behind the two kidney grills. Not only do they look awesome but they are pointed in the correct direction with minimal interference. It took me about 3 hours total to install them but I took my time and made my own custom brackets to properly mount these. Installation was very easy, following the instruction for my style of horn configuration. I did use the relay to make sure I get the most of them. I did not test them without the relay so I do not know if there would be a difference.These are great for upgrading your existing horn and adding a little visual flare if you want. Installation was easy and straightforward. I tell people to stand in front of my car when they ask about them. They usually stand about 3 feet away and I always tell them they might want to back up. Usually they just say it's ok and to go ahead and push the button. Every single one of  them has jumped because they were so startled by how loud they are.So far they have been waterproof. It has been raining non-stop for a few days, with intermittent torrential down pours and I have had no problems with them. Overall I would highly recommend them.

Amazingly loud. Their tone is a mix of a tinny sound (edge) and a train horn (depth of sound). LOUD LOUD LOUD. But you REALLY need to use the provided relay so they're getting their power directly from the battery. That's the only way they're going to reach the full 118dB, unless your stock car horns are also running on a 30A relay lol.

Wired them up on my 08 civic with a relay triggered from the original horn wire, and they sure are loud. I mounted them to a bracket off the front bumper so they hang down perfectly in the lower front grille giving a nice aggressive look. It took a while to get them both to blast at full power at the same time, but the problem ended up being my ground like was too long. Once I shortened this up the horns worked perfectly.
Excellent produce, excellent price, excellent delivery. Just as advertised. The only con was the directions - not very clear unless you are an electronics guru, otherwise I would recommend.

I'm fixing up an old Jeep Cherokee and these were perfect for it. They're very loud, easy to install, and seem to be very durable. Mine are in front of the wheel wells and I don't have fender liners so they get splashed on a regular basis. So far they are holding up fine.

The sound is definitely different from most factory installed horns and it is definitely louder than my single small toyota disc horn.I like it...it definitely makes other drivers observe their surroundings better when they hear it.Package includes1 x 500Hz Horn (High tone)1 x 300Hz Horn (Low Tone)1 x Relay (its wired differently from most relays)and Installation InstructionsSound samples can be found on youtubeI wired mines to replace my factory horn. I also removed the grills to repaint them Black. If you are planning to mod your horns this way please be informed that removing those 8 screws will dismantle most of the horn. The grill is part of the horn and I'm not certain if it will function without it; grill helps to distribute clamping force to the paper gaskets.These horns have saved me from two possible accidents already so I believe that they have paid for themselves.

Purchased this to replace my 06 WRX horns and I love the way it sounds.  The included instructions are somewhat dim, as it does not mention if the connectors are positive or negative, i assumed it was Universal since there were no markings.  But then again YouTube has clear instructions on install of this item for WRX'sInstall Link:  [...]
summary: Definitely Louder than my Stock Horn

reviewText: This is my fourth set I've purchased, 2 are for my own vehicles. These things are EXTREMELY LOUD. So much so that I wired a separate button for them and kept my OEM horns for normal use. if you want to paint them take off the black bolts around the bezel. Paint is pretty soft, so I sand-blasted mine, but mind you the ones my buddies kept red still look good after 2+ years
These horns work well install is easy . You will be happy you got them . The price is right .

This is a great set at a great price.  These took me 10 min per side to install.  They are DEFINITELY better and brighter than the stock headlamps.IMPORTANT: only touch the bulb with clean rubber gloves.  The guy at the parts store said the oil from your fingers will burn out the bulb in a week if you get it on the glass!

This will not fit a 2010 Ford Fusion S.  You will need the bulbs will the plastic pieces that connect to the headlamp wire assmebly.  Look for any Sylvania H11 series.  I hate the fact that I have to rate this star wise for it not fitting versus actual bulb performance.  I put this same style bulb in a Jeep Grand Cherokee Laredo and they work great.
summary: Does not fit 2010 Ford Fusion S

reviewText: This is the third time i've bought these bulbs. I tried the Phillips X-treme bulbs in my 04' Elantra and those burned out very quickly (about 3 months), and weren't nearly as bright as these. The first pair of these lasted a year and a half, last pair of these bulbs that I owned lasted me for only 7-8 months. I'll have to wait and see how long this set lasts me.
Solid value with solid light output.  I've seen brighter but there's nothing ahead of me I can't see so I'm satisfied.

I ordered these bulbs in part due to the excellent reviews others have left. The main points to take away from this item are:~Excellent value. I paid $16.83 for the pair of bulbs. That's about the same price for a single bulb from W*Mart with lower quality, plus sales tax.~Works great. The light is at least equal in color temperature and brightness to the OEM bulb.~Plus, it's GREEN! No, the light color is not green, but the manufacturing and components are more eco-friendly than traditional bulbs.If you're thinking about getting this, don't give it a second thought. It's a great value.

Great price, fast free shipping with Prime, and I was able to have them sent straight to work. Could have gone to the parts store but would have paid a bit more for the same thing and had to wait in line behind the guy who can't figure out what year Oldsmobile he has ;)
This bulb pack is the same price for a single bulb at auto parts stores. Buy a couple and replace both sides at the same time to ensure consistent illumination.
Can't say enough about the tried and true products we buy every day like these lamps the fit most of our cars
I'm happy with my purchase.  IT fit my Lexus IS300.  It's sylvania a trusted brand.  Works just fine.  Will update in a few months on longevity.
summary: It's name brand, nice.  not bad.

reviewText: I didn't realize that it's a double filament light bulb when I was buying it. But I just bent two terminals around and it fit right in. Just got a little brighter light. Can't complain :)
summary: Installed in the 3rd brake light of my Honda Fit

reviewText: I bought these for autodetailing based on the reviews and the advertised purpose. I have another set of towels that are 350GSM and they are MUCH better quality and have a deeper nap for trapping debris. Because the nap is so short I would *never* use them on my exterior paint. I plan on using these for underhood, on glass, on wheels, and on textured plastics. Basically, anywhere I would normally use an old t-shirt.
summary: Decent towels but these aren't 350 GSM

reviewText: These are great towels for detailing jobs. They remove wax easily. They work really good on eye glasses if you are used to cleaning your eye glasses and getting scratches on then this will work wonders and not leave any scratches.
Works about as well as any medium priced micro-fiber towel I've ever used. After washing some 5-6 times they're showing their use but I still like them.
These microfiber towels are awesome and so is the price.  I've use many other brands and these are the best. I use them fo detailing my cars.

This is a very good towel with a multitude of uses.  They are a good size, and came at a good price.  I have used and washed only a few, but they have been very durable.  Washing them makes them thicker and softer.I've been using them in place of paper towels in the house.  When the weather gets better, I plan to give them a lots of use inside and outside our cars.

These towels are real nice, almost too good to be used. Kind of one of those cloths you save for special projects.The only negative is that they should make them out of different colors so you do not mix up your wax rag with your compound rag.,

I would recommend these towels.They do a great job of waxing our vehicles.When you're done just throw then in the washer, and they're ready for the next time.Sometimes after I wash a car I use them to wipe it down.Microfiber towels are the best cleaning products available.Works great.Show Car Guys All Purpose Microfiber Towels 16" X 16"- One Of The Best Microfiber Cleaning Cloths There Is. This 6-pack Of High Quality All Purpose Microfiber Terry Towels Can Be Used To Clean And Detail Cars, Clean Glass, and Kitchen Appliances Using N...

These great little towels have ended up everywhere.  A couple in the garage, a few at the office, a couple in every room of the house.  They're great for just about everything.  Having been ripped off in the sham-wow scam, these seem even better.  They're soft and useful, wash up well, and come in a great quantity.
The only Microfiber towels I trust on my Porsche 911 - sensitive paint.  Very smooth - My only wish is that they came with out the tags.  But a simple clip with scissors and your set.

I seldom write glowing reviews because I usually find something wrong or subpar with almost everything I buy but I have to say these towels are incredibly good at the price I paid or really at just about any price.  They are soft and very absorbent so when I wipe up detail spray it comes up quickly and without streaks.  I've also used these cloths for buffing and they pick up a good deal of wax before it's necessary to use another cloth.  And with 36 towels in the package at 16x16" I'm a happy camper., I can afford to change cloths much more frequently and that makes detailing tasks much easier.  Only one towel had a defective edge and I will fix that with some cotton thread.  I'm going to be delegating the vast majority of the microfiber I got at department stores to the sacrificial box for those really dirty jobs where it won't be worthwhile trying to wash the cloth.This is one of the best deals I've found on Amazon.
summary: Great product, great price - a 5 Star Deal

reviewText: I haven't had to wash any yet, but they work well for cleaning the exterior of the vehicle. Waxing, washing, drying, windows...works well on everything so far. Very handy having a whole package.

I have bought these microfiber towels now twice.  Do a google search on how to choose microfiber towels and they will tell you that 250 and above GSM rating is good stuff.  Yeah i don't remember what that GSM rating meant, but I bet ya when you google it will show ya!

I bought these to detail my cars.As mentioned, the price is great for a 36 pack.I have used these to wipe down my cars with a detail spray, worked great.I have purchased the Meguiars supreme towels, Meguiars Ultimate wipe towels, and to me, the Eurow microfibers are just as good but priced much lower.I recently grabbed my second pack when it dropped below $20....great deal

This is at least my third order of these Eurow Microfiber towels.  I have rated them a 5 star before because I like them so much, they are softer, thicker and more absorbent than any other similar towels I've bought and they are my preferred towel for cleaning the house and vehicles.  I've read the reviews before that they stink and wondered what those people were talking about because I've never had that problem with these towels...until this order of them.  I opened them up and they do stink really really bad.  I had to wash the load of them four times in a row to get the smell out to where I felt comfortable enough to use them.
