Exactly as described... It was very easy to hook up and has good build quality.  I believeit will hold up for years to come.  I would reccomend to all jeepers!

Rugged Ridge 17275.01 4-Way Tow Hitch Wiring Harness for 2007-2010 Jeep Wrangler and Wrangler Unlimited JK is easy to install and a nice addition to the Rugged Ridge 11580.10 Rear Hitch.  Save yourself some trouble and install them both at the same time.

Straight up, this is a stone simple add-on for simple trailers with flat plug connectors. I had the taillight housing out and this harness plugged in within 10 minutes, and then spent an additional 10 minutes obsessing over how to route the loom across the back frame rail. I ended up pulling off the electrical tape holding on the push fasteners and re-stretching the loom to get more slack at the hitch, and replacing the tape with my own small cable ties.Price and ease of installation earn this 5 stars, but some extra length would be welcomed.

Someone finally came up with a no brainer idea for a wiring harness, easy easy easy to install the first time and if you don't like the plastic insert spacing for attaching the wiring just remove the tape and put them back where you want them - total install time 8 minutes.
Good quality and shipped fast. Fits my 2009 Jeep Wrangler. Fit great in my jeep and just the right length and fit into the hitch.

It just doesn't get any easier than this trailer wire harness from Rugged Ridge. Remove the left tail light lens cover, plug in the connectors, run the harness to your hitch & done! Thanks RR for another great product. Teamed up with a Rough Country receiver or another brand of your choosing and you've got a $200+ savings from the factory installed 'trailer tow group'.
summary: Rugged Ridge Trailer Harness : Super Easy & Save $$

reviewText: Loved the way this harness was designed to utilize the factory holes to attach to my 2013 wrangler.  You only need to remove the screws on the right hand side of the drivers side rear light to remove it.

Super easy to install by just taking off the driver side tail light and running it down thru to the hitch. 2 snaps and it was on. I did use a couple zip ties to hold it close to the car so it woudln't drag.
Extremely easy wire harness install. Even came with attached clips to hold wires to existing holes in frame. Very slick.

I mounted an aftermarket trailer hitch to the OEM holes drilled int he rear cross frame, but the receiver did not come with a wiring harness.  I figured I sould pick one up at a local parts store.  Then I saw this one.  I like the way it appears to be "plug and play" and let me tell you it IS!  Very simple to install without drilling, cutting or splicing wires.  Plugs right into the tail light plugs inside the driver side tail light casing.  Once I removed the tail light cover (with a screw driver) it took about five minutes to plug the harness in and feed it down through the bottom of the tail light socket and (how lucky I was) I found it snapped into the socket on the side of the receiver I had installed.  It even has little retainer clips along the wiring so you can secure it to the frame under the Jeep.  Trailer lights work perfectly.  This was an EASY install.  NOTE: it has a four plug flat type plug.  If you have a 7 pin round plug on the end of your trailer wiring, you will need to purchase an adapter that converts it to the four flat plug style.  I picked one up at a local farm supply store for around seven dollars.
summary: What a great quick install harness

reviewText: This simply plugs into the left taillight. Much less a pain than the one for our Chrysler Town and Country.
summary: Plug and Play for Jeep Wrangler Unlimited X

reviewText: Great product.  Easy and fast installation with great directions.  They even had pictures!  Nice product and it works great.
This was really easy to install on my 2012 Rubicon.  It took 10 minutes tops to install and works perfectly.  I highly recommend this product.
summary: Rugged Ridge 17275.01 4-Way Tow Hitch Wiring Harness

reviewText: I installed these on my 2012 Jeep Arctic tonight i think they make the front end really pop now was unsure of the look at first but it kinda grown on you after awhile. Install was fairly straight forward just peel off the backing on the double sided tape line up and stick. Shipping,packaging was awesome as always from Amazon wish other retailers would try to be more like Amazon. The stuff actually came a day early and no damaged at all thanks Amazon !!!

Would have given it 5 stars but for the price , make the front end pop with my color jeep and I would recommend the headlight trim also. But for what it is , a small bit of plastic , and what it cost , it seems a bit pricy  , If you have the spare cash and your jeep is a bright color . Go for it.

I ordered these along with the ones for the turn signal lights and could not be happier with the way they look.  They fit in well and add protection to the edge leading into the lights.  I looked at some other items and also looked at these on a few other sites but ordered them from Amazon based on the lower price.  I have ordered several accessories from Amazon for my 2011 Wrangler and these are one of those "great investments"

I really love these headlight trim, I purchase them along with the turn signal trim pieces and the aluminum billet inserts and really made my Rock Lobster Red wrangler grill stand out!  They are very easy to install, and the final look is awesome!

These are really easy to install, anyone can do it.  These tiny little details add a nice custom look to it so your Jeep stands out from the rest. The adhesive tape used is great. You can spray it with a power washer on full power and they stay put. Easily recommended to anyone.
Nomally I'm not one for this stick-on stuff, but these look great, especially if you have grille inserts. Fit my '10 Rubicon perfect.

I put inserts into the grill slats of my Black Jeep Wrangler and something just didn't look right.  They created a textured look to the center of the grill but the outside edges looked plain.  I added the Headlight trim and the turn signal trim, both in Matte Black, and it added a little something.  Just enough to offset the grill inserts.  it is a very subtle add on for a black Wrangler but looks real sharp, like it was supposed to be there, but different from stock.  A friend has the Dozer Yellow Wrangler and these look awesome on it.
These are easy to install and seem to stay on just fine. It is a nice way to look different from the other Jeeps
Easy install. Did the front of my Jeep with headlight trim, turn signal trim, and grille inserts. Other Jeep owners have asked what was different about my Jeep.
summary: Sets my Jeep apart from others.

reviewText: These installed very easily and they look great if your looking for a quick way to add something to your jeep these are great
I like it because it looks good and it is easy to install. Only problem is that the tape does not stick enough and it keeps popping out.Replaced the tape and problem solved.
Just like the other Rugged Ridge ad-ons I have purchased, easy and fast to install.Double sided sticky tape, done in minutes and makes a nice but minor different look.
Added a nice touch of class and installation and fit were a breeze. A little pricey but look'en good is priceless.
These look great on my rock lobster red wrangler! Really accents the front along with the matching turn signal trim and mesh grill inserts. Super easy installation.

I use these valves on all our vehicles and put one on any new vehicle we acquire. This valve is not much bigger than the oil pan plug. If clearance is an issue for off road like in my 4x4 vehicles, I make sure it is either tucked/hidden nicely by factory design or I add an engine skid plate to protect the valve as well as the oil pan and transmission. I have not had any issues with 6 of these valves over many miles. Comes in handy to get a quick sample for oil analysis as well. No muss no fuss. I like to use the valve to drain the oil directly into an old used 5 quart oil jug and then drop it off at the oil collection depot. No need for a hose off the valve either. Great product!
summary: Great Valve for Fast Mess Free Oil Changes or Sampling

reviewText: This Oil Drain Valve is awesome... I wish I would of known sooner. It is very simple to installs just like the old drain plug. Fit perfect and no more slow drips are coming out of my car.

I lost the valve on my Escort when I scrapped it so needed one for the Focus. This valve will probably stay closed for normal people in normal driving. If you are driving in weeds and brush bumper high and sometimes backing up, it could open. I fastened a steel hose clamp on it to keep this from happening. It did happen once with the Escort.

Have been changing my oil for while now, for a few reasons. One, it saves me some bucks, and the second is, i know exactly what oil is going in, and what filter is going on. I don't so much care about the oil as long as it's synthetic, as I do about the filter. Anyways this product is great if you change your own oil! It is so easy to change, no mess no hassle, no tools. Just make sure you check the manufacturers website to verify if you need one of the adapters, and please make sure to use the included washers, or your oil will leak! The only minor annoyance is it takes slightly longer to drain the oil using this, as the opening is narrower than that directly on the oil pan. This isn't an issue for me, however if you off road or have a very low car, there is a chance that this will stick down far enough to become vulnerable. I read somewhere that someone with this installed was off-roading, hit a rock and took off the entire oil pan. Sounds like utter poppy-cock to me, but who knows. I love it.
summary: Great idea, great product, easy peasy.

reviewText: I ordered this for a 2008 Honda Civic.This valve will not screw into the oil pan, because the spot where the plug is located is recessed, and the valve can't turn in that space.
summary: Fitment guide is incorrect, does not fit 2008 Civic

reviewText: Saves lots of time when changing oil. Excellent and very simple methods to find out which model is right for the vehicle. Product is of industrial quality and great craftsmanship. This is my third fumoto valve and I will always make sure I use them. Saves sooooo much time!

I have purchased several of these valves over the years and put them on 6 different vehicles that I have owned.  They make oil changes a lot less messy especially on a Subaru Outback I used to have that had a large diameter drain plug that would quickly dump and splash oil everywhere. I trust Fumoto and haven't had any issues with loosening or leaking even on my Toyota pickup that I installed a valve on over 10 years ago.  In the unlikely event that the valve somehow gets damaged or broken by road debris, I still do carry the original drain plug in each vehicle for my own piece of mind.  I also do all my own oil changes and am not sure if quick lube places like these valves or not because it does take a little extra time for the oil to drain.

Purchased two of these to replace the vents on my 2008 KZ Sportsmen. Install was straight forward, quality seems to be top notch. Kind of cool to watch them spin in tandem when the wind shifts directions. I only had a slight sewer smell in my trailer if it sat for an extended period of time, I suspectthese will take care of that with ease.

Very poorly designed roof connection. If you have a rubber roof the amount of Dicor you would have to use is crazy, plus that is the only thing (no butyl tape under it.) Because of that I modified the old roof vent so as to slip this one onto it and then caulked it in place. Can't believe Camco didn't design this better.
summary: Does the job, but the roof connection is poor.

reviewText: no stink yet so I guess it works. Installed in about 1/2 hour. turns with the wind as advertised. good product
Works as described and very easy to install. I would also put a heavy bead of silicone around the vent pipe before you put it over it. this way it will help keep it on.

Compared to units I've had in the past, this is very tall. Rotates freely in all directions even under the lightest breeze.  Doesn't seem to have the drawing power of other brands I have tried at highway speeds leaving vapors entering the cabin while flushing, but this could be how the motor home is plumbed and not the vent.

We've all been there...Not always, but if the wind blew the right way you got that smell...Not once since I installed this vent. Easy Install and it works! With the slightest breeze, I creates a negative pressure that draws the odors out of the sewer system. Satisfied customer!
works just like a super dooper pooper scooper. well it definetly gets rid of any smells or whatever. easy to install. dosent hurt to put a little sealer around the base.

On my second one of these now. First one somehow disappeared on the highway somewhere. Not sure how that happened. Anyway, this has made a huge difference with keeping the black tank  vent odor out of our trailer. Black tank vent is right by the bathroom air vent. This has really helped move the odors away from the trailer - thanks to the wind. Great product.
Works as described, fairly easy to install. Kinda obtrusive though, it really stands out more than I would have liked

This little thing actually works as it should.  I'm holding one star back because I think there's a little room for improvement.  What if, while sitting stationary, you could extend this thing up about 18 inches and then secure it with a lynch pin?  Why, you ask?  Well, my black water vent is right behind my bathroom vent fan.  If the wind direction is just right, this serves to expedite the sewage 'smell' into my RV.  That is not the most pleasant of experiences.  Of course this could happen with or without the vent but, as the vent is more capable at air exchange, the aroma tends to be a bit more pronounced.  Still, this is a good product and I won't remove it due to that one fault.

I receved the vent and it was just as described. Works and actually eliminated the black tank odors that would happen at times when you flushed the toilet. I normally only had odor in windy situations and/or when someone might use the toilet while traveling in the motorhome.  This simple device creates by design a constant updraft via the vent pipe. Works good.  BTW,  Camping World has these also but not at this pricing.

Keeps the updraft going on the RV septic system so that the odors do not linger in your holding tank.  Just be sure to use the proper sealant upon installation so that you get a good tight seal.  I would recommended this product to all RVer's! :)

We had a couple of these vent broken by people washing our roof.  We replaced them but we find that sometimes they don't rotate as easily as they should.  They serve the purpose and in general, they work well.  We would buy them again.

I bought this product for my father who just went to Germany to sign for his new BMW. I wanted to put together some good cleaning products for him to use when his car arrives. This company makes some of the best cleaning products you can buy.

This wheel cleaner annihilated brake dust on my 2006 VW Touareg (knwon for having excessive wheel dust). The cleaner works awesome and leaves wheels perfectly clean. The long brush is a little too big to get into all the spots on the insode of the wheel. The finger gloves work magic when used to clean the wheels.
I read a review on this product before I purchased it and am glad I did.  It really works.  Like it.

WOW, just wow. This makes it so easy to clean the dust off of my wheels. No excuses now. The brush is cheap but it works on my wheels. I really don't want to spend the day cleaning cars and this stuff makes it so easy.
I cannot tell the difference between using this cleaner and using just soap and water.  The scrubber brush is nice.

Then it would be perfect, but no matter, after a while, you will get your hands dirty when you use this, unless you have the temerity to clean the sponge after every use, i dont and it would take a long time, so after a while, the tire black and applicator will eventually seep through the entire sponge and every time you use it, it will get on your hands.  Having said that, i have not found something better that has the same price point, so i continue with it.
Can' beat any other applicator for putting on leather conditioner and tire shine products.  LIcking might work better, but that could be fatal. Enough said.

I bought this product to use withGriot's Garage 11044 Long Lasting Tire Dressing - 16 oz..  While the tire dressing is a fine product, this detail sponge sucks.  Every time I use this my hands end up covered in the tire dressing.  I haven't found a way to hold this that your hand doesn't get fully greased with  product.Ordinarily I'd give such a product 1-star but they say it works for interior dressing as well- maybe it's better at that.  For tire applications spend your money on theEagle One 5010602 Tire Swipes (2 per poly Bag)instead.  They work great and can be cut in half to handle low profile tires.

These blue sponges have slits on the sides, so taking a scissors I continue the slits and cut the sponge in half, then cut each half in half again, ending up with 4 half-moon segments from each sponge, for a total of 8 sponges from this 2 sponge set.  I use these to apply wheel dressing.  One segment allows me to apply dressing to both cars in my family (8 tires) then I toss it out.  Applying dressing once every six weeks, This 2-pack lasts me just about a year.Recommended!
summary: Cut each sponge into 4 pieces, great for applying tire dressing

reviewText: This is a well made sponge, easy to hold on to, and do a great job applying leather cleaner on seats, I wish I'd have bought a few more!

I got these just to see if they are worth the money and I will say that while you can get foam/sponges all over the place now, this is one of those products that you buy in association with other products. I would probably not make a special purchase just for these, but they're good accessories. The foam does appear to be a better quality that what you get at the local parts houses. They take a beating and if used right will do wonders for keeping you clean while you apply tire dressing or even do a spray cleaning of your interior. Good stuff and bigger than I thought they'd be.

These are one of the best tire gel applicators I've ever used. They are well-suited to gels, but not liquids. They are not the absolute best as I believe a black hex foam applicator would be a bit of an improvement, but those are difficult to find. I don't really have any complaints with these ones from Griot's for the price paid.
summary: One of the best tire gel applicators

reviewText: I love these mitts for drying. To make the car look great, in my experience, good drying is just as important as washing! And these mitts are superb for that! They not only dry and shine, but remove any remnants of the dirt your washing might have left behind. I do half of the car with one side, and then the other half with the other side by flipping them on my hand. Then I use the second glove for non-painted surfaces. Since they are color coded, I always use one color mitt for the painted parts, and one color mitt for the non-painted parts.I don't like these gloves for washing too much. These mitts hold A TON of water. I found that when they are loaded with water they are quite heavy and I prefer micro fiber towels for washing!This is how I use micro towels for washing: I made a mitt out of a microfiber towel by sewing a rubber band into the towel edges. Then I put this home-made mitts on a car washing wand (the kind that has a head that rotates easily in many directions). I bought the wand in a store, but replace the cotton mop head with my home-made micro fiber mitts and they gives me much better cleaning results and with less effort. I made a few of these micro fiber mitts and use 5 or 6 of them during each car wash. And then finish up with these "wormy" Micro Fiber mitts to dry out.The same wormy mitt is sold under several brand names. The best price I found on these gloves is at CostCo, but lately I don't see them there any more. Amazon price is pretty good but fluctuates. There is a nice tool that shows history of Amazon prices and these item varied by just $1 within last year. If you want to find this tool search on Amazon price alert and select the one with camel in its name.Ali Julia review

These Griot's Garage Micro Fiber Chenille wash mitts are fantastic!! I have been extremely impressed by the quality of these mitts.1. Different colors are nice so you can use different mitts for upper/lower part of the car.2. MF Chenille will not damage your paint and works great in a 2-bucket wash3. The mitts can absorb a ton of water/soap so you can wash large sections of the vehicle.4. The mitts fit nicely on the hand and I do not have issues with them falling off, spinning, etc.If you are looking for a quality wash mitt then look no further. I have compared to other MF wash mitts (non-Chenille) and these blow the competition away in this price range.
summary: Great Mitts at a Great Price

reviewText: I so far have found these to work very well.  They hold lots of soap and water and it's pretty easy to flip the mitt while it's on your hand.  I have average size hands and the mitt never felt like it was going to fall off.  I also did not experience and color bleeding, although I hosed them down before I used them.  They do a good job cleaning my car.

These wash mitts are awesome in my opinion.  They are super soft and will not, if cared for, scratch any finish.  I have a lot of Griot's products, but I must admit, these mitt's are the best thing they sell!  If you  really care about  your cars finish,  you can't go wrong with these mitts.
summary: Awesome is not a term I would normally use for a wash mitt, but...

reviewText: I actually have the wash pads and they are not really effective because they hold so much water that they become heavy and cumbersome to use --especially on the side and lower parts of your vehicle.Also, they take forever to dry. One time I accidentally put them away in a container when I thought they were dry but the inside was still moist. The next day, they smelled like mold.You could toss these in the dryer but it would take forever to dry. When you leave them out to dry, they take a few days to completely dry before you can put them back in storage.As far as washing ability, I wasn't impressed. They don't lather up properly and I feel like every time I go over the paint, I am moving water around and not enough soap.My favorite car washing sponge is the Zymol sponge. You can get it for like 8 bucks on eBay. It is made from a higher quality sponge material, it is the perfect size, and it just makes car washing so much easier.  Microfiber is good for a lot of things but I think a good quality sponge is best for washing.  I actually like the sponge better than a sheepskin mitt (Griot's used to sell a superior sheepskin mitt which I have and still use.)I will admit that these micro fiber mitt's/pads look really cool and they feel great when they are dry but once you drop them in the water, they become so heavy that you can't efficiently use them. You might feel otherwise but I have a feeling if you use these, you will encounter the same problems I had.  IMO a good quality washing sponge/cloth should be lightweight when loaded with water and soap so that when you are washing your vehicle, you are able to produce lather.  This wash mitt/pad becomes so heavy when loaded with water that it is not able to effectively do that.I don't recommend this product to wash your car.
summary: Ineffective washing tool, too heavy when loaded with water.

reviewText: I washed these brightly colored mitts along with my othermicro fiber towels. Now they all have a tint to them! I wishthe manufacturer would warn about this. My white MF towelsstill work well but are no longer white. Mitts do hold a lot ofsoap and will do a larger area than a less plush mitt would do.Minus one star for the bleeding color.

These things hold a ton of water.  That means they transfer more water from the bucket to your car, which is a good thing.  They're nice and heavy when wet so you don't have to scrub your paint.  When combined with a no-rinse (like ONR) wash, it soaks up a ton of dirt trapping liquid so you're safe from scratches while washing your car.
summary: super absorbent and fun to use

reviewText: Bought it for  my car but so far it is delegated to drying my 10 pound mini Doberman.  The pup has several recurved teeth and you have to be fast in getting the water on the soap on the rinse done and the biggie the dog must be dry before leaving the controlled wet area.These mitts give you 4 surfaces that are more that adequate for my dog.  The trick is getting them on at the end of rinse. so you might consider a dog wash stand as sold by Amazon that keeps the dog from jumping to the floor and breaking something if the floor is not carpeted.  Two people would be nice so you can play bad cop and good cop thereby avoiding the putting the mitt on which is not easy in this situation.  My dog is like a rocket and has only two states wild and sleeping.
summary: Great for drying my miniature Doberman.

reviewText: I bought these mitts for the high reviews but I was insanely disappointed. In the first minute I knew I hated them. When I soaked them in the soap and water I pulled out what felt like a set of 10 lb dumbells. My arms were exhausted and just to give them another chance I tried them on another wash... I threw them in the trash.. I wouldn't even be okay giving them to a friend because I wouldn't wanna put them through it.
summary: WASH MITTS WAY 10 LBS WHEN WET!!

reviewText: These mitts DO hold quite a bit of liquid and take some agitation to clean.  But, using a 2-bucket wash system, these mitts do the job well.

Microfiber material is very soft. I like the right colors. The mitt size is a little big for my hand, but if you have a big hand, it will fit perfect. Holds a lot of water when using it. Washes up great after use.

These hold a great deal of sud! Whoa. Don't over soak them in the water though because they are quite hefty when saturated. You can clean large sections of the car and don't forget to turn over and use the other side as well.I had no issues of it bleeding after washing or dying or leaving residue.

This is the second set of Griot micro fiber mitts I purchased.....they do not wear out...I simply change them every year just to be safe regarding my car finishes...they wash well and hold up to numerous washings...I love them...they are cheaper to ship via Amazon as well.

These things hold A LOT of water.  They're nice and thick and wash easily to prevent any marring.  Using the 2 bucket method you should have little to no swirls when you're done washing.  Remember to use 1 for the top 1/2 of the car and the other for the bottom.

These work great, they hold water/soap really well and seem to keep the dirt from scratching the paint. Combined with a two bucket wash method these really cut down on developing swirls and other marks. I washed them first, and haven't seen any color bleeding or other issues.
These micro fiber wash mitts seem to work well.  I have used this style for a couple years and as long as you dont drop them and wash them out thoroughly they clean very well.
summary: Griot's Garage 10268 Micro Fiber Wash Mitt - Set of 2

reviewText: Best wash mitts of the ones I've tried. Perfect for those OCD folks like me. Two mitts in different colors mean you can use one for the dirty parts of the car (wheel wells, lower trim, etc.) while leaving the other for the parts you're really protective of (the hood, and body panels).Nice and soft. Holds a huge amount of water and suds making it easy to get the soapy water from the bucket to where you need it.I've had mine for a year or so and they seem to be holding up very well in the wash.Really great quality. Just what you would expect from Griot's.
These work well, almost as well as sheepskin/lambswool mitts.  They launder easily, wring well, and hold a lot of water.  Large too.
summary: These work well, almost as well as sheepskin/lambswool mitts..

reviewText: The Good: Godly absorbing power, I mean you will refill your wash bucket several times. Freaking insane absorbancy. Mitts are supper soft and feel well made, as expected from griot products.They pretty much soak your car. They Feel good on the hand, when dry... see the not so good.The Okay: Suds okay, gets the job done but not as deep cleaning as i wanted one pass to be.Not so good: this mitt absorbs so much water that it does get abit heavy after dunking it in the bucket. It gets annoying to refill the bucket with water every 5 minutes.The Bad: Because you have to make multiple passes with a heavy mitt, you get freakin sore. I mean you feel it burn that arm muscle.Judgement: The quality is there, and its a nice mitt. the performance leaves me confused, because judged as a wash mit Its almost terrible! however other users say its a great drying mitt, and I must say it probably is.bottom line: of you want a great light,foamy mitt, perhaps look elseware because I think im using this as a drying, and perhaps detailing mitt.

These are nice wash mitts in that they are gentle on your car being that they are microfiber.Note, they take a very long time to dry.  I washed my car one week ago and squeezed out as much water as I could by hand and hung these up in my garage to dry. They are still damp one week later!  Granted, it is winter time here so has not been very warm, but I guess I will have to put them in the dryer next time.I do not know how long these will last but hopefully a while.
summary: Seems safe for your car, takes a long time to dry.

reviewText: These are super soft and may be the best wash mitt I've ever used.  Plenty of room to trap dirt away from the surface when cleaning, and releases dirt well in the rinse bucket against a grid guard.

Very, very fluffy. Holds a lot of water and soap. Having two means you can separate one for the cleaner, top half of the vehicle and use the other for only bottom half.Washes well and has many "hairs" which can trap dirt effectively.Oh and good price too.

I purchased the sprayer to go with a 35 oz of Griot's Garage Speed shine which I got based on a recommendation of a auto enthusiasts forum I follow. Given the price of the sprayer and the fact that it was sold separately my expectation were very high and did not quite live up to my expectations.1. Even on the fine setting it sprays huge amount of liquid. Maybe that is a feature, but I would have liked more control over that. I am attaching a photo (under customer photos) of how much Speed Shine I used by just using it on the windows (not the entire car) while using Griot's Glass clay.2. After four uses it began leaking. I am still using it, but I expected to get more life out of it without leaks.I like Griot's Garage car care products, but next time I think will go with another sprayer.Ali Julia review
summary: Next time I think will go with another sprayer

reviewText: Works well to get the very bottom is Griot's larger product bottles. Unavailable locally.  Groit's seems to have good, quality products no matter which on you buy and use. Excellent offering Amazon...
summary: Great to get the very bottom of the larger bottles

reviewText: Since Griots makes you buy this separately I thought it would be a good product. Not so. This sprayer didn`t make it through half the bottle when the seals broke. The speed shine is a great product,but the sprayer is crap. Save your money and just pour the speed shine in an empty Windex bottle like I had to do.

There's no fine mist setting on these sprayers.  It goes from closed, to a sloppy spray.  I apply the majority of my detailing liquids to pads or towels, and a fine spray would really cut down on wasted product.  It's a conspiracy! :)Yeah.... just go to your local hardware store, buy cheap spray bottles and transfer your liquids to those.  These sprayers are low quality and sadly I have like 10 of them.  Right in the garbage they will go.Not recommended :(

I've bought five of these over the last 2 years for various bottles of Griot's products I use and so far four of them have blown their internal seals and now leak fluid all over my hand as I spray. This is after maybe a dozen uses, sometimes less. If these sprayers were included with the products it wouldn't be so bad, but since Griot's sells them separately, this is inexcusable. That they call them the "finest" sprayer just makes it worse. I've found the sprayers I can get at my local home improvement store for half the price (including a bottle) are superior to this one. I'll continue to use Griot's other products, but for sprayers I'll look elsewhere.
summary: Not up to Griot's usual standard

reviewText: If this is their "finest", I am pleased that I have not experienced their worst.  Although Griot's has some good products,,,,and some not so good,,,this one is miserable.  When using this with Speed Shine, it just lays big goobers of liquid on the car which then runs off everywhere.  I have tried several of those that I have,,,I once bought 3 of them,,,and they all failed.  I have a friend who details cars and he said that their old sprayers were fine but that he too hates this one,,,and he is a real Griot's bigot.Check out Chemical Guys for a really good one,,,,however some of their product too leave much to be desired, but their sprayer is good in the very fine controllable mist that it lays down.

Got mine with my bottle, I'm not stupid to pay $4 online for a sprayer. I've had it for over a year with countless bottle uses. And it sprays very nicely without using too much product. You got to know how to set the sprayer. Do you really need a manual for it?

I use a lot of Griot's Garage products, but only recently tried Griot's Garage Clay for the first time.  Prior to traying Griot's Garage Clat I have been usingMothers 07240 California Gold Clay Bar Systemon my car for many years.  Overall, Griot's Garage clay did a good job, but I liked working with it less than I like working with Mother's clay.  I will explain the differences below.I am attaching a collage of two photos under customer photos.1) The stock photo is somewhat deceiving as it makes you think the clay fills the nice container it is shipped in. Photo #1 shows the clay in the plastic wrap is it arrived. The amount of clay is sufficient to work with, I am not complaining about that, just the photo makes you think you get a lot more. The container itself is very nice for storage. Mother's clay does not come with a container and I had to come up with a plastic container of my own. A tip on storage: before storing the clay ball in the container wet the outside of the clay ball with Griot's Speed Shine or any other detailing spray. This makes the clay easier to take out the next time as it sticks less to the container.2) Photos #2 shows the 35 oz of Speed Shine which I used as lubricant. Speed shine has almost no scent, provides good cleaning and is easy to work with. Griot's spray trigger  delivers a generous even spray of liquid. Because it is a generous spray the solution is used fairly fast. On the first application of clay I used 1/4 of the bottle. I think I will be able to get 4-5 washes out of this bottle.The clay worked well to remove debris. It took more swipes to remove debris with Griot's clay than with Mother's Clay, but the results were very good. The clay itself is softer and fairly sticky and my hands were slightly yellow when I finished, and there was clay under my nails.  This does not happen when I work with Mother's Clay system.  I was able to remove the residue from my hands using Griot's Speed Shine followed by a vigorous washing with soap.  This made working with the clay less enjoyable.  For example, when the phone rang while I was cleaning my car I could not pick it up because I had clay all over my hands.A tip for short people: I am fairly short so reaching the middle of the roof of my Honda CRV to clay it is difficult. I found that that I can do it if put the clay ball under a triangle-shaped Windshield Reach and Clean ToolStoner 95161 Glass Reach and Clean Tooland use it to rub the clay ball on the parts of the roof I can not reach.  The reason why it works better than other tools is because its surface is concave to follow the windshield shape and that curve holds the clay ball without the ball sliding out.Ali Julia review
summary: Does a nice jobs, but has one minus

reviewText: I just spent some time with this on a dry 70 degree day. I washed the truck well and dried the paint with a shammi. The clay picked up some fine grain stuff and looks like an improvement. reviewText: I looked into a number of options for a clay bar. I used this clay today and was highly impressed.When using a clay bar to remove contaminants (bugs, bird droppings, tar, etc) remember to use clay lube / quick detailer liberally. I purchased Optimum No Rinse and diluted the solution into a Clay Lube / Quick Detailer spray. This worked great with the Griot's Paint Cleaning Clay.I had some significant contamination on the front of my SUV (mostly bug splatters). The clay worked wonders and removed everything visible to the naked eye. If the clay did not pick everything up on the first pass then I gently rubbed the area with the clay (applying lubrication as necessary) until it was gone.When using clay bar remember to do these things:1. Use clay bar on a freshly washed vehicle. I personally prefer to dry as well before doing the clay bar.2. Use lubrication with the clay bar (car soap and water, clay lube, or quick detailer)3. Apply protection after clay barring! The clay bar will remove wax. Always remember to wax after doing a full clay bar.Go with the Griot's clay and you will not be disappointed. I only used about 1/5 of the clay and will be able to re-use it. The clay was malleable and easy to work with. I wore nitrile gloves to protect my skin from chemicals and I made sure to keep the gloves wet so the clay would not stick.
summary: Great Product from a Quality Company

reviewText: Almost every Griot's product I have used has been amazing and their clay is nothing short of amazing. It works extremely well and is very economical compared to other brands. It comes in a nice reusable case and a little goes a long way.

reviewText: Had a some noise coming from the belts on the Z06 and this helped to cure one of those issues.
Looks and feels and fits like the 5 times more expensive Motorcraft OEM.It fits really well and coupled with the new belt, car is as quiet as has ever beenWe will see how long the bearing lasts

This is an idler pulley that fits many applications. It is made of stamped steel and comes with a reducer bushing to use with smaller diameter bolts if needed. The entire pulley including the bearing is made in China. That aside, it is not a bad product and I am pleased with the build quality.
Easy to install, low cost and completely silent. Much easier to buy parts here than standing in line at the local auto parts store dealing with lazy, incompetent employees.

First... check your idler pulley and measure the diameter then check your tension assembly to see if they spin freely. On my 1990 Chevy K2500 350 5.7 w/AC I wanted to replace the pulley on the automatic tension assembly... not the idler pulley on the left side under the alternator. Seems most sites use the words for both interchangeably but that doesn't mean you'll get the correct pulley. The Dorman site states this pulley has a diameter of 76mm (about 3") but Amazon shows it as 4.5" and not only is that incorrect that's about the size of the pulley on the tension assembly... which I thought I was buying. So, I'm partly to blame in the purchasing error because I didn't do enough research first but I did rely on the measurements. I have now purchased the automatic tension mechanism that was at fault and it came with a wheel. I should have pulled the belt first and then checked the tension assembly but that's what happens when you think you know it all. However, at about 11 bucks this is a pretty good price and... since I now have one... I'll replace the idler pulley and clean all the other pulleys while the belt is off. I also noticed that the bolt that holds the wheel on was worn and the wheel would wobble a bit, overheat the belt and cause it to start coming apart. I went through about 3 belts in the last 15 years and probably didn't drive more than 5,000 miles... I thought it was just the belt. This is a solid wheel and includes instructions... like stating you need to make sure the vehicle isn't running before you start replacement. It also includes the bushing but without a bolt you may have a problem like I did. Well worth 5-stars and I've been pretty happy with the Dorman products I have purchased. I think Rock Auto has a great site to determine what parts fit and the Dorman site is also very good... I'll check a little better next time before I assume anything. I have noticed that many listings here and on that big auction site will use words to describe something like this item that aren't always applicable... like "Idler Tension Pulley"... and that is partly what led me to purchase the wrong item... and the fact that both parts look pretty much the same.In my application... as someone else mentioned... I had to use the old spacer/bushings and O-ring because the bushing that comes with this isn't correct... though that may not be the case in all applications.
summary: Oops... wrong wheel for where I needed... and measurements are wrong in listing.

reviewText: I recently ordered this 800 watt unit. I liked the way its put together and all the saftey features the unit has. I installed the inverter in battery area in motorhome. I comes with 6 gadge cables. I just cut off the clamps and hard wired to the battery itself and mounted to underside of RV floor near chassis and battery. Inverer ran both... 22 inch flat screen and DVD player without much effort or much load on inverter. The TV and DVD player and xbox is setup is off a 4 plug receptical in RV itself.I did not want to have to plug tv, DVD and etc from house 110 recepticals and inverter receptical everytime we stopped the RV for the night or few days or run these items through inverter all the time drawing on battery when I had house current available.So I ran and installed UL junction next to invertor with cover . In the junction I ran up to TV cabinet 14ga 110 house wire. I spliced heavy duty 3 wire 14ga cord into house wire in junction box and place heavy duty plug on end into inverter receptical.In Tv Cabinet in RV I ran this wire to a lighted household light switch so I can see when inverter was on battery compartment ( which was outside hidden in compartment) then to a 110 Toggle switch on one side of the toggle switch.On the other side of  toggle switch I connected to the 110 shore ....rv power (when RV is plugged into at campground).The output off toggle went to double recepticals by TV, DVD, Xbox etc would use.I maked the toggle house current on one side and Invertor on other side of toggle switch.Now instead of switching wiring back and forth or leaving inverter running off RV battery I simply toggle back and forth between both souces of 110 power.The toggle can handle 110 current.... left ON.... middle OFF ....right ONAlso both sources of power can never be on to recepticals at same time. Works great
summary: PERFECTED SIZE AND WATTAGE TO RUN TV AND DVD PLAYER IN MOTORHOME.

reviewText: I have a 2000 watt Whistler inverter and am very happy with it (I wrote a review of it if you're interested).  The 2000W version is part of a solution (package? system?) I put together to supply power for a few items I'd like to have available in a power grid failure like a hurricane or an ice storm.Part of that solution is a pair of 12V batteries and a battery charger (NOCO Genius G7200).  The batteries supply the power to the 2000 watt inverter.  The charger keeps them ready or, if the grid is down, recharges them.  My problem was how to supply power to the charger if I deplete the batteries and the grid remains down.Turns out my NOCO charger needs only 150 watts to charge the batteries.  This Whistler 800 watt inverter can provide that without breaking a sweat, and only needs 80 amps DC to provide it (actually, to provide 800 watts, not just the puny 150 watts my charger needs).  My car's alternator provides 105 amps, way more than the Whistler 800 needs to max out.So I bought this item and now my car can power this 800W inverter that can easily and safely recharge the batteries that supply my 2000 watt inverter.  At the same time as it's charging the big guy, this 800W inverter has power to spare for lights and low-draw electronics (laptops, cell phones, cable/DSL modems, wireless routers, VOIP boxes, cordless phones, yada yada yada).You can buy the 400 watt version for a bit less if you like, but if your car will support the 800 watt version (80 amps minimum) why would you not opt for more power and flexibility for just a few bucks more?Nope, I don't work for these guys but I probably should :-)  And yes I'm a Viner but I paid for both this and the 2000w version and all the other goodies in that system.  Whistler makes a good range of products here.
summary: Exactly what I wanted and then some

They are soldered in which makes it a PITA to replace. The reviews say they don't blow easily, unless you are an idiot and hook the pos and neg up backwards. Then you deserve to spend the time to re-solder new fuses in. But seriously this is an outstanding inverter. I have already used it a bunch of times using drills, sanders, and a dremel in the first week of getting it. Other websites give a description saying it comes with 6 foot cables but thats combining both which are really 3 feet each (pos and neg). The terminals are on the wimpy side but who cares, this thing kicks butt. I wish it came with a digital display that shows the watts, volts, amps, etc like the larger units have. Its a perfect size and has the tabs on the base to mount it to whatever tickles your fancy. Don't expect it to come with the cigarette attachment thingy. Its too big and will blow your vehicle cigarette outlet fuses. Most people assume the mid size inverters come with it. They don't. Get over it. Just use the alligator clamps and throw it on your battery or be a man and hard wire it into your rig. Buy it right now.Edit...I just used this inverter to power a small George Foreman Grill! The cables got a little warm so keep an eye on them. Mmmmmm grilled cheese sandwich!!! What else can I run on this thing?!

There aren't many products that I rave about, but I absolutely love my Fumoto drain valve.  I installed a F-106N on my 2008 Hyundai Sonata (with a 2.4L engine) and it's never coming off--until I sell the vehicle, that is.The quality is high.  The Fumoto drain valve incorporates stainless steel and brass.  It employs a ball valve, which is a tried-and-true bit of plumbing technology that is used in a huge variety of applications in industry and your very own home.  In short, it doesn't leak the slightest bit when the valve is closed.Installation is easy.  You do have to tighten it using an open-ended wrench, and go by feel alone regarding how tight to make it, but you can handle it.  Just don't overdo it when you tighten it. These Fumoto drain valves have recommended torque values that are typically lower than those of a standard steel drain plug, because the brass that comprises their threads is softer than steel. (The maximum recommended torque for the F-106N is 18 lb/ft.) Also, they don't recommend tightening the Fumoto valve using the hex part of the nipple.Having the Fumoto drain valve greatly eases oil changes.  Greatly?  Yes, especially if you are aware that oil drain plug crush washers ordinarily need replacement, lest leaks develop.  With the Fumoto drain valve, you won't have to worry about overtightening, worn washers, getting oil all over your hand and arm (and floor...).  And of course, you don't even need a wrench to change the oil.  With the N-type Fumoto drain valve, you don't have to use a hose, but you can use one to prevent a mess if wind or other issues require it.I occasionally have my used oil analyzed, and when I do, the Fumoto drain valve is a great way to get a few ounces of oil out without a hassle or mess.  And it's easier (for me at least) to get an uncontaminated sample using a Fumoto drain valve than using an evacuator.I've seen some people complain that a Fumoto drain valve increases the risk of vandalism.  Seriously?  I very much doubt there has ever been a person who was intent on doing harm to a vehicle who squeezed underneath it hoping to find a Fumoto drain valve, didn't find one, and then walked away in defeat.  All it takes to remove any drain valve is an adjustable wrench.  The same wrench that can smash your body work and windows in.Before ordering a nipple-type Fumoto drain valve, I'd urge you to check to make sure you have adequate clearance underneath the oil pan.  The nipple on N-type Fumoto drain valves only adds 5/8" to the regular Fumoto drain valves, but if you have a vehicle with little clearance to begin with, it could make a difference.If you have a Fumoto drain valve installed and you ever let anyone else change the oil on your behalf, make sure to tell them about the Fumoto drain valve, and explain that it has a lever that needs to be lifted and turned.  I have seen reports of people who brought their vehicles into a shop only to have the Fumoto drain valve removed completely.  If that happens, you can't be sure that they won't overtighten it, use the wrong washer with it, or even if they'll reinstall it at all.The other piece of advice I have to offer is that I use a 1/2" vacuum cap to protect the nipple of my Fumoto drain valve from road debris and dirt (your local auto parts store has these vacuum caps; or you can order them here).  I don't feel that this is necessary, but it's probably a good idea, especially if you ever have your oil analyzed.
High quality part .. I'm glad I installed it .. I'm sure it's going to make life easier in the future.

This valve looks like it is well made and should last.  I installed it and expect to be very glad when I drain the oil in the future.I ordered the one with the hose end since I need to direct the oil away from suspension parts that usually get sloppy with oil while draining.I have installed a suggested wire hose clamp to ensure that the lever does not accidentally move and drain my oil if bumped by brush or some other object.

This oil drain valve eliminates the need to hold onto a hot oily drain plug, worry about the seal of the plug, even finding the proper wrench.
