This item is great for cars with incandescent brake lights.  They are very high quality and should work fine to correct fast blinking light issues for normal cars.In my case I bought them for correcting fast blinking light issue on my Lotus Evora that happens after doing the popular DRL-disable hack, which involves disconnecting the main headlights from a relay circuit that controls the brake lights. The ECU is programmed to expect a certain load on the brake light circuit to determine whether or not the brake lights are out.  This value includes a default load of used by the DRLs.  By turning off disconnecting the DRLs from the brakelight circuit, the baseline has lowered and therefore the ECU thinks one of the bulbs (front or rear) have failed (when they are actually not) and increases the turn signal blink rate. (The Evora has no independent turn signal lights, it uses the brake lights).Anyway, the fix is to mock the original load, thereby correcting the current levels back within the expected threshold.While these resistors will work in eliminating the fast blinking, the draw far too much amps than actually needed.  Also, at drawing 2 amps of current they generate an amazing amount of heat, which would be okay on most cars with metal body work, but for the Evora, the delicate composite body and trim panels surrounding the heat sink can potentially warp  under prolonged heating. Also, because the DRL circuit leaves the lights on while engine is not running, more battery power will be used up than before. Lastly the excessive 2A load would negate the car's ability to actually detect a real bulb failure in the event it really happens.All that is needed is to simulate the original 3W bulb load at each brake light using a pair of 30 ohm 5W resistors.  Each of those will only draw a miniscule 250mA.Anyway, I hope this helps.
summary: Great resistors. Evora owners with DRL hack, read on...

reviewText: I needed a little charger to maintain a motorcycle battery and this one works great. It's automatic. It will will charge the battery and automatically switch over to maintain on it's own without having to flip any switches manually. It can also detect whether the battery is a 6 volt or 12 volt and automatically change to charge and maintain either one. I also like the connections that were included with the charger. You can put a permanent pigtail on the terminals on your motorcycle and all you have to do is hook the charger to it without having to lift the seat or remove anything to hook up to the charger. It also includes the regular alligator clip type connections if you'd rather use that type of connections.  It was also very reasonable in price. Couldn't ask for more for $19 bucks!UPDATE:I've been using this charger continuously now for almost 7 months and it's still working great.

I write this review, looking back...I am either SUPER happy with things like this!orThey just S.U.C.K.  2 Star or Lower - Good product is not expensive...This ranes true with the Schumacher brand, I have two other products that I have had for 35 years... and they Still work perfectly!I Especially like the charging wires than can switch between, Clips vs. Eyelets for a Permanent mount to my equipment. Then you only need extra Clips and then you can simply Plug in the Charger between batteries.I am going to add them to my Riding Mowers, ATV, and two Motorcycles! Then in the Winter, just rotate the charger every week to a different machine! A great product at entry level price... My Battery Tender works great for my long term storage Cars, But I may have been just as well off with out the price difference...I would rethink this if I were to do it all over again. Plus you can do 6 Volt and 12 Volt systems in one product and "GEL-Cells" too.... Better Value with out a Cool BAG!BatmanDSM
summary: Great Value for such a small Smart Charger!

reviewText: As another reviewer noted, this thing is dummy proof.  I have multiple units keeping batteries charged in seasonal use vehicles & boats.

This thing works great and must be quite simple inside of the plastic housing as the first thing you will notice is how lite the charger is .The cords are long enough for pretty much any use and the plastic housing is smaller than the picture makes it seem. It is pretty much the size of a Kleenex box if anyone is wondering as this could be a selling point for some users but I have been using to charge power wheels batteries and it is working great. I would buy again if I need a second.
summary: Smaller than the picture makes it look

reviewText: Super easy to use!  I use this to keep my 2008 Harley Electra Glide's battery topped off.  It comes with a quick-disconnect harness that allows you to quickly attach the charger.

Very easy to use.  The only problem I find with it is the green "Charged"  indicator light  is a little weak in brightness and sometimes hard to see.  About 1/3 the price of a Battery Tender and does all of the same things.
Bought this on a recommendation from a friend to use as helmet visor cleaner/polish.  It works GREAT for this application, I just wish I could find the smaller can....
Found out about this product through amazon and it's awesome. I use all types of waxes and spray detailers. If this wasn't in a spray can it would be even better.
I will most certainly buy again, just have to run out first. This stuff is incredible at cleaning ANYTHING related with the motorcycle.
It cleans and polishes, no residue or streaking. It works well on any paint job leaving a high gloss finish which actually repels dirt. Highly recommend.
It works really well and I have used it for many years.  I use it on the plastics on my motorcycle and cant say how well it works on chrome because I do not have any!

Just wiped down my Star V1300 with this stuff. Goes on easy and comes off easy. Leaves a real nice shine and is a breeze to use. It did not let it dry and just did one section of the bike at a time. Worked flawlessly. I will keep a can of this in my saddlebag. Used a micro fiber towl to wipe it down.

When I bought my new cruiser this past year, the dealer recomended this product. I have been using it ever since on all my bikes and I love it.Safe on plastics and vynal. Cleans and leaves a showroom shine.

This is works great. I use it on the mirrors, fairings, aluminum, black plastics,my gauge cluster, and on my polished frame. It gives a brilliant shine and gives the appearance that the bike was just washed. This reminds me ofGriot's Garage 11066 Spray-On Car Wash - 1 Gallon. They both have the same smell and do almost the same thing. The only difference is the pro Honda spray is lighter and takes less effort to wipe off. The is a great product for keeping your bike nice and clean.

Don't get me wrong, I like this kit, but and it would of been nice if it came with some kind of wipes or cloths to use with the cleaning solutions. If it came with wipes then it would be a "complete" kit. The box states it is a TRIAL size. These are to be used for touch-ups, they are not intended to be used to clean your entire vehicle. There is probably enough of each product to be used at least 10 or more times depending on how much of each product you use.I don't see a use for this for my everyday vehicle, but it has come in handy for our street and hot rods. Our family has two antique muscle cars and 3 hot rods. A couple of the vehicles date back to 1930. We are always going to car shows and exhibitions with them. These are the perfect size to keep underneath the seats hidden away from the public eye. If you have ever been to a classic car show, you know all the men stand around buffing their vehicle all high and mighty. It does not phase them that they are cleaning the same spot for 4 hours, but all that matters it looks shiny! This kit has everything we need - all purpose cleaner to remove break dust from the rims, dashboard protector, carpet and upholstery, leather protector and window clear. The scents are wonderful, not too harsh or strong. I can not stand using Armor All because of the smell it leaves behind. However, these cleaners smell like a very light scented hand lotion or deodorizer. The window cleaner has no scent. I have attached a few pictures showing a couple of our classics cars with "notes" where the Eco Touch Care Care products were used.I would of given it a 5-star rating, but since it did not come with cleaning wipes or cloths I really do not consider this set to be a "trial" kit.
summary: Trial sizes, wish it came with cleaning cloths

reviewText: Has five components: leather cleaner, window cleaner, carpet cleaner, dash cleaner, and all-putpose cleaner.  Convenient to get all in one package.  Now to review the individual items:*all purpose--works well on all surfaces.  Cleans and shines nicely.*dash--works well and as described.  Also clean and shines well.*carpet--easy to use, removed old stains, and has a nice scent. Kind of a citrus scent.*glass cleaner-you will need a microfiber cloth to use this. I got a little microfiber handheld squeegy/cleaner from a local Dollar store and that worked great. Cleaned just as advertised. Streak free.  One of the nicest cleaners we have used on windows.*leather--this was just average.  Hard to dispense as it has to be poured. Did not like the smell AT ALL! The cleaning was quite average; Maguire works much better.So, overall, the four cleaners are a good value but the leather cleaner is something I will never use again.

Most eco friendly products seem to have some drawbacks, unpleasant smell or texture or being  very expensive. These products seem to work very well on my "new to me " SUV. There is a great windshield cleaner that you can spray on to remove those huge bugs that seem to leave an impermeable deposit on the windshield. If I am getting gas and have a particularly nasty spot, I spray with this and it disappears along with the normal grime that you can get with the sponge and squeegee.It has a dashboard protector which I found handy because this vehicle came with scratches as if a small dog was trying to get to the windshield. The scratches disappeared with just a spray and a wipe. The kit includes an all purpose cleaner which I use in the car seat, an upholstery/carpet cleaner and "surprise", a really good leather cleaner. As the owner of several saddles, I have been using leather cleaners for fifty years and this is good stuff. The seats look like new when I am done.

Eco Touch's Car Care Kit Mini Pack is true to its name. It is a "mini pack," more of a sampler than anything, that includes small (2 ounce) bottles of various cleaning fluids. There's the "All Purpose" fluid, another designed to clean the dashboard, another for the carpeting, etc. I thought each did its job well enough, and this mini-pack is perfect for anyone who wants to try it out before committing himself to a more expensive purchase.

Everything you need to give your road weary vehicle a spa treatment.  Not only was the kit very handy, it contained products that did the job. I will say it is targeted to the higher end vehicle as it has a leather treatment. Not every car owner needs this. I might like to see a version that contains a treatment for fabric seats. I also think the inclusion of a couple microfiber cloths might be handy. That way, you could store it in your vehicle and have it ready for emergency spot cleaning.
summary: So handy! This will make your vehicle feel SO GOOD!

reviewText: This isn't really a kit, in that there are no cloths or wipes to use when applying the various cleaning agents; rather it's a collection of cleaning agents in sample sizes.  That being said, it's actually quite handy.  I keep this in the boot of one of my cars, along with some paper and micro-fiber towels, for touch ups when I'm away from my garage.The "kit" contains an all purpose cleaner, a glass cleaner, dashboard protectorant, carpet cleaner and a leather care product.  They all work fairly well.  The glass cleaner, in particular, does a nice job; streak free with little effort.  The leather care product, however, has a very offensive smell.  Speaking of odors, most of the products are scented.  I don't care for that.  I don't want an artificial smell in my cars; I prefer the smell of the natural leather.Overall a nice handy kit to tuck into the glove box or boot.  Nothing earth shattering here in terms of performance; the Griot's or Mequiar products are as good or better, but it is compact and travels well.
summary: Not Really a Kit, But a Collection of Samples

reviewText: The eco touch collection makes a nice interior cleanup emergency kit.The window spray works wonderfully to get interior window buildup which causes nighttime glare. It can vaporize very quickly on a hot summer day.The all purpose cleaner wasn't as effective with what I felt comfortable spraying on my center console material. The carpet and upholstery cleaner didn't appear to do much for the dirt spot on the floor either; perhaps I didn't use enough of either product, but I finished them off by my usual method.I protect my dashboard with a towel and use my horsehair brush vacuum cleaner attachment when particulates are present; it's not the type of dash that would benefit from such a treatment, so I have no use for the dashboard spray. I haven't any leather in my car to use the cream on, either.I'm not a big fan of filling my car with scents. These sprays' scents are very light and subtle, so for those who like that stuff you shouldn't be overwhelmed by them.I experienced a growing discomfort in my hand while continuing to pump the little spray jar - switching hands helps. I had to "burp" the jar too. The sprayers are reusable, so that's nice.These care products are acceptable, I'm sure, but I have my proven solutions already, and none of these items have succeeded in converting me. Having a care kit can be essential for some people, and this would be the perfect size to keep on hand.

I'm a car guy who used to own a custom detail shop and who has his cars detailed regularly.  So, I'm going to be a harsh critic of this type of product.This is not a kit that you would keep in your glovebox for quick clean-ups.  In fact, it doesn't even include any cloths.  This is really just a trial pack with 2oz of five of their products, probably intended to get you to buy larger quantities.The products are:"All Purpose" spray"Window Clear" spray"Dashboard Protect" spray"Carpet + Upholstery" spray"Leather Care" creamThey all worked OK (not great), but they are also all scented. Some are lemon-orange scented.  Others are lavender scented.  All smell pretty bad, in my opinion.  If I walked out of my detail shop after paying a few hundred bucks, and my car smelled like this, I would not be happy.My only real concern was the leather care - it seems to be very oily and not really like leatherique, saddle soap or other products I use.This stuff might be OK for 90% of people driving around in ordinary cars, but if you are someone who really pays attention to car detailing - you actually own an orbital polisher - this is probably not for you.
summary: Product works OK, but it is really a sample/trial pack and they are scented

reviewText: All of the products work great.  These are more of sample sizes, not full size.  The leather cleaner worked well too but it smells terrible.  I wouldn't buy the leather cleaner. The other products, I do recommend.
summary: Products work great.  The leather cleaner smells terrible

reviewText: I must admit I'm really impressed.  The size is such that it fits neatly into the glove box.  I get in the car all too often look at my dash, remember I need to clean it and forget it again.  This set is great in that I can keep it in the glove box and clean it then and there.The sent of the dash cleaner is great.  Not over whelming (even when you get in the car after the car has set in the sun).  Also it lacks the chemical smells of the leading products.  Unlike other products the finish is a mat finish. For me this is great because if any accidently gets on the windows it is not a mess to clean off.  I also feel like the glossy finishes show the dust more and even tend to attract dust or show finger prints / smudges.The leather product a little goes a long way and enhances the look of the leather without a slippery residue.The carpet spot cleaner is a must for me as a coffee drinker/spiller.  In previous auto detailing packages I bought a carpet product was not included.  The sent is good and does a great job at spot lifting.the window cleaner cleans without streaking and does not have the overwhelming scent that other window cleaners have.  This lack of a chemical scent is essential for me when working in close places such as a car.What would make this kit even more effective would be an included cleaning cloth.  Since it is not there I recommend consideringZwipes Microfiber 36-Pack of Cleaning Cloths.  There are many more cloths than you would need for your car - however I have found them to be a good bulk value and I have had a set for over a year and they have worn really well.
summary: great size, excellent value, green friendly and works well to boot!

reviewText: I'm always looking for products that are better for the environment and ones that have non-chemical scents. This is especially true in the summer when a car sometimes sits in the heat for hours and anything you use for cleaning can come back to haunt you with an overwhelming smell. I found this sampler kit of products to do a decent job of cleaning and the fragrances are pleasing and not too heavy.As the description states, these are 2 oz. sample sizes, which really goes a lot further than I thought at first. These are the different items in the kit along with their scent:"All Purpose" spray - Lemon-orange scent"Window Clear" spray - Unscented"Dashboard Protect" spray - Lavender"Carpet & Upholstery" spray -Orange-grapefruit scent"Leather Care" cream - Not certain what the scent is, but it's nice!None of the fragrances are overwhelming, so even if you used them at the same time, I don't think your car would smell like a perfume counter. But I use them on different days because I like to smell each one. The handy 2 oz sizes would be great to take along on a trip. You know how easily a car's interior can get trashed when you're driving several hours a day. These are products that I enjoy using and will order the full size versions when these are empty.
summary: Interior auto detailing products with a nice, clean fragrance

reviewText: I can't say this is the best product I have ever used for interiors. (That belongs to products I have used from Zaino Brothers). But these are adequate, and do seem to be less harsh than typical cleaners.I did have a problem with the bottles. Weirdly, every bottle in my kit had a "straw" for the pump that was way too long. It actually curled from the bottom of the bottle so that it was unable to pump any fluid. Not just in one or two bottles, but all of them. Not a flaw of the product itself, but a bit annoying when I was trying it out.I did not think that the cleaners worked quite as good as others I have used, especially the leather cleaner. But they did not seem very harsh at all, and using a light brush (I used a toothbrush) yielded good results.Would I use these again? Probably yes. Would I go out of my way to find them? Probably not. But they do represent a good way to keep materials clean while helping protect your interior as well as helping the environment.

This package includes five different bottles of car cleaning products; one each for leather, windows, dash, carpet/upholstery, and all purpose. One thing I noticed immediately was the pleasant smell. The dashboard cleaner works very well. It doesn't leave a shiny look, and does a great job of actually cleaning and protecting. Same goes for the leather cleaner. I've used the window cleaner the most, so I think this bottle probably needs to be a larger size or sold separately. I haven't used the all purpose bottle yet, but will try it on the wheels, as recommended by another reviewer. The small size of each bottle allows easy storage in the glove compartment or console for those quick touch-ups. Recommended.

I can't fail the company for referring to this car care kit as a 'mini pack' but I would have preferred if they had labeled it a SAMPLE KIT.  Each bottle is 2 oz and at the price I can understand.  This mini kit will travel well in your glove compartment or underneath your kitchen sink.  I still do not feel that it is enough liquid for our Nissan Armada's needs.  If you do not have any product at all then this is a good starting point to see which products you would want in a larger size.The kit includes: All Purpose cleaner, Dashboard Protector, Carpet and Upholstery cleaner, Leather Care cleaner and Streak-free Window Cleaner.The all purpose cleaner performed as it should as did the dashboard protector.  We found the dashboard protector to not be oily to the touch as others have been in the past.  The carpet and upholstery cleaner performed rather well on our dirty rugs considering they haven't been washed in two years.  They smelt horrible before and after using a bit of the cleaner they have seen a new life for a bit longer.  The leather cleaner stood out to ME because with my husband's other cleaner I would slide off of my seat and jam into the dashboard each and every time.  This is while being strapped in.  With the Eco Touch cleaner I no longer slide off of the seat.  The bad thing is that it STINKS.... not pleasant at all.  Our other cleaner with all of it's sliding had a pleasant almond scent.  Another big performer was the window cleaner.  It did not streak one bit but you must use a Microfiber cloth.  The exclusion of a cloth was a bit upsetting because you will not get the full potential of the glass cleaner without it.Highly recommend if you are in the market to try new products for the upkeep of your vehicle.  Understand that they are tiny bottles and should be marketed as samples.  I do believe they get away with that because it is convenient to have a wide array for all your car cleaning needs in a small package that is readily found in your glove.  Recommend the leather cleaners performance but not the scent.

It definitely doesn't clear it up perfectly but the chip is much less visible now. They give you quite a lot of the fluid but the entire kit is a single use item. A bit of a bummer really but it does what it says it does. Quite simple to use as well.

Fixed my windshield crack as expected.  Almost as good as a Windshield repair service and a lot cheaper.  Would recommend to anyone.  Follow the instructions very carefully and you will get a good result.
My review basically says it all. I did not have a chip, I had a spider webbing crack, about 1 inch by 1 inch. This did nothing for it.
summary: Did NOTHING for the spider webs cracks.

reviewText: This product is ok but to be honest it can only fix a crack maybe 1/3 of a size of a penny. I used it and it was quite useless for the crack on my windshield. I even bought two and basically you can only use it once and that is it. Then it is useless. I cannot recommend it based on my experience but if you have a tiny tiny tiny tiny crack that does not even require fixing this maybe your solution.
summary: It is not what it claims to be

reviewText: I had a pretty big spider web crack in my windshield from a rock. It was probably about half an inch in diameter. This repair kit made the crack much less visible/transparent, but the larger cracks are still visible.
summary: Helps, but not as good as I imagined.

reviewText: Had a stone that deflected off the windshield and chipped the glass. If left untreated, the crack would grow and the windshield would have to be replaced. Make sure to follow the directions very carefully. Even being meticulous, I had to actually do it 2x, as the adhesive did not penetrate well on the first effort. Second time around - the adhesive finally sealed all the cracks and the windshield had held up.
summary: fixed a chip, saved me big $$$

reviewText: The kit itself is easy enough to use, the instructions are clear but I've only had luck repairing tiny star cracks. Repair of small star cracks makes them nearly invisible but anything longer than 1/2 inch doesn't get filled well. Repair of longer (more than 1/2 inch) may stop the crack from spreading but does nothing to conseal it so the crack is still very visibe.Bottom line - don't procrastinate and use this product before the crack spreads. If you do that, this product should work well.

I used to do some windshield repair 15 years ago back in college working for a detail shop.  Same technique this product uses.  But we were able to not just fix the rock chip and prevent from spreading, but we were able to visually eliminate between 90% to 95% of the chip.  This product most likely prevents a rock chip from getting bigger, but visually, it didn't eliminate anything!  Use this to prevent from spreading but don't expect the rock chip to be diminished visually......  At All.

I read the directions and also watched the "how to" video on Youtube.  It was very easy to apply and it worked great.  Yes, I can still see a little of the rock chip, but I'm confident it will not crack.

Instructions were fine and it was easy enough to do. I had to do it twice though to get acceptable results. Good thing there was enough solution to do it multiple times.Posting this a few months after using it, and the windshield is still holding up fine.
It worked but it's only one time use. Fixed a small spider crack I had in my speed3. Looks a lot better.
summary: Nice but only one time use.

reviewText: This stuff didnt work at all. The intructions were a bit hard to understand, but once figured out, the product was a piece of garbage anyway. Didnt really make a difference, if anything made the problem worse.

Well my headlights were a gross greenish cloudy hazed color.  Used this kit and they literally almost look brand new.  Now all I use when washing my car is PlastX to give them a nice shine, and have not had any issues or cloudiness comeback.
summary: Dont be afraid to press hard

reviewText: Cool product. I used this kit to restore a yellow headlight on a 2001 Nissan Sentra and a 2003 Ford F150. It takes some time and you don't want to rush the process; but they looked good when I was done. Saved me about $200.00 from a dealer.

Do what the instructions say and you will get what you expected. The headlights look like "new". Be sure to take your time and get a stool (or bucket) to sit on. Bending over to polish the lights makes your back tired and causes you to hurry!
Worked great on my oxidized headlight. I should've recharged my drill before doing the second headlight, however. But the results are amazing!

If you want like-new headlights, order this.  So simple and easy to use--it couldn't be more clear and simple.  Remember, you do need a high-rpm house drill for this kit, or this won't work for you.By the way, this is my second kit, for what it's worth.

I've bought Craftsman's C3 XCP wireless drill (max 1600RPM) and tried this kit. This kit worked very well and my cloudy lens is restored to crystal clear. Note, however, that some swirl marks are still left is you look closer. Also, if you are not careful, you can strip the bumper paint as the masking tape can easily be torn.If you're not confident enough to use drill, let someone with skills or a shop do it for you as you can cause damage.
i was blowned away after using the 3M 39045 Headlight Renewal with Protect-ant kit as the finished product was amazing. That was 2 months ago and the buff still holds. Highly recommended.

If your headlights are yellowed, fogged, or opaque from sun damage, you're not seeing as well at night as you could be. There's a ton of kits out there to refinish headlights, and they all work the same way, by sanding off the damaged layer, and polishing the plastic underneath to a smooth surface.The bonus here is the protectant, which helps prevent the yellowing and oxidation from coming back. You do need to apply it often, once a month or so, to keep protection in place, but a good car wax will work once you run out of the packet.3M has frequent rebates on these products, so keep an eye out and give one a try. It's a small price to pay for safety on the road.

I used a single kit on the headlights of my 1998 Chrysler Town and Country and my 1996 Ford F150.  The result for both vehicles was amazing.  The polishing sequence of the pads in the kit transformed my lenses from so opaque the bulbs weren't visible to nearly new looking.  The increased nighttime visibility was truly impressive. I would not hesitate to use this product again.  I can't imagine a better DIY solution to tired headlight lenses - and it keeps stuff out of landfills by eliminating the need for replacements.
summary: One kit did my van and truck

reviewText: This works better than the other brand I used before. All the renewals seem to do a good job, but reoxidize w/i 6 months. After this last time, I bought kevlar headlight adhesive sheets-$30 on Amazon. These are available cut specifically to the size of headlights and driving lights of auto.

I purchased this product to restore my headlights and it did a great job.  Cheaper here than at the auto store and identical product.  Follow the directions or watch the video and you will be impressed.

Follow the instructions and your back to seeing a bright road ahead at night. They have put together the perfect combination of grit and liquid to do the job. Just keep in mind that once the factory coating has deteriorated to the point you need this lit the damage is done and you will have to redo the light regularly (Yearly) until they need replacing. I believe the Headlight are the eyes of the car the clearer they are the newer the car looks.
I get about 18 months out of these,they do work. I've had my headlights professionally done and used the 3M. This works as well as professional $50 job.
summary: Works. Don't expect a lifetime solution

reviewText: This is a nice product and did exactly as I expected it would. My lights went from yellow and dull to crystal clear. However I did not expect that it would take as much effort as it did. The light has to be sanded three different times with three different grades of sandpaper and then an additional once over with a fine sanding cream.Like I said my expectations were that it would be very quick and easy and maybe I had unrealistic expectations. The reality is it is fairly easy but takes closer to an hour to do properly. I would certainly use this product again and I would recommend it.
summary: Works well but a bit more work that I expected it would take.

reviewText: I used this kit to do the badly damaged lenses on a motorhome. There is enough for probably 2 more sets. It took about an hour. This is a nicely made kit of everything you need to make the worst lenses look great. You will need a drill.The things that you must remember.The drill needs to be around 1600 rpm. Less and it may take a long time. A corded one may be the best.This is not for the merely discolored but not scratched. For those an oxidation remover is better. This is for the ones where the hard coating is damaged and scratched.This will remove any UV barrier left and you can expect UV discoloration and scratching to begin showing up again in 3 months with all of these kits. The included UV protection won't do much to stop it. I suggest getting either a spray on UV cured hard coating or a aftermarket protection sheet coating to protect them. (Amazon sells them). In my case that added $40 to the cost of the job but replacement lights would be $500 for the pair!. I expect this to last for 1-3 years before needing the scratch covering replaced.

Nice system. the Drill bonnet inside the kit makes the job easier. I would highly recommend a drill system. OTW, it will take twice the time and effort. It does not get your plastic on the headlight back to 100%. I would say, 85-90%. But, noticeably improved, whiter and clearer than before. The first system lasted about 2 years without the lens UV protection application. So, this time, did it with a final UV application. It was more like a wax finish as opposed to a clear coat finish I was expecting. Nevertheless, I will see if will last longer with a final UV coat.
The instructions are very helpful and easy to use. This is a good product and lives up top the 3M name.

Maybe since I park my car inside my headlights weren't too bad, but they were getting a tiny bit frosted so I decided to head it off at the pass.  The first step with the gold sanding pad is the key to a successful outcome.  You have to sand off everything you want to get rid of in this step because the remaining steps are just to minimize then buff out those scratches.  I should have been more aggressive with the first (gold) step, but I was scared of doing something I couldn't undo.  When you start sanding and your headlight gets frosted you think that it will never be right again.  Trust me, spend some time with that first step and use all of your sanding discs to get rid of all of the haze and pits.  Then, follow the remaining steps per the directions and your headlights will be beautiful again.  Use this kit when you have some time to dedicate to it.  Pull up a chair and allow yourself at least an hour so you can slowly and thoroughly perform each step.

I was able to bring back the headlights from my wife's 2003 Corolla.  Almost brought them back to new.  It does take some time depending on how bad the headlights are.  It took me 1 hour each headlight but the headlights where very hazy.
summary: Good prodcut.  Just take your time with it.

reviewText: The lights are easy to see in daytime. They seem to be well made. If anyone rear-ends my trailer it will be because they are blind.
This led light is excellent. Easy to install. I replaced the original lights in my trailer, and these lights are twice as bright.

Not near as bright as others I've seen, the original incandescent light assembly was a lot brighter.The gaskets does not fit snuggly in the hole opening allowing the light to just sit loose in it, it would eventually fall out. I was able to use my original gasket but again the brightness is the main issue, should be twice as bright.
Converting my old tandem trailer to led. They have  the same standard plug as all ovals, fit perfect, and have been running for a year with no issues

Replaced some original "light bulb" type of lights on a boat trailer with these LED's.  Very low cost, and installation was very easy.  Just get something under the round black grommet, start to pull, and it will come out of frame.  Just connect the wiring, and slide the new one with new grommet into the frame.  The light is held in place and "suspended" by the grommet.  I have not put the trailer into the water yet, but the lights look fine, and are reasonable bright.
summary: worked just fine - good value for price

reviewText: I love this wax! It gave my car a great shine and it protects my paint from any harsh contaminates.
The liquid wax goes on easily and, after wiping with the microfiber cleaning cloth provided, leaves a nice clear shine. For me it's all about ease of use, quality, and results. Meguiar's delivers!

I love this new wax by Meguiar's. I applied this to my clayed and polished car, so just note that. It is VERY HARD to see when you apply this to your car (I have dark blue paint). It is basically clear even under my garage lights. This might make you put on more wax than is needed. After awhile, you get the hang of it though. I put this on a quarter of my car at a time, waited 4 minutes, then buffed off. After this was, my car was incredibly shiny and had rich color. This also repelled the dust and water that seems to get on my car every morning.

its an excellent wax, easy on and off, it leaves sometimes black streaks on my black car, but i learned how to do it properly the second time, is to go 1/2 panel maximum and wax off immedietly, this way i had no streaks, ok on plastic mirrors and trim, very easy to apply than paste waxes, in the commercial on you tube meguiars claim you can wax the whole car and then wax off, , i dont think so, again 1/2 a panel each time and then moving to the next is the most ideal way, for example the hood of the coupe is long, so i devided it to four sections, t,he door devided to 2 sections and so on, at the end excellent product.

reviewText: I used this to wax my Jeep and it worked really well. It was very simple to apply and remove (even in direct sunlight), and left a nice rich shine on the paint. I'll definitely buy this product again.
summary: and left a nice rich shine on the paint

reviewText: This liquid wax is very easy to apply and even easier to remove.  It is not like paste wax that usually takes a lot of effort to remove.  It leaves a nice shine and I expect it to last about 3-4 months.  I normally renew wax every 3 months anyway, so it works out good for me.

Once I figured out how little product I should be using on the car, it was amazingly easy to apply and take off.  Like many people, I figured the more the better.  After talking to and watching the Meguiar's tech, I realized that I have been applying wax wrong all these years.  They've got some good videos on their website, so I won't waste print describing the proper way, but I will say that the haze left to dry out should be close to non-existent.  So an extremely light haze that can just be seen is just about perfect.  If you have to work to take it off, that's way too much wax applied.  It took me a long time to get away from the old paste waxes, but I won't ever go back to all that work.

I must say this wax leaves a brilliant shine.It's better to let this wax dry thoroughly before taking it off to make the job a bit easier.If it's taken off to soon it leaves streaks.Overall a good wax.All Meguiar's products are good.A few are pricey but U get a good name product.Complete Microfiber Towels Car Kit - 2 All Purpose Microfiber Towels - 1 Microfiber Towel For Streak Free Glass- For Home Or Auto - 2 Ultra Plush 16 by 24 Microfiber Auto Detailing Towels - 1 Auto Dust Pad For Home Or Auto

This wax worked out really well. When I was younger I used to only use the three step wax products. Not that I'm older and really don't have the time to wax my car three times, I wanted an all in one application solution. This product worked just as well as my former three step product. It's been six months now and the water still beads right off my car.

I received this product as a gift recently (I had posted this in my Amazon wishlist) and could not be happier. As the product states, this is their "Ultimate" synthetic wax. I've worked with various types of waxes and this was by far the easiest to remove. Application was no different from the carnuba style wax paste, but removal was so easy. Literally, you can apply, walk away, and come back to remove the wax.Just remember to follow the directions and don't push too hard into the paint to prevent any scratches. Meguiar's is one of the top brands for a reason, and this does not disappoint.

I purchased this wax as part of a complete car finish overhaul solution using pretty much all Meguiar's products from the claybar to the Ultimate Polish, Ultimate Quick Detailer spray and micofiber clothes. I did reviews for all of the products I used, including the polishing pad, except for the claybar which I purchased from a local store last year. The claybar works well so I can recommend that too.I have tried other Meguiar's wax products like the NXT 2.0, which I did not care for, and find this wax to be their best hands down. I used the included pad to apply the wax versus a machine and the Meguiar's microfiber clothes to remove it. I found it relatively easy to apply and remove although it took some effort when the sun started to go down and the wax was not drying well enough.  On that point, regardless of what the instructions may say, I prefer and have the best results when I apply wax to a completely cool surface. Especially if it's black like my car. When I say cool I mean completely cool. When applied on a cool surface and left to dry completely, it comes off easily. I normally finish a wax job with some Meguiar's Ultimate Quick Detailer anyway to bring out the final shine so it takes care of any smudges or wax residue left behind. I did a review on the detailing spray last year.The wax has been on for a few weeks now and has been through about four washes with, of course, Meguiar's Gold Class car wash, and is holding up very well. After washing I go over it with the detailing spray using the microfiber clothes to bring it to a nice shine. I suspect it will hold up for a few more weeks or more. I'll be sticking with this wax for sure. Has a nice smell too.Let me also mention, the wax only works as well as the car finish will let it. That goes for pretty much any wax. If you are serious about getting your car to look it's best you must and I mean must, start with a claybar. Period. Or you are wasting your time and will not get the best out of any wax. You may also need to use rubbing and polishing compound too depending on the results you want. Just saying.And no I do not work for Meguiar's. I have tried a lot of car care products through the years and  while I am not expert, I just happen to like their product line - no not everything they make, but I think I have found a nice suite of products I can rely on and recommend to anyone who is willing to put in the work and wants good results.
summary: Nice Shine and Holds Up Well

reviewText: The key to successfully using this product is to apply it extremely thin,  applying it to thick causes streaking, and is hard to remove.  With 1 bottle and being wasteful, I can get at least 20 applications.  This equates to less then 1oz of Wax...Highly recommend this wax for anyone that keeps a car outside 24/7.  Holds up extremly well under high temperatures.

This wax can be used under full sun exposure! Meaning that if you dont have a garage to do it under, this is GREAT news!It was super easy to remove, to those people having trouble removing it, make sure it dries for atleast 10-20 mins, and use the included cloth.The smell is WAY BETTER than Meguiars NXT 2.0, and somehow it last much longer also, it has been 1 week since I fully waxed my war, and I can still smell it!Is it really any better than NXT 2.0?As far as shine goes, I felt it was the same thing. I did not have any streaks or other problems the other reviewers are having.I used my clay bar before waxing, maybe this made the difference.As far as durability goes, I have not had it for more than 1 week, so I cannot tell yet, but am confident it will be same if not better in durability.Conclusion: If you have metallic paint, I would Definitely give this a try! It is around 5 bucks pricier than NXT 2.0, for that reason I will remain using NXT unless I noticed a difference in durability.

First, I'm giving this product 4 stars because I haven't had a chance to test the durability of this product.  I may upgrade the rating later.I bought this product because my Ranger has a LOT of exterior vinyl.  Use the wrong wax and the vinyl will stain and sometimes it's not easy to fix..  Trying to avoid all that vinyl while waxing becomes very tiresome so when I heard that Meguair's Ultimate Liquid Wax (MULW) didn't stain vinyl I bought a bottle.  That this wax can be applied out under the sun is a nice feature as well.I bought this from Amazon on Friday and on Monday it was on my doorstep.  A Prime membership is one of the best investments I make each year.I decided to give this product a severe test and waxed several border areas making no effort to miss the vinyl.  A few minutes later I buffed it off and I was satisfied that this wax will be my go-to wax for transition areas at least.  The waxed vinyl appears to have a deeper color and is not shiny.  I also applied the wax to a portion of my repainted tonneau cover and it worked just fine coming off easily and without leaving behind streaks.  I could easily do my whole ride with this product if I wanted.There have been numerous complaints about MULW on detailing boards because of streaking and I'd like to say that streaks seem to happen when the product is applied too heavily.  Heavy applications waste product and make the wax difficult to buff. You have to apply a light coat and when I say a light coat, I mean that you should be barely able to see the wax.  If you can see it easily, you put on too much.Unlike the paste wax, the foam pad Meguair's supplies is pretty decent.  It's not a sandwich-type pad, that's to say two thin pads separated by an air space so I decided to use the pad.Proper pad preparation is important as well for a good result..  I put down a circle of wax halfway from the center to the edge and used my finger to spread the product evenly over the surface.  Once the pad had the wax completely covering the application surface, I added about three additional drops to the pad and began to apply the wax.  I did not have to add additional wax until I'd waxed the running board and two chromed wheels.  Another two drops was needed for two more wheels and a running board.  See what I mean about applying it thin?  Follow these instructions and you can do a whole car with about an ounce (probably less) of this wax and one microfiber towel for buffing.After I finished waxing, I put the pad inside two sandwich bags purging as much air from them as possible so that the pad will not dry out.If you apply this wax properly, you should be able to get 20+ applications out of a bottle.  If you're only going to use one wax, this product should be on your short list.

I've used the Meguiar's Ultimate Spray Wax, Ultimate Liquid Wax and Ultimate Paste Wax and this was the worst, the other two products were great. I clayed my truck applied Meguiar's Ultimate Polish and this wax left streaks. I tried many different detailing techniques and I still noticed streaks. I decided to purchase the Ultimate Paste Wax, after hours of frustration, and it removed the streaks this left behind and it was so easy to remove with a Cobra microfiber rag. The only way this product works, without leaving streaks, is if you spray it with Ultimate Detailer or Ultimate Spray Wax afterwards. What a waste of $20 this was.Update: After posting my review above I found this wax works really well if you use a DA  buffer, I purchased the Porter Cable DA sander/buffer with Meguiar's pads. So if you don't have a good DA buffer don't bother with this one buy the Ultimate Paste Wax.
summary: Works Great With DA Buffer Only

reviewText: used Meguiar's ultimate polish first then the ultimate wax WOW! my factory 2002 purple harley looks better than new honest! the meguiars polish used first takes out all the really fine imperfections then the wax omg stunning! read my review for the ultimate polish cleaned my truck headlights!
Super easy to apply and remove.  Very forgiving when you get it on non painted surfaces.

As the other reviews state this really is a fantastic wax.  I haven't waxed a car in many years and was used to the goopy waxy dry cheap stuff.  This is really in a league of its own.  The wax goes on smoothly, almost kind of greasy in how easy it spreads onto your surface.  Let it dry for a few minutes then take it off with the cloth.  My car is new and it left it with a better-than-new finish after using the polish from Meguiars.Application was very easy and the included pad and cloth are very useful.  At the end my car looked great.  I'd use this polish again but am curious to see what the tech wax is like as well.
This wax is great your car's paint gets a smooth and soft finish and it also smells great nice product
I kinda like idea on Easy On, Easy Off. I even apply it on my plastic trim, rubber lining, and on my vinyl stickers. Its great and smooth to touch.
Have used this stuff for years, since it came out, and in the Florida sun, it's the only wax that holds up. Easy on Easy off.

This wax gives your paint an awesome deep gloss and is very very forgivable, unlike caranuba which gets rock hard after 3-5 minutes. Mind you caranuba gives your paint a much richer finish but I still prefer the ultimate line for general paint maintenance

I had this wax for a couple of month's now since before it was available at amazon or most retailers.  The reason I didn't use it sooner is because while I was awaiting the release of this product I had just used the NXT 2.0 wax days prior and just held off using the Ultimate Liquid Wax until I needed to wax again.  Well that came this past weekend and one of the things I noticed is just like the other reviewer said...the wax was very difficult to remove with a microfiber cloth.  I had to go over most of my truck 2 times and then some and I did one section at a time.  Meguiar's says you get the best results with this wax (probably b/c of the difficulty to remove in relation to other waxes) by doing a section at a time.  I did one section at a time, and it was still difficult to remove.  Now, one of the benefits of this ultimate liquid wax is that you can use it in direct sunlight.  I did this when there wasn't much sun, so that wasn't the reason behind the difficulty in removing the wax, it's just the nature of the wax itself.  But still, for many people who don't have sufficient shade, that is a positive.Another positive is that the ultimate liquid wax actually acts as a polish so there is NO NEED TO POLISH before using this.  The previous reviewer must not been aware of this fact but it sure does make a huge difference and save half the time when this is basically a polish and wax all in one.  And sure enough, when I was done there were no fine scratches or swirl marks, just a nice gleam.  Now as far as the finished look I was not really impressed.  I've used most of Meguiar's products/waxes but this look was nothing special.  It had a decent shine, but nowhere near MIRROR-LIKE and my truck is relatively new with a nice, metallic black pearlcoat.  The finish of this product looked almost identical to that of the ULTIMATE LIQUID SPRAY WAX.  Now obviously the Ultimate Liquid wax will outlast the spray wax, but in terms of appearance, the Ultimate Liquid Wax was nothing special.From everything i've read on this, the wax is supposed to outlast all other Meguiar's waxes, including the NXT 2.0 WAX.  If that is the case I will come back and update my review 1/2 star.  Just the fact that the wax is a quality wax, it does look nice and it can be used the sun give this wax 3 stars.  But as far as removal of the wax and overall appearance, 3-3.5 stars is as high as this wax is deserving.  And remember, this wax is NOT for flat paint finishes, it is ONLY for METALLIC paint finishes.
summary: Ok, but not worthy of the hype

This wax worked good protecting my paint. I liked the result. So far so good.Recommended.

reviewText: For more then slight discoloration this kit works.There is enough product in the kit for two vehicles if youFollow the directions.

reviewText: I was apprehensive in buying and trying this product.  I mean, who wants to use an abrasive product (sandpaper) on plastic headlamps?  We have a Volvo XC90 with the active xenon headlamps - replacement cost $1,000 EACH.Well - It's well worth the time and money.  The kit comes with a small 1000 and 3000 grit sanding disc.  I opted to buy some 220, 400 and 1500.  I started with the 220, very lightly wet sanding the headlamp.  Then on to the 400.  Then I used the kit's 1000, then the 1500.  I finished with the kit's 3000.  Very impressive results.I would recommend this to anyone that wants to greatly improve the appearance and the restore the transparency to damaged headlamp lenses.

This product works!  I had previously tried the Turtle Wax resoration kit and had pretty much resigned myself to buying new headlight lenses at about $100 a piece.  Then I read the reviews on this product and decided that I would give restoration one last try.  Wow!It works!  My headlights look like new!  Follow the instructions, be patient and voila!

Used it on wifey's Honda Civic Si. After an hour or so of work, looked 95% better. The lenses don't look like new, but you have to be looking closely to notice any imperfections left. All of the yellowing is gone and nearly all of the haze. Drastic improvement.I'm sure I'll have to repeat every year or so, but that's fine considering the cost replacing the lenses would be.

Unfortunately I forgot to get a true "before" picture, but I did get a picture after my initial attempt to clean the lights on my mom's Bug, and a picture after using this kit. The lights were as bad as a lot of the other pictures, cloudy and yellow, and just ugly. I had some of the Plastx polish from a different Meguiar's car care kit, but I only had the polish. Just using that made quite a difference, but trying to use only the polish, and using it by hand, I would never have managed to get them much better than they are in my "before" picture. I decided to try the kit, and as soon as I started I could see how much of the dried plastic was coming off of the lenses. The amazing part was using the polish with the drill attachment! You could actually watch the lenses go from cloudy to clear as you use it. If your lights are bad, even if you think they are past saving, you should give this kit a try! Look at the pictures people have sent in... I wouldn't think it was possible to do what this kit does if it were not for the pictures, and now that I have done it myself there is no doubt that this kit works. Before looking into all this, I would not have believed that you could ever get "clear" back from damaged plastic. It just didn't seem like something that could be done! The proof is in the pics!I have been happy with all of the Meguiar's products I use. In some cases they cost a little more, but they are not the most expensive products out there, and they are quality products that really work.  This kit goes beyond the typical car care stuff because it produces such dramatic results in a relatively short time. There is enough in the kit to do several sets of lights, and it includes a bottle of the protectant that is supposed to keep your lights from fading in the future. I am using this on my new car, and I will try to come back down the road and review that, but it would take a long time before lights would start to look bad, so by that time I might have long forgotten my plan. However, With Meguiar's quality, I believe that it will do what it says, and I believe that based on their reputation, it is worth giving it a try on faith. You will get plenty of it in the kit as well, so you can use it on your cars that haven't started to fade as well as the ones you fix.This kit is money WELL spent!

I love Meguairs products, but really question whoever designed this spray head.  Its like a fire extinguisher.  You can empty the can in 60 seconds.  Probably only enough to do 8-12 tires in this can.  I recommend the gel instead.  It does last a good while, even driving through several rains.
summary: Good product but the spray version is a big waste.

reviewText: I love this stuff.  Meguiar's Endurance Tire Dressing Aerosol -15 oz is the best tire dressing on the market.  No sling off, last forever even with all our rain and looks fantastic.  Always get compliments on how clean my truck tires stay.  i use this in conjunction with Sanctiond W30016 Wheel and Tire Cleaner.  Never a complaint yet.  Two thumbs up on this one Meguire's don't ever change the endurance tire dressing.  Highly recommend this tire spray to anyone who ask.

Now this review is going to be somewhat of a contradiction between positive and negative, especially for a four star review but I will do my best to explain in detail as best as possible.Aerosol:  For an aerosol I haven't found a product that beats this.  Of course with any spray you are most likely going to get spray where you don't necessarily want it.  With that being said if precision and "endurance" is key I would recommend the gel.  I only tried these because they were on a huge clearance at my local auto store.  I've used others and the results were horrible, bad run marks even under light usage, large amounts of sling, and severe "browning" of the tires after only a few days.The shine is still unfortunately due to a silicon based product, which is never good for auto body paint.  If your main priority is paint protection then this product or any other product containing silicon is NOT for you.This product has definitely outlasted my expectations.  After week 1 the tires were still showing moderate shine even in upper midwests currently salty winter road conditions.  It also seemed to hold to the tires better in general not "slinging" all over the place like other products i've used including Meguiars.  The funny thing is if you look up the product description of Meguiars Endurance tire GEL part of it reads as followed "Saves time by eliminating all the mess common with sprays and foams. Saves money by lasting longer, requiring fewer applications". It's like they basically said, yeah, those stink. lol.. But again, for a spray, its good.Final note:  my tires did not brown with this product unlike most of the others.
it dries wet, beautifully and streak free. It sprays on more evenly as most products ive tried as well..love it.
summary: best tire shine on the market imo

reviewText: First let me start by saying I have roughly 3/4 of the Meguiar's products made and love every one of them including this Endurance (Aerosol)Tire Dressing...BUT.....there is a major issue and it isn't just with this Aerosol, but ANY Aerosol Spray, and that is that they just don't last long!  That's probably an understatement as even with a LIGHT-COATING spray on my 4 tires, HALF THE CAN WAS GONE!  The NXT INSANE SHINE TIRE SPRAY is slightly bigger (a few ounces more) so I can MAYBE squeeze out 3 seperate tire applications out of it..but that's it!  Now the benefit to the Aerosol cans is that they are CONVENIENT, not Messy, and QUICK!  You can spray all 4 tires in a minute or two..but for $7-$10 a can...sorry Charlie...that's just a rip.  Most people (myself included) work hard for their money and expect to get more then 2 applications from a tire spray.  It's ridiculous to be honest.  So with that being said, i'm just sticking to the Meguiar's Gels and Tire Sprays (Trigger bottles) as they go much further for the dollar, they just take more time to apply.  Another benefit to the sprays & gels are that they last longer then ANY of the Aerosol tire dressings, including this one.  It's been 1 week since I washed my truck and while my tires do have some shine left...I work 5 miles from work and it's freeway driving.  I haven't driven over any mud or puddles, and this shine is no better nor any longer lasting then the NXT INSANE TIRE SPRAY.  Both last about a week, so if you wash your vehicle weekly (like I typically do) you'll need to cans per month.  That's $18-$20 a month or well over $200 a year just on tire dressing alone!!  That is, if you continue to use the Aerosol cans.  I love Meguiar's but I'm a little disappointed here.  Yes, the product works, but it's just a major rip off to have 15oz in an Aerosol Tire Dressing can.  If this can were 45oz, this product would be worthy of 5 stars.  But the same goes true for the Insane Shine Tire Spray as well.So in summary, if you're in a real rush and need a quick tire dressing, this fits the bill.  But over the long haul if you take care of your ride like I do and wash it regularly, then there are much better options out there for longevity and price.

This does last rather long. It makes the tires smell great too. Hey, don't judge! ;-) But seriously, it's a very good product and I do like using this one over the other offerings Meguiar's has for tire dressing. I use this on my Michelin PS2s on my CTS-V.

Was recommended this product based on the fact I had swirls on my car. I applied the product to the car as directed, but it was harder to take off than apply. I may have let it sit too long, but I don't know until I try it again. But it did remove my swirls and brought out the best in the paint. After adding, I just applied some quik wax and my car went back to looking fresh!
summary: Goes on easy, hard to wipe off

reviewText: This stuff easily removes some black swirls and marks from my blue paint. It gives your paint a deep shine and reflection if you use a nice wax after this (I used meguiar's ultimate liquid wax). Just be aware that this polish does dry extremely quickly. Pull your car into the garage and let it sit until the paint is cool to the touch. I recommend doing small sections (like a quarter of the hood) at one time. Make sure you apply and then immediately buff off with a microfiber. Overall for 7 bucks, it doesn't get any better. I love the entire Meguiar's ultimate series.Just FYI I used these steps on my new carWash and dryPulled into garage to let paint cool off.Clayed the whole car (mother's clay bar kit)Ultimate PolishUltimate Liquid WaxMy car looks awesome, just took 3 hours of elbow grease.

This is a dynamite product, easy on-easy off, great results!I used it on a 14 year old Lexus with white metallic paint.  Although the car has been well cared for, it had amassed its share of swirls, light scratches and bonded contaminants.  I thought for sure I was going to have to clay it first, but as that's a step I am not fond of, I thought I would take a chance and try the polish alone,  I'm sure glad I did.I applied the polish by hand. Afterward, the car felt absolutely smooth to the touch, and many of the previously mentioned defects were either gone or faded into the background. The paint was shiny, with depth and brilliance restored.After carefully wiping off all the excess polish, I gave the paint a "quick detail" with a detailing spray to make sure all the dust was removed before waxing. I followed this with one coat of Carnauba Wax.  The result was outstanding.  I have never seen white paint give off such clarity, depth, gloss and reflectivity.  The surface of the car is now smooth to the touch and the envy of many of the mechanics over at the Lexus dealership when I went in to buy some parts yesterday.I think that the Ultimate Polish is a great product, at a very fair price.  I highly recommend it.Ps.  I did use a more slightly more aggressive pad to apply the polish.  It's called a Polishing pad  (as opposed to a finishing pad) Used with a hand held pad holder called a Polishing Pal (available on Amazon).  All work was done by hand, following Meguiar's instructions for multiple passes over each section.
summary: This is a dynamite product, easy on-easy off, great results!

reviewText: I use this as the middle step between the compound and the wax, and it does great.  It's not meant to be a wax, but a very mild cutting (polishing) compound to reduce marks left by the heavier cutting compound before applying the wax.
summary: Does exactly what it is supposed to do.

reviewText: I purchased this polish to remove swirl marks on my black 2007 Chrysler 300C. I used it with an electric buffer and a Chemical Guys BUFLC_103_8 - Lake Country Heavy Polishing Pad which I also reviewed separately.I watched a few Youtube videos to get a basic idea on how to use the product and followed the instructions on the bottle too. The product performed well, removing almost all of the swirl marks after one application. Some took a little more effort and some did not come completely out, but are barely noticeable now. I suspect I would need to use a bit more aggressive methods to get them out, but did not want to go that route.I learned quickly that the surface needs to be completely cool, which is stated on the bottle, or it can dry and be difficult to remove. I used Meguiar's X2020 Supreme Shine Microfiber Towels (reviewed separately) to remove the product and the combination worked well. When I did have smudges or dried polish I removed it with Meguiar's G14422 Ultimate Quick Detailer, which I highly recommend and have reviewed previously. A nice side benefit is the product has a nice smell so you don't have to suffer through a couple hours of dealing with a foul odor.Overall I am very pleased with how this polish performed. I can't recommend using it without an electric buffer. I just think it would be too much work to be effective and way to time consuming. It took me a good 3-4 hours even with a buffer. But I got the results I was looking for and can recommend it for anyone looking to get rid of swirls and light scratches. Anything more than that and you'd want to use a rubbing compound and different pad.

For the price it can't be beat.  I apply this product right before I apply "Ultimate Liquid Wax".  I get phenomenal results every time especially using a Dual Action Polisher.This product works best when you apply it to a cool surface.
This was the final product that was recommended that I put on my clear coated wheels.  It keeps the shine.

I have a black 2013 Lexus. I refuse to take it to a car wash or use a buffer. I do not want any swirls. I do my own washing and detailing. I use ONLY Meguire products. The polish did great removing road film before I waxed it. It was hard to put on without a buffer and remove before drying. It was worth it. Great shine!!!

I used this on my dark purple harley before using the Meguiar's ultimate wax WOW ! shine on baby! used  it on my 1999 tacoma headlights rub hard and fast wipe before dry oxidation gone wax with ultimate for continued protection shhhhh don't tell anyone

This really is a great product.  I have a brand new car so there wasn't much work that needed to be done.  I just wanted to add some depth to the paint and this certainly does the trick.  It wipes on very easily and comes off just as easy.  Like the instructions say - give it only a few minutes to sink in then wipe it off with a towel. I purchased Meguiar's Ultimate Polish to address some light swirl marks and fine scratches on my otherwise well-kept paint job. It was quite difficult to hand-buff off, even when doing so immediately after application. I think the process, both in ease and efficacy, would improve with mechanical application and buffing. I had recently clayed the vehicle so maybe the paint was just in better shape than this polish could improve.After spending quite a bit on cleaners/protectants, I came to the conclusion that if a car's paint is already in good condition (in this case a five year-old Accord), all I'm going to do from here on is wash, clay (twice per year), and apply a good synthetic polymer wax/sealant. I'll leave the multi-level regiment of glazes and polishes to those looking for show quality.I was conflicted on the three star rating. While it didn't deserve only a single star ("I hate it"), the "I don't like it" of two stars is somewhat accurate. For me to like it, it would need to accomplish something beneficial, which it did not (to my eyes). However, I think two stars implies something is still wrong with the product, which I'm not comfortable saying. So it gets an "It's okay," because I think much of the experience had to do with my vehicle, and I don't want to sway someone from trying something that may in fact work for their needs.

reviewText: This is the first wax I've used on my car and it is real easy to apply and leaves a great coat of protection. This wax also smells amazing!

Like most of Meguair's products in my experiences Ultimate Paste Wax is easy to use, especially if applied in a thin layer.  Applying the wax heavily simply wastes product and creates a mess as many others have noted.  One of the best ways to insure a proper application is to use a proper application pad.  Throw the pad that Meguiars provides in the trash.  Use a Lake Country CCS applicator pad instead.  You get two pads for $5.  But if you want the very best application method, use a DA polisher with a finishing pad.  This is how you get the thinnest application and it will buff right off because with a extremely thin layer the wax (actually a sealant) dries very quickly.According to AutoGeek, this wax can indeed be applied in the sunshine but I have never tried it.  My guess is that if the surface is warm, my guess is that you can wipe it on and the buff it off.  Since I've never tried this I really don't have a recommendation for applying in the sun but the commentary on this product at AutoGeek says the product is "foolproof" so it can't be too hard to do.The paste can be applied to the pad by patting the pad into the paste.  Wiping the pad in the paste will load it up too much though if you're starting out with a new pad, you may have to wipe the pad into the wax just a bit.  If you're doing it right, You will be putting down a layer of wax that will be hard to see.Once the applicator pad is properly coated with wax, it will be good to keep it protected until you need to wax again.  The paste can has enough internal space to store the pad.As for vinyl/rubber trim, I've come to change my mind about it staining these materials.  I have tried it on some vinyl trim and it seems to buff off just fine.I look for this wax to last about 3-4 months unless the car is exposed frequently to a combination of high temperatures and rain like what we see in Georgia during the summer.  I haven't had enough time to evaluate the wax's ability to cope with bird bombs and bug splats.

Apparently these are no longer in stock but I purchased this helmet directly from the manufacture.The size chart was accurate.  I first put it on and felt pressure on my upper cheeks and was worried it may be too small, but very soon it broke in nicely.  There is enough firm padding to keep the helmet feeling secure yet comfortable.Unless there is some crash testing i dont know about, no one will know how well a helmet will keep a head safe, but I feel confident enough with this full face.Visor swapping i found very difficult and would not look forward to doing again.  but no need as i like the tinted shield.  It is difficult to see out of it at night but what tinted shield wouldn't.The matte finish doesn't provide scratch protection but what matte finish does.Even with the vents full open air flow is  minimal, that REALLY could be improved for summer use.The 2 gripes are the the chinstrap, it is a double loop that is a bit tedious to use as most loops are, but if one really wants to they can add an adapter, I just may.And its rather difficult to raise the visor being there is a very small lip for this, too small, and gloves dont help.That said not sure why i dont give it the extra 5th start considering the comparative low price.I suppose cuz its not perfect.

Pro:- Super cheap- Rigid- 2 visors/screens- Aero dynamic- Not too much wind noise- Comfy helmet- DOT approved- Cool looking matte blackCons:- Not that much airflow from the top vents- Harder to install another visor (switching between tinted/transparent wind screen)- A bit heavy- A bit tight on the bottom (a bit harder to get the helmet over the head)- Not Snell approved- Heat attracting black- Visor clicks into place. Can't click it between places.- Visor handle is on the left. Sometimes opening or closing it, results in the visor to be angled (the right side clicked, but the left side of the visor still is in previous setting).- Visor fogs up a bit in chilly rainy days.Other thoughts:I wore only 3 helmets in my life. My experience with this helmet is, that it makes much less wind noise at high speeds than any other helmets I've wore before!It's also very aero dynamic; meaning this helmet does not tug on me when driving above 65. The noise levels are quite low at 70MPH, not as low as some more expensive helmets, but lower than some $120 helmets I've tried.Compared to this helmetPGR Jet Pilot Open Face Motorcycle DOT APPROVED Helmet JE02 (L, Silver), this black helmet is way better and safer; though noticeably a bit heavier too!Overall, this is a great helmet, which I would buy again for this price! I don't care much about helmets sold for $120 in the stores, they generally don't have more quality as a helmet like this one.

First of all, it is a great price point.  Second, the product arrived in half the estimated time, thanks a bunch who ever shipped it.  Third, it more than meets my expectations. Bought this as a backup helmet and chose it because it was so cheap. It comes with 2 visors which is nice. However, you can tell it uses cheap material in the inside cushioning. Road noise is pretty loud and it would not be my first choice for a longer road trip. Nonetheless, at the price point it is great if you just need an extra helmet.

Ratings on products are pretty much just varying opinions; many people don't consider the price of a product when rating it overall--they strictly rate the quality, which isn't fair in my opinion.So, for the price, this helmet gets the coveted 5-star rating from me.  But barely.The good:  The helmet is DOT approved, lightweight, fairly well-ventilated with one vent on top that allows air to blow between pads/foam in the top and over the top of your head/hair, and one vent on the bottom that splits left and right into two areas of incoming air on the inside, which are lined up approximately just below the corners of your mouth, and are composed of a few tiny little holes.  I have already used the helmet in 90+ degree, humid weather, and it keeps you cool when you are moving, even with the shield down.  The shields are nice and do their job, with good visibility and no distortion.  They are easy to flip up and down.The bad: I went with my gut and ordered a size larger than the seller recommends, and thank gawd for that because it's snug.  But snug is good; a good helmet fit will allow very little movement of the helmet on your head side-to-side and front-to-back which you should test when you get it.  You should be able to fit 1 or 1.5 fingers between your chin and the front of the lower part of the helmet, one finger or less between your temples and the sides of the helmet, and the same for the the area between your upper forehead and the front of the helmet, BUT it shouldn't be so snug that you get a headache or red marks after 15mins or more of use.  So, I believe the seller's sizing chart is wrong.Next, although the shield's quality is good, the directions for swapping the shields flat-out suck.  With the new version of this helmet, you DON'T need to change any screws/brackets; it is the same bracket for both shields and no tools are needed.  However, you'll see things in the instructions like (paraphrasing) "Place shield in position C" when there IS NO POSITION C in the diagram.  So, here's the trick to swapping shields: study the very small slit in the circle that the screw is in; understand that as you tuck the "fin" in, it can't just go in that general area--it has to go into that very fine slit.  Once you've done that at about a 45-degree angle, with the face shield sort of in the half-open position, it's a breeze (I would have said snap but I don't do puns... then again, breeze?).  After you get used to that little trick, it's easy to swap shields, although the dark one isn't that dark and I will leave mine on night and day.  When you have the helmet on, flipping the shield down sounds like a jackhammer coming down.  Also, there are some mild air leaks around the shield which doesn't bother me at all.I ride a 50cc scooter so I'm satisfied with what this helmet will do for me.  I've read peoples' testimonies about how this helmet saved their lives, but frankly, if I'm going over 60mph, I'm looking at something a little more well-known.  For me, the comfort works, the ventilation is adequate, it's DOT-approved and it is rather handsome from any angle.  For the price, to get all that--that's a good deal.  Would recommend to anybody doing less than 60mph.

The fuels today use 10% Ethanol that burns cleaner but also absorbs moisture so if your lawn equipment sits for more than 30 days with the same fuel it will damage the components. This is cheaper than other products and it's worth the money to keep your machines works properly.
summary: A Must Have For Lawn Equipment

reviewText: Just to be clear, this is not a stabilizer for storage, this just helps to prevent the problems associated with using Ethanol. I use it religiously in my mowers and other small engines, 2 ounces per 5 gallons of gas, and I have not had any carburetor problems since. On my car, I always, and I mean ALWAYS, had 2-3 degrees of spark knock registered by the knock sensors, it goes away when I treat the gas with this stuff.

I added a bottle of this to my daughters '94 Camry 2.2 before she took off for Memphis Feb 2nd. We live in the central Illinois. First tank out she calculated 31.8 mpg. That was an increase of 3mpg from when she drove there last June. Was it this product? Too many variables involved to say this is the secret to the Holy MPG Grail. I used it my car on 2 tanks and put it in my wife's car and saw no significant increase in performance or mileage. Long highway distance is where it will most likely make the difference. I will for sure start adding it to all my motorcycles and lawn equipment when they all go down for the winter and see how it compares to the standard Sta-bil.

Good product if you store ethanol gas in anything. Ethanol turns back into water in a few short weeks. This stuff combines with the water and allows it to burn. Great for lawn mowers, motorcycles, etc. that you store over winter.
summary: no more water in your stored gas
